function uniqueSources(sources: readonly TerrainLineSource[]): readonly TerrainLineSource[] {
  return sources
    .filter((source, index, all) =>
      all.findIndex((candidate) => taggedSourceId(candidate) === taggedSourceId(source)) === index)
    .sort((left, right) => taggedSourceId(left).localeCompare(taggedSourceId(right)));
}

interface SightBlockingHit {
  readonly cell: GridCell;
  readonly progress: number;
}

function firstSharedEdgeBlockingHit(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
): SightBlockingHit | null {
  if (from.row === to.row && Number.isInteger(from.row)) {
    const direction = from.column < to.column ? 1 : -1;
    for (
      let column = direction === 1 ? from.column : from.column - 1;
      direction === 1 ? column < to.column : column >= to.column;
      column += direction
    ) {
      const upper = { column, row: from.row - 1 };
      const lower = { column, row: from.row };
      // Deterministic pair choice: the flanking cell with the lower row wins.
      if (sightBlockingAt(upper) && sightBlockingAt(lower)) {
        const entryColumn = direction === 1 ? column : column + 1;
        return { cell: upper, progress: (entryColumn - from.column) / (to.column - from.column) };
      }
    }
  }
  if (from.column === to.column && Number.isInteger(from.column)) {
    const direction = from.row < to.row ? 1 : -1;
    for (
      let row = direction === 1 ? from.row : from.row - 1;
      direction === 1 ? row < to.row : row >= to.row;
      row += direction
    ) {
      const left = { column: from.column - 1, row };
      const right = { column: from.column, row };
      // Deterministic pair choice: the flanking cell with the lower column wins.
      if (sightBlockingAt(left) && sightBlockingAt(right)) {
        const entryRow = direction === 1 ? row : row + 1;
        return { cell: left, progress: (entryRow - from.row) / (to.row - from.row) };
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function greatestCommonDivisor(left: number, right: number): number {
  let dividend = Math.abs(left);
  let divisor = Math.abs(right);
  while (divisor !== 0) {
    const remainder = dividend % divisor;
    dividend = divisor;
    divisor = remainder;
  }
  return dividend;
}

function firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
): SightBlockingHit | null {
  if (![from.column, from.row, to.column, to.row].every(Number.isInteger)) return null;
  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
  const latticeSteps = greatestCommonDivisor(columnDelta, rowDelta);
  if (latticeSteps <= 1) return null;
  const columnStep = columnDelta / latticeSteps;
  const rowStep = rowDelta / latticeSteps;
  // Indices exclude t=0 and t=1: endpoint vertices are governed only by cell-interior crossing.
  for (let index = 1; index < latticeSteps; index += 1) {
    const column = from.column + columnStep * index;
    const row = from.row + rowStep * index;
    const topLeft = { column: column - 1, row: row - 1 };
    const topRight = { column, row: row - 1 };
    // Check TL/BR first so lower row then lower column wins when both pairs seal.
    if (sightBlockingAt(topLeft) && sightBlockingAt({ column, row })) {
      return { cell: topLeft, progress: index / latticeSteps };
    }
    if (sightBlockingAt(topRight) && sightBlockingAt({ column: column - 1, row })) {
      return { cell: topRight, progress: index / latticeSteps };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function cellInteriorEntryProgress(from: CornerPoint, to: CornerPoint, cell: GridCell): number {
  let entry = 0;
  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
  if (columnDelta !== 0) {
    entry = Math.max(entry, Math.min(
      (cell.column - from.column) / columnDelta,
      (cell.column + 1 - from.column) / columnDelta,
    ));
  }
  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
  if (rowDelta !== 0) {
    entry = Math.max(entry, Math.min(
      (cell.row - from.row) / rowDelta,
      (cell.row + 1 - from.row) / rowDelta,
    ));
  }
  return entry;
}

function firstSightBlockingCell(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  interveningCells: readonly GridCell[],
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
): GridCell | null {
  let first = firstSharedEdgeBlockingHit(from, to, sightBlockingAt);
  const vertex = firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(from, to, sightBlockingAt);
  if (vertex !== null && (first === null || vertex.progress < first.progress ||
    (vertex.progress === first.progress && compareCells(vertex.cell, first.cell) < 0))) first = vertex;
  for (const cell of interveningCells) {
    if (!sightBlockingAt(cell)) continue;
    const hit = { cell, progress: cellInteriorEntryProgress(from, to, cell) };
    if (first === null || hit.progress < first.progress ||
      (hit.progress === first.progress && compareCells(hit.cell, first.cell) < 0)) first = hit;
  }
  // One traversal merges cell-interior, shared-edge and strict-interior-vertex events by segment progress.
  // Simultaneous events use lower row, then lower column.
  return first === null ? null : { ...first.cell };
}

function traceCornerLine(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  candidates: readonly GridCell[],
  sourcesAt: (cell: GridCell) => readonly TerrainLineSource[],
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
): TerrainCornerLineTrace {
  const interveningCells = rasterizeCornerLine(from, to, candidates);
  let tier: CoverTier = 'none';
  let strongest: TerrainLineSource[] = [];
  const firstBlockingCell = firstSightBlockingCell(
    from,
    to,
    interveningCells,
    sightBlockingAt,
  );
  for (const cell of interveningCells) {
    for (const source of sourcesAt(cell)) {
      const comparison = coverRank(source.tier) - coverRank(tier);
      if (comparison > 0) {
        tier = source.tier;
        strongest = [source];
      } else if (comparison === 0) {
        strongest.push(source);
      }
    }
  }
  const sources = uniqueSources(strongest);
  return {
    targetCorner: { ...to },
    interveningCells,
    tier,
    blocksSight: firstBlockingCell !== null,
    sourceIds: sources.map(taggedSourceId),
    sources,
    firstBlockingCell,
  };
}

function traceSpaces(
  state: EncounterState,
  sourceCells: readonly GridCell[],
  targetCells: readonly GridCell[],
  options: TerrainLineOptions,
): TerrainLineTrace {
  const sightBlockingCells = normalizedSightBlockingCells(options.additionalSightBlockingCells);
  const blockerSignature = sightBlockingSignature(sightBlockingCells);
  const traceKey = `${options.includeCreatures === true ? 'creatures' : 'terrain'}:${sourceCells
    .map(cellKey).join(';')}->${targetCells.map(cellKey).join(';')}#sight:${blockerSignature}`;
  const stateTraces = terrainLineTraces.get(state) ?? new Map<string, TerrainLineTrace>();
  const cached = stateTraces.get(traceKey);
  if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
  if (!terrainLineTraces.has(state)) terrainLineTraces.set(state, stateTraces);
  const nearest = nearestCells(sourceCells, targetCells);
  const exclusions = new Set([...sourceCells, ...targetCells].map(cellKey));
  const indexedSources = indexedTerrainSources(state, options.includeCreatures === true);
  const equivalentTraceKey = `${terrainSourceSignature(
    state,
    options.includeCreatures === true,
    indexedSources,
  )}\0${traceKey}`;
  const equivalent = equivalentTerrainLineTraces.get(equivalentTraceKey);
  if (equivalent !== undefined) {
    stateTraces.set(traceKey, equivalent);
    return equivalent;
  }
  const sourceCorners = outerCorners(sourceCells);
  const targetCorners = outerCorners(targetCells);
  const cornerColumns = [...sourceCorners, ...targetCorners].map((corner) => corner.column);
  const cornerRows = [...sourceCorners, ...targetCorners].map((corner) => corner.row);
  const minimumColumn = Math.min(...cornerColumns);
  const maximumColumn = Math.max(...cornerColumns);
  const minimumRow = Math.min(...cornerRows);
  const maximumRow = Math.max(...cornerRows);
  const candidateEntries = sightBlockingCells.length === 0
    ? [...indexedSources.values()]
    : [...new Map([
        ...indexedSources.values(),
        ...sightBlockingCells.map((cell) => ({ cell, sources: [] })),
      ].map((entry) => [cellKey(entry.cell), entry] as const)).values()];
  const candidates = candidateEntries
    .filter((entry) => !exclusions.has(cellKey(entry.cell)) &&
      entry.cell.column < maximumColumn && entry.cell.column + 1 > minimumColumn &&
      entry.cell.row < maximumRow && entry.cell.row + 1 > minimumRow)
    .map((entry) => entry.cell);
  const sightBlockingKeys = new Set([
    ...sightBlockingCells.map(cellKey),
    ...[...indexedSources]
      .filter(([, entry]) => entry.sources.some((source) => source.tier === 'total'))
      .map(([key]) => key),
  ]);
  const sightBlockingAt = (cell: GridCell): boolean => {
    const key = cellKey(cell);
    return !exclusions.has(key) && sightBlockingKeys.has(key);
  };
  const traces = sourceCorners.map((sourceCorner) => aggregateCornerLines(
    sourceCorner,
    targetCorners.map((targetCorner) => traceCornerLine(
      sourceCorner,
      targetCorner,
      candidates,
      (cell) => indexedSources.get(cellKey(cell))?.sources ?? [],
      sightBlockingAt,
    )),
    nearest.sourceCell,
    nearest.targetCell,
  ));
  const first = traces[0];
  if (first === undefined) throw new RangeError('A line query requires non-empty source and target spaces.');
  const physicalSelected = traces.reduce(
    (best, candidate) => comparePhysicalCornerTraces(candidate, best) < 0 ? candidate : best,
    first,
  );
  const blocksSight = traces.every((trace) => trace.blocksSight);
  const opticalSelected = blocksSight
    ? traces.reduce(
        (best, candidate) => compareOpticalCornerTraces(candidate, best) < 0 ? candidate : best,
        first,
      )
    : null;
  const selected: TerrainLineTrace = {
    ...physicalSelected,
    blocksSight,
    firstBlockingCell: opticalSelected?.firstBlockingCell ?? null,
  };
  stateTraces.set(traceKey, selected);
  retainEquivalentTrace(equivalentTraceKey, selected);
  return selected;
}

/** The canonical 2014 corner-to-corner trace for two bare grid cells. */
export function traceTerrainLine(
  state: EncounterState,
  sourceCell: GridCell,
  targetCell: GridCell,
  options: TerrainLineOptions = {},
): TerrainLineTrace {
  return traceSpaces(state, [sourceCell], [targetCell], options);
}

export interface CreatureLineOptions {
  readonly sourceAnchor?: GridCell;
  readonly additionalSightBlockingCells?: readonly GridCell[];
}

export function traceCombatantLine(
  state: EncounterState,
  sourceId: CombatantId,
  targetId: CombatantId,
  options: CreatureLineOptions = {},
): TerrainLineTrace {
  const blockerSignature = sightBlockingSignature(
    normalizedSightBlockingCells(options.additionalSightBlockingCells),
  );
  const traceKey = `${String(sourceId)}->${String(targetId)}@${options.sourceAnchor === undefined
    ? 'current'
    : cellKey(options.sourceAnchor)}#sight:${blockerSignature}`;
  const cached = combatantLineTraces.get(state)?.get(traceKey);
  if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
  const source = options.sourceAnchor === undefined
    ? combatantSpace(state, sourceId)
  const stateTraces = combatantLineTraces.get(state) ?? new Map<string, TerrainLineTrace>();
  stateTraces.set(traceKey, trace);
  if (!combatantLineTraces.has(state)) combatantLineTraces.set(state, stateTraces);
  return trace;
}

export function coverTierBetweenObjects(
  objects: readonly WorldObject[],
  from: GridCell,
  to: GridCell,
): CoverTier {
  const exclusions = new Set([cellKey(from), cellKey(to)]);
  const candidates = [...new Map(objects
    .flatMap((object) => object.footprint)
    .filter((cell) => !exclusions.has(cellKey(cell)))
    .map((cell) => [cellKey(cell), cell] as const)).values()];
  const sourceCell = { ...from };
  const targetCell = { ...to };
  const targetCorners = outerCorners([to]);
  const sourcesAt = (cell: GridCell): readonly TerrainLineSource[] =>
    objects.flatMap((object): readonly TerrainLineSource[] =>
      objectOccupiesCell(object, cell) && object.blocking.cover !== 'none'
        ? [{ kind: 'world_object', id: String(object.id), tier: object.blocking.cover }]
        : []);
  const sightBlockingAt = (cell: GridCell): boolean =>
    !exclusions.has(cellKey(cell)) && sourcesAt(cell).some((source) => source.tier === 'total');
  const traces = outerCorners([from]).map((sourceCorner) => aggregateCornerLines(
    sourceCorner,
    targetCorners.map((targetCorner) => traceCornerLine(
      sourceCorner,
      targetCorner,
      candidates,
      sourcesAt,
      sightBlockingAt,
    )),
    sourceCell,
    targetCell,
  ));
  const first = traces[0];
  if (first === undefined) throw new RangeError('A line query requires non-empty source and target spaces.');
  return traces.reduce((best, candidate) =>
    comparePhysicalCornerTraces(candidate, best) < 0 ? candidate : best, first).tier;
}

export type CreatureCoverOptions = CreatureLineOptions;

export interface CombatantCoverResult {
  readonly tier: CoverTier;
  readonly sourceIds: readonly string[];
}

export function coverBetweenCombatants(
  state: EncounterState,
  sourceId: CombatantId,
  targetId: CombatantId,
  options: CreatureCoverOptions = {},
): CombatantCoverResult {
  const trace = traceCombatantLine(state, sourceId, targetId, options);
  return { tier: trace.tier, sourceIds: trace.sourceIds };
}

const EMPTY_ENVIRONMENT = {
  lightRegions: [],
  difficultTerrainRegions: [],
  movementRegions: [],
  obscurementRegions: [],
  narrowOpeningRegions: [],
} as const;

function withSenses(
  profile: CombatantProfile,
  senses: readonly CombatSense[],
): CombatantProfile {
  return { ...profile, rules: { ...profile.rules, senses } };
}

function normalProfile(key: string): CombatantProfile {
  return withSenses(playerProfile(key), [{ kind: 'normal_sight' }]);
}

function fieldState(
  observer: CombatantProfile,
  options: {
    readonly bounds?: { readonly columns: number; readonly rows: number };
    readonly position?: GridCell;
    readonly combatants?: readonly CombatantProfile[];
    readonly tokens?: readonly ReturnType<typeof placedToken>[];
    readonly blockedCells?: readonly GridCell[];
    readonly worldObjects?: EncounterState['worldObjects'];
    readonly environment?: EncounterState['environment'];
  } = {},
): EncounterState {
  return createEncounter({
    bounds: options.bounds ?? { columns: 5, rows: 3 },
    combatants: options.combatants ?? [observer],
    tokens: options.tokens ?? [combatToken(observer, options.position ?? { column: 0, row: 0 })],
    ...(options.blockedCells === undefined ? {} : { blockedCells: options.blockedCells }),
    ...(options.worldObjects === undefined ? {} : { worldObjects: options.worldObjects }),
    environment: options.environment ?? EMPTY_ENVIRONMENT,
  });
}

function seamState(wallAbove: boolean, doorBelow: boolean, blockedDoor = false): {
  readonly state: EncounterState;
  readonly observer: CombatantProfile;
  readonly subject: CombatantProfile;
} {
  const observer = normalProfile('seam-observer');
  const subject = normalProfile('seam-subject');
  const blockedCells = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_unused, row) =>
    row === 4 && !blockedDoor ? null : { column: 5, row })
    .filter((cell): cell is GridCell => cell !== null)
    .filter((cell) => wallAbove || cell.row !== 3);
  const worldObjects: EncounterState['worldObjects'] = doorBelow
    ? [{
        id: worldObjectId('object:seam-door'),
        name: 'Seam Door',
        kind: 'door',
        position: { column: 5, row: 4 },
        footprint: [{ column: 5, row: 4 }],
        durability: { kind: 'indestructible' },
        armorClass: armorClass(10),
        damageResponses: [],
        blocking: { movement: true, lineOfSight: true, cover: 'total' },
        createdRevision: 0,
      }]
    : [];
  return {
    observer,
    subject,
    state: fieldState(observer, {
      bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 8 },
      combatants: [observer, subject],
      tokens: [placedToken(observer, 2, 4), placedToken(subject, 8, 4)],
      blockedCells,
      worldObjects,
    }),
  };
}

function gradeRows(field: readonly VisibilityFieldCell[]): readonly string[] {
  return field.map(({ cell, grade }) => `${String(cell.column)},${String(cell.row)}:${grade}`);
}

function gradeAt(
  state: EncounterState,
  observer: CombatantProfile,
  column: number,
  row = 0,
): VisibilityFieldCell['grade'] {
  const entry = visibilityField(state, observer.id).find(({ cell }) =>
    cell.column === column && cell.row === row);
  if (entry === undefined) throw new Error(`Visibility field omitted ${String(column)},${String(row)}.`);
  return entry.grade;
}

function applyEffect(
  state: EncounterState,
  source: CombatantProfile,
  effect: EffectApplication,
): EncounterState {
  return {
    ...state,
    revision: state.revision + 1,
    nextEffectSequence: state.nextEffectSequence + 1,
    effects: [...state.effects, {
      id: encounterEffectId(`effect:test-visibility-${String(state.nextEffectSequence)}`),
      source: source.id,
      targets: effect.targets,
      createdRevision: state.revision + 1,
      duration: effect.duration,
      concentrationOwner: effect.concentration ? source.id : null,
      stackingIdentity: effect.stackingIdentity,
      stacking: effect.stacking,
      repeatedSave: effect.repeatedSave,
      payload: effect.payload,
    }],
  };
}

function conditionEffect(
  target: CombatantProfile,
  condition: 'Blinded' | 'Invisible',
): EffectApplication {
  return {
    targets: [target.id],
    duration: { kind: 'permanent' },
    concentration: false,
    stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity(`test:${condition.toLowerCase()}`),
    stacking: 'replace_same_source',
    repeatedSave: null,
    payload: { kind: 'condition', condition },
  };
}

function senseEffect(
  target: CombatantProfile,
  kind: 'darkvision' | 'devils_sight',
  rangeFeet: number,
): EffectApplication {
  return {
    targets: [target.id],
    duration: { kind: 'permanent' },
    concentration: false,
    stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity(`test:${kind}:${String(rangeFeet)}`),
    stacking: 'replace_same_source',
    repeatedSave: null,
    payload: { kind, rangeFeet },
  };
}

function obscuredAreaEffect(
  obscurement: 'heavy' | 'magical_darkness',
): EffectApplication {
  return {
    targets: [],
    duration: { kind: 'permanent' },
    concentration: false,
    stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity(`test:${obscurement}:screen`),
    stacking: 'replace_same_source',
    repeatedSave: null,
    payload: {
      kind: 'obscured_area',
      placement: {
        shape: 'line',
        template: {
          origin: feetPoint(10, 0),
          direction: { x: 0, y: 1 },
          length: feet(30),
          width: feet(10),
          includeOrigin: true,
        },
      },
      radiusFeet: 10,
      obscurement,
      dispersedByStrongWind: false,
    },
  };
}

function selectedTraceShape(trace: TerrainLineTrace) {
  return {
    sourceCell: trace.sourceCell,
    targetCell: trace.targetCell,
    sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
    lines: trace.lines,
    interveningCells: trace.interveningCells,
    tier: trace.tier,
    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
    sourceIds: trace.sourceIds,
    sources: trace.sources,
    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell,
  };
}

const COVER_TIER_BY_RANK = ['none', 'half', 'three_quarters', 'total'] as const satisfies readonly CoverTier[];

function countTier(obstructedLineCount: number): CoverTier {
  if (obstructedLineCount === 0) return 'none';
  if (obstructedLineCount <= 2) return 'half';
  if (obstructedLineCount === 3) return 'three_quarters';
  return 'total';
}

function aggregateCornerLines(
  sourceCorner: CornerPoint,
  lines: readonly TerrainCornerLineTrace[],
  sourceCell: GridCell,
  targetCell: GridCell,
): TerrainLineTrace {
  const blocksSight = lines.length === 4 && lines.every((line) => line.blocksSight);
  const physicalBlocksCover = lines.length === 4 && lines.every((line) => line.tier === 'total');
  const obstructed = lines.filter((line) => line.tier !== 'none');
  const strongestLineTier = obstructed.reduce<CoverTier>((strongest, line) =>
    coverRank(line.tier) > coverRank(strongest) ? line.tier : strongest, 'none');
  const tier = physicalBlocksCover
    ? 'total'
    : COVER_TIER_BY_RANK[Math.min(
        coverRank(countTier(obstructed.length)),
        coverRank(strongestLineTier),
        coverRank('three_quarters'),
      )] ?? 'none';
  const sources = tier === 'none'
    ? []
    : uniqueSources(obstructed
        .filter((line) => line.tier === strongestLineTier)
        .flatMap((line) => line.sources));
  const interveningCells = [...new Map(lines
    .flatMap((line) => line.interveningCells)
    .map((cell) => [cellKey(cell), cell] as const)).values()];
  const firstSightBlockingLine = blocksSight ? lines.find((line) => line.blocksSight) : undefined;
  return {
    sourceCell: { ...sourceCell },
    targetCell: { ...targetCell },
    sourceCorner: { ...sourceCorner },
    lines,
    interveningCells,
    tier,
    blocksSight,
    sourceIds: sources.map(taggedSourceId),
    sources,
    firstBlockingCell: firstSightBlockingLine?.firstBlockingCell ?? null,
  };
}

function comparePhysicalCornerTraces(left: TerrainLineTrace, right: TerrainLineTrace): number {
  return coverRank(left.tier) - coverRank(right.tier) ||
    left.sourceCorner.row - right.sourceCorner.row ||
    left.sourceCorner.column - right.sourceCorner.column;
}

function compareOpticalCornerTraces(left: TerrainLineTrace, right: TerrainLineTrace): number {
  return left.sourceCorner.row - right.sourceCorner.row ||
    left.sourceCorner.column - right.sourceCorner.column;
}

 export function outerCorners(cells: readonly GridCell[]): readonly CornerPoint[] {

+function outerCornerEndpoints(cells: readonly GridCell[]): readonly CornerEndpoint[] {
+  const corners = outerCorners(cells);
+  const topLeft = corners[0];
+  const topRight = corners[1];
+  const bottomLeft = corners[2];
+  const bottomRight = corners[3];
+  if (topLeft === undefined || topRight === undefined ||
+    bottomLeft === undefined || bottomRight === undefined) {
+    throw new RangeError('A line query requires four outer corners.');
+  }
+  // The quadrant names the occupied space relative to its outer corner:

+  it('SOURCE_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED', () => {
+    const observer = normalProfile('source-endpoint-observer');
+    const blockers = [
+      { column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 1, row: 1 },
+      { column: 2, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 },
+      { column: 2, row: 4 }, { column: 2, row: 5 },
+    ];
+    const state = fieldState(observer, { bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 6 }, blockedCells: blockers });
+    const trace = traceTerrainLine(state, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 0, row: 3 });
+
+    // The observer's bottom-left corner is vertex (2,2); its cell lies TR of that vertex.
+    // Ray (2,2)->(0,4) leaves into the opposite BL quadrant through the pinch sealed by
+    // TL (1,1) + BR (2,2). Lower-row cell (1,1) wins; physical cover remains None.
+    expect(trace).toMatchObject({
+      tier: 'none',
+      blocksSight: true,
+      firstBlockingCell: { column: 1, row: 1 },
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('TARGET_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED', () => {

+    const blockers = [
+      { column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 1, row: 1 },
+      { column: 2, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 },
+      { column: 2, row: 4 }, { column: 2, row: 5 },
+    ];
+    const state = fieldState(observer, { bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 6 }, blockedCells: blockers });
+    const trace = traceTerrainLine(state, { column: 0, row: 3 }, { column: 2, row: 1 });
+
+    // Mirrored ray (0,4)->(2,2) arrives from the BL quadrant opposite the target cell's

+    expect(trace).toMatchObject({
+      tier: 'half',
+      blocksSight: true,
+      firstBlockingCell: { column: 1, row: 1 },
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('SAME_SIDE_ENDPOINT_GRAZE_CLEAR', () => {
+    const observer = normalProfile('same-side-endpoint-observer');
+    const blockers = [

+      { column: 2, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 },

function maximalMonsterSegment(state: EncounterState): readonly CombatantId[] {
  if (state.activeInitiativeIndex === null) return [];
  const actors: CombatantId[] = [];
  for (let index = state.activeInitiativeIndex; index < state.initiative.length; index += 1) {
    const initiative = state.initiative[index];
    if (initiative === undefined) throw new Error('Execution invariant encountered a missing initiative entry.');
    const combatant = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === initiative.combatant);
    if (combatant === undefined) throw new Error(`Execution invariant cannot find ${initiative.combatant}.`);
    if (combatant.life === 'dead') continue;
    if (combatant.profile.kind === 'player_character') break;
    actors.push(combatant.profile.id);
  }
  return actors;
}

function deterministicActivationChoice(option: EngineOfferableOption): EngineActivationChoice | undefined {
  const slot = option.activationChoice;
  if (slot === undefined || slot === null) return undefined;
  switch (slot.kind) {
    case 'command_word': return { kind: slot.kind, value: slot.values[0] };
    case 'unicorns_blessing_spell': return { kind: slot.kind, value: slot.values[0] };
    case 'dispel_evil_and_good_mode': return { kind: slot.kind, value: slot.values[0] };
    case 'calm_emotions_per_target': return {
      kind: slot.kind,
      selections: slot.targetIds.map((targetId) => ({ targetId, mode: slot.values[0] })),
    };
  }
}

function dryRunMonsterPlan(state: EncounterState): ReadonlyMap<CombatantId, AuthorizedEngineTurnProposal> {
  const actorIds = [...livingMonsterIds(state)].sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right));
  const planningState = projectFutureMonsterTurns(state, actorIds);
  return new Map(actorIds.map((actorId) => {
    const report = actorOpportunityReport(
      planningState,
      actorId,
      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
      state.revision,
    );
    const primary = report.defaultOption;
    const fallback = availableEngineActorOptions(
      planningState,
      actorId,
      OFFER_ENVIRONMENT,
      state.revision,
    ).find((option) => option.optionId !== primary.optionId);
    if (fallback === undefined) throw new Error(`Dry-run plan has no independent fallback for ${actorId}.`);
    const activationChoice = deterministicActivationChoice(primary);
    const proposal: EngineTurnProposal = {
      actorId,
      expectedRevision: state.revision,
      primaryOptionId: primary.optionId,
      fallbackOptionId: fallback.optionId,
      reason: 'Use the engine-ranked option to maximize immediate tactical value.',
      ...(activationChoice === undefined ? {} : { activationChoice }),
      overrideJustification: null,
    };
    const resolution = TURN_PROPOSAL_RESOLVER.resolve(planningState, proposal);
    if (!resolution.valid) {
      throw new Error(`Dry-run plan was refused for ${actorId}: ${resolution.refusals.map((entry) => entry.code).join(', ')}.`);
    }
    return [actorId, {
      proposal,
      option: resolution.option,
      primaryOption: resolution.primaryOption,
      fallbackOption: resolution.fallbackOption,
      mechanics: resolution.mechanics,

slotLevel: null,\n        castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 8, saveDc: 15, spellcastingModifier: 4,\n        targets: [target.id], area: null, weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n      }, () => 0);\n      return result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied')?.amount;\n    };\n    expect(amountFor('fire-resistance')).toBe(2);\n    expect(amountFor('fire-vulnerability')).toBe(10);\n  });\n\n  it('targeted_modifier_scope: a selected-attacker AC defense blocks that attacker but not a non-targeted source, unlike a blanket bonus', () => {\n    // Protection from Evil and Good scopes its defense by attacker source (spell-descriptions.txt:6337-6362).\n    const pack = packWithSpells([\n      { id: 'targeted-ward', operation: { kind: 'targeted_defense_modifier', against: 'selected_attacker', armorClassBonus: 3, duration: twoRounds } },\n      { id: 'blanket-ward', operation: { kind: 'armor_class_modifier', modification: { kind: 'bonus', amount: 3 }, duration: twoRounds } },\n    ]);\n    const warder = playerProfile('targeted-warder', { initiativeBonus: 40 });\n    const selected = playerProfile('targeted-selected', { initiativeBonus: 30 });\n    const outsider = playerProfile('targeted-outsider', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = playerProfile('targeted-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 20 });\n    let targeted = cast(started(pack, [warder, selected, outsider, target]), warder, target, 'targeted-ward', null, selected);\n    targeted = endTurn(targeted, warder);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(targeted, selected, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 })).events).attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n    targeted = endTurn(targeted, selected);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(targeted, outsider, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 })).events).attack.outcome).toBe('hit');\n\n    let blanket = cast(started(pack, [warder, selected, outsider, target]), warder, target, 'blanket-ward');\n    blanket = endTurn(blanket, warder);\n    blanket = endTurn(blanket, selected);\n    expect(attackEvent(attack(blanket, outsider, target, rngFaces({ face: 16, sides: 20 })).events).attack.outcome).toBe('miss');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/forms.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1724","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement form_assumed_and_stats_replaced: pack statblock supplies form HP, stats, speed, senses, and actions while identity and original HP persist"},{"id":"1725","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement carryover_lost and carryover_boundary_exact_vs_one_over: exactly the remaining form HP reverts without original damage; one over carries exactly one"},{"id":"1726","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement original_hp_touched_in_form and revert_keeps_form_stats: partial form damage drains only the form pool and effect-end reversion differs from zero-HP reversion"},{"id":"1727","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement form_actions_and_casting_restriction: only an unchanged statblock attack is legal and spellcasting is refused"},{"id":"1728","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement merged_equipment_is_unavailable: worn and carried shape with the form and cannot be interacted with"},{"id":"1729","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement declared_stat_override_and_drop: a pack can declare the replacement block and drop equipment at the origin"},{"id":"1730","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement unknown_form_id_transforms: rejects only the missing-id form record and loads the rest of the pack"},{"id":"1731","name":"D348.1 imported form and stat replacement true_polymorph_and_object_transformation_refusals: unsupported permanence and object-to-creature shapes have named reasons"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  availableFormActions,\n  canCombatantSee,\n  createEncounter,\n  EquipmentRuleError,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport {\n  FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n  type BranchSpellOperation,\n  type SpellCastCommand,\n} from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, itemId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  importedMonsterAttackCommand,\n  loadContentPack,\n  OBJECT_TO_CREATURE_REFUSAL,\n  TRUE_POLYMORPH_PERMANENCE_REFUSAL,\n  type LoadedContentPack,\n} from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst { readText: readFileSync } = declareTestInputs({\n  fixtures: ['tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json'],\n}).fixtures;\n\ninterface MutableFormsPack {\n  packId: string;\n  spells: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  items: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  monsters: Array<{\n    recordId: string;\n    name: string;\n    statblock: Record<string, unknown>;\n    actions: unknown[];\n  }>;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nconst FORM_ITEM = itemId('greenforge:shape-knife');\n\nfunction sourcePack(): MutableFormsPack {\n  const source = JSON.parse(readFileSync('tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json', 'utf8')) as MutableFormsPack;\n  source.packId = 'forms-fixture';\n  const monster = source.monsters[0];\n  if (monster === undefined) throw new Error('Forms fixture has no monster statblock.');\n  monster.statblock.speedFeet = 40;\n  monster.statblock.senses = [\n    { kind: 'normal_sight' },\n    { kind: 'blindsight', rangeFeet: 30 },\n  ];\n  source.items = [{\n    sourceId: 'greenforge', recordId: 'shape-knife', name: 'Shape Knife',\n    materials: [{ kind: 'other', name: 'bone' }],\n    equip: { kind: 'held', handCapacity: 1, droppable: true },\n  }];\n  return source;\n}\n\nfunction packMonsterOperation(\n  equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form' | 'dropped_at_origin' = 'merged_into_form',\n): Extract<BranchSpellOperation, { readonly kind: 'form_replacement' }> {\n  return {\n    kind: 'form_replacement',\n    form: { kind: 'pack_monster', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote' },\n    retainedStatistics: FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n    hitPoints: 'temporary_form_pool',\n    equipmentDisposition,\n    actionAccess: 'form_statblock_only',\n    spellcasting: 'prohibited',\n    lifecycle: { concentration: true, durationRounds: 10, expiresAt: 'source_start' },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction statOverrideOperation(): Extract<BranchSpellOperation, { readonly kind: 'form_replacement' }> {\n  return {\n    ...packMonsterOperation('dropped_at_origin'),\n    form: {\n      kind: 'stat_override',\n      stats: {\n        id: 'mist-hound', name: 'Mist Hound', armorClass: 13, hitPointMaximum: 7,\n        speedFeet: 45, initiativeBonus: 3,\n        savingThrowBonuses: {\n          strength: 2, dexterity: 3, constitution: 1,\n          intelligence: -2, wisdom: 2, charisma: -1,\n        },\n        attacksPerAction: 1, reachFeet: 5,\n        damageResponses: [{ type: 'Cold', response: 'resistant' }],\n        conditionImmunities: ['Prone'],\n        senses: [{ kind: 'normal_sight' }, { kind: 'truesight', rangeFeet: 20 }],\n        actions: [{\n          kind: 'attack', id: 'mist-bite', name: 'Mist Bite', attackBonus: 5,\n          delivery: { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: 5 },\n          damage: [{\n            average: 5, dice: { count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 1 }, type: 'Cold',\n            trigger: { kind: 'always' },\n          }],\n          attackRollAdvantage: null, onHit: [],\n        }],\n      },\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction formSpell(source: MutableFormsPack, operation: unknown, recordId = 'assume-brassleaf'): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const template = source.spells[0];\n  if (template === undefined) throw new Error('Forms fixture has no spell template.');\n  return {\n    ...template,\n    recordId,\n    name: recordId,\n    level: 1,\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', rounds: 10 },\n    concentration: true,\n    targeting: { kind: 'single', rangeFeet: 30, willing: true },\n    operation,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction loadedFormsPack(operation: unknown = packMonsterOperation()): LoadedContentPack {\n  const source = sourcePack();\n  source.spells = [formSpell(source, operation)];\n  const result = loadContentPack(source);\n  if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Forms pack refused: ${result.refusal.reason}`);\n  expect(result.content.diagnostics).toEqual([]);\n  return result.content;\n}\n\ninterface FormsEncounter {\n  readonly content: LoadedContentPack;\n  readonly caster: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly target: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly enemy: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n}\n\nfunction started(operation: unknown = packMonsterOperation()): FormsEncounter {\n  const content = loadedFormsPack(operation);\n  const caster = playerProfile('forms-caster', {\n    initiativeBonus: 20, spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 4 }],\n  });\n  const target = playerProfile('forms-target', {\n    hitPoints: 20, initiativeBonus: 10, spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n  });\n  const enemy = playerProfile('forms-enemy', { hitPoints: 30, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 10, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [caster, target, enemy],\n    tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(target, 1), placedToken(enemy, 2)],\n    contentPacks: [content],\n    equipment: [{\n      combatant: target.id,\n      hands: { kind: 'one_handed', items: [FORM_ITEM] },\n      worn: [], carried: [],\n    }],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { content, caster, target, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction cast(subject: FormsEncounter): EncounterState {\n  const command: SpellCastCommand = {\n    type: 'cast_spell', actor: subject.caster.id, spellId: 'greenforge:assume-brassleaf',\n    slotLevel: 1, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 6, saveDc: 14,\n    spellcastingModifier: 3, targets: [subject.target.id], area: null,\n    weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n  };\n  return reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0).state;\n}\n\nfunction fixedDamage(subject: FormsEncounter, state: EncounterState, amount: number): ReturnType<typeof reduceEncounter> {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'force_save', actor: subject.caster.id, target: subject.target.id,\n    ability: 'dexterity', dc: 30, rollMode: 'normal',\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: amount } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n    onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n  }, () => 0);\n}\n\nfunction targetState(state: EncounterState, target: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === target.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error('Forms target is absent from encounter state.');\n  return found;\n}\n\ndescribe('D348.1 imported form and stat replacement', () => {\n  it('form_assumed_and_stats_replaced: pack statblock supplies form HP, stats, speed, senses, and actions while identity and original HP persist', () => {\n    // Replaced statistics and retained continuity: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5952-5963.\n    const subject = started();\n    const before = targetState(subject.state, subject.target);\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    const after = targetState(transformed, subject.target);\n\n    expect(after.form).toMatchObject({\n      formId: 'greenforge:brassleaf-mote', formName: 'Brassleaf Mote',\n      hitPoints: 9, hitPointMaximum: 9,\n      retainedStatistics: FORM_REPLACEMENT_RETAINED_STATISTICS,\n      equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form', spellcasting: 'prohibited',\n    });\n    expect(after.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(after.profile.name).toBe(before.profile.name);\n    expect(after.profile.rules).toMatchObject({ armorClass: 12, speed: 40, initiativeBonus: 1 });\n    expect(availableFormActions(transformed, subject.target.id)?.map(({ id }) => id))\n      .toEqual(['attack:brassleaf-tap']);\n\n    const enemyCell = transformed.tokens.find(({ combatantId }) => combatantId === subject.enemy.id)?.position;\n    if (enemyCell === undefined) throw new Error('Forms enemy has no token.');\n    const dark = {\n      ...transformed,\n      environment: {\n        ...transformed.environment,\n        lightRegions: [{ id: 'form-sense-darkness', cells: [enemyCell], level: 'darkness' as const }],\n      },\n    };\n    const originalDark = { ...subject.state, environment: dark.environment };\n    expect(canCombatantSee(originalDark, subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id)).toBe(false);\n    expect(canCombatantSee(dark, subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('carryover_lost and carryover_boundary_exact_vs_one_over: exactly the remaining form HP reverts without original damage; one over carries exactly one', () => {\n    // Form THP ends the spell: spell-descriptions.txt:5958-5963. Leftover damage\n    // carries to actual HP: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:1126-1131.\n    const exactSubject = started();\n    const exact = fixedDamage(exactSubject, cast(exactSubject), 9);\n    const exactTarget = targetState(exact.state, exactSubject.target);\n    expect(exactTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(exactTarget.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(exact.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'effect_ended', reason: 'form_hit_points_depleted',\n    }));\n\n    const overSubject = started();\n    const over = fixedDamage(overSubject, cast(overSubject), 10);\n    const overTarget = targetState(over.state, overSubject.target);\n    expect(overTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(overTarget.hitPoints).toBe(19);\n  });\n\n  it('original_hp_touched_in_form and revert_keeps_form_stats: partial form damage drains only the form pool and effect-end reversion differs from zero-HP reversion', () => {\n    const subject = started();\n    const partial = fixedDamage(subject, cast(subject), 4).state;\n    expect(targetState(partial, subject.target)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 20,\n      form: { hitPoints: 5, hitPointMaximum: 9 },\n    });\n\n    const ended = reduceEncounter(partial, {\n      type: 'end_concentration', actor: subject.caster.id,\n    }, () => 0);\n    const endedTarget = targetState(ended.state, subject.target);\n    expect(endedTarget.hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(endedTarget.form).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(endedTarget.profile.rules).toMatchObject({ armorClass: 14, speed: 30 });\n    expect(ended.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'effect_ended', reason: 'concentration_ended',\n    }));\n    expect(ended.events.some((event) =>\n      event.type === 'effect_ended' && event.reason === 'form_hit_points_depleted')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('form_actions_and_casting_restriction: only an unchanged statblock attack is legal and spellcasting is refused', () => {\n    // Form anatomy and casting restriction: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5965-5967.\n    const subject = started();\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n      type: 'cast_spell', actor: subject.target.id, spellId: 'greenforge:assume-brassleaf',\n      slotLevel: 1, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 5, attackBonus: 5, saveDc: 13,\n      spellcastingModifier: 2, targets: [subject.target.id], area: null,\n      weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n    }, () => 0)).toThrow('cannot cast spells in its current form');\n\n    let targetTurn = reduceEncounter(transformed, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(targetTurn, {\n      type: 'attack', actor: subject.target.id, target: subject.enemy.id,\n      attackBonus: 4, criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal',\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Bludgeoning'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5)).toThrow('must use an attack from form');\n\n    const monster = subject.content.monsters.find(({ recordId }) => recordId === 'brassleaf-mote');\n    if (monster === undefined) throw new Error('Loaded form monster is missing.');\n    targetTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      targetTurn,\n      importedMonsterAttackCommand(monster, 'attack:brassleaf-tap', subject.target.id, subject.enemy.id),\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(targetState(targetTurn, subject.enemy).hitPoints).toBeLessThan(30);\n  });\n\n  it('merged_equipment_is_unavailable: worn and carried shape with the form and cannot be interacted with', () => {\n    // Polymorph gear melds and provides no benefit: docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:5971-5973.\n    const subject = started();\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(transformed.equipment?.find(({ combatant }) => combatant === subject.target.id)?.hands)\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'one_handed', items: [FORM_ITEM] });\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n      type: 'drop_item', actor: subject.target.id, item: FORM_ITEM, interaction: 'free',\n    }, () => 0)).toThrow(EquipmentRuleError);\n    try {\n      reduceEncounter(transformed, {\n        type: 'drop_item', actor: subject.target.id, item: FORM_ITEM, interaction: 'free',\n      }, () => 0);\n      expect.fail('Merged form equipment unexpectedly remained interactable.');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toMatchObject({ code: 'form_equipment_unavailable' });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('declared_stat_override_and_drop: a pack can declare the replacement block and drop equipment at the origin', () => {\n    const subject = started(statOverrideOperation());\n    const transformed = cast(subject);\n    expect(targetState(transformed, subject.target)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 20,\n      form: { formId: 'mist-hound', hitPoints: 7, equipmentDisposition: 'dropped_at_origin' },\n      profile: { rules: { armorClass: 13, speed: 45 } },\n    });\n    expect(transformed.equipment?.find(({ combatant }) => combatant === subject.target.id)?.hands)\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'empty' });\n    expect(transformed.groundItems).toContainEqual({ item: FORM_ITEM, position: { column: 1, row: 0 } });\n    expect(transformed.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'item_dropped', item: FORM_ITEM, cause: 'form_replacement',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_form_id_transforms: rejects only the missing-id form record and loads the rest of the pack', () => {\n    const source = sourcePack();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    const missing = {\n      ...packMonsterOperation(),\n      form: { kind: 'pack_monster', monsterId: 'absent-form' },\n    };\n    source.spells = [healthy, formSpell(source, missing, 'missing-form')];\n    const loaded = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Missing form record unexpectedly refused the pack envelope.');\n    expect(loaded.content.spells.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(loaded.content.monsters.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['brassleaf-mote']);\n    expect(loaded.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'missing_form_reference', recordId: 'missing-form',\n      monsterId: 'greenforge:absent-form',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('true_polymorph_and_object_transformation_refusals: unsupported permanence and object-to-creature shapes have named reasons', () => {\n    const source = sourcePack();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    source.spells = [\n      healthy,\n      formSpell(source, { kind: 'true_polymorph_permanence' }, 'permanent-form'),\n      formSpell(source, { kind: 'object_to_creature_transformation' }, 'object-creature'),\n    ];\n    const loaded = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Named form refusals unexpectedly refused the pack envelope.');\n    expect(loaded.content.spells.map(({ recordId }) => recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(loaded.content.diagnostics).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      expect.objectContaining({ reason: TRUE_POLYMORPH_PERMANENCE_REFUSAL, recordId: 'permanent-form' }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ reason: OBJECT_TO_CREATURE_REFUSAL, recordId: 'object-creature' }),\n    ]));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/turn-exhaustion-coordinator.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1732","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator authorizes an initial declared fallback and journals the selected fallback"},{"id":"1733","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator dispatches exactly one proposal correction and accepts its complete proposal"},{"id":"1734","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator marks deterministic controller output auto-resolved after the correction returns no proposal"},{"id":"1735","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator pauses for DM adjudication instead of skipping when the deterministic controller fails"},{"id":"1736","name":"host turn exhaustion coordinator reconstructs a browser resume mid-chain without dispatching a second correction"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport {\n  agentSessionId,\n  encounterBranchId,\n  encounterSessionId,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { AgentSessionLifecycle } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session-lifecycle';\nimport type { RoundTurnProposalEnvelope } from '../../../src/vtt/engine-envelopes';\nimport { engineActionId, engineOptionId } from '../../../src/vtt/turn-proposal';\nimport {\n  createEngineStateCapsule,\n  projectEngineDmProjection,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/engine-state-capsule';\nimport { engineActionRegistry } from '../../../src/vtt/engine-query-port';\nimport { projectDmBoard } from '../../../src/vtt/encounter-projections';\nimport { referenceEncounterSetup } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter';\nimport {\n  EncounterSessionJournal,\n  MemoryBrowserSessionStore,\n  MemoryMirrorSink,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/session-persistence';\nimport {\n  MAX_PROPOSAL_CORRECTIONS,\n  TurnExhaustionCoordinator,\n  type AutoResolvedProposalMark,\n  type DeterministicProposalResolution,\n  type ProposalFallbackResult,\n  type TurnExhaustionCorrectionRuntime,\n  type TurnExhaustionHost,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/turn-exhaustion-coordinator';\nimport { SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter } from '../../fixtures/simulated-agent-session-adapter';\n\nconst INITIAL_COORDINATOR_STATE = {\n  requestSequence: 1,\n  pendingRequest: null,\n  pendingCommand: null,\n  continuation: { kind: 'idle' as const },\n  pause: null,\n};\n\nfunction fixture() {\n  const state = createEncounter(referenceEncounterSetup());\n  const actor = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.kind === 'monster')?.profile.id;\n  if (actor === undefined) throw new Error('Exhaustion fixture needs a monster.');\n  const sessionId = encounterSessionId('session:turn-exhaustion');\n  const branchId = encounterBranchId('branch:turn-exhaustion');\n  const store = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n  const journal = EncounterSessionJournal.create({\n    sessionId,\n    branchId,\n    encounterState: state,\n    coordinatorState: INITIAL_COORDINATOR_STATE,\n    controllers: [],\n    rng: mulberry32(398_399),\n    store,\n    mirror: new MemoryMirrorSink(),\n  });\n  journal.startAgentSession({\n    cli: 'codex',\n    sessionId: agentSessionId('agent-session:turn-exhaustion'),\n    adapterVersion: 4,\n  });\n  const projection = projectDmBoard({\n    view: { audience: 'dm', state },\n    coordinator: INITIAL_COORDINATOR_STATE,\n    controllers: [],\n    history: journal.history(),\n  });\n  const capsule = createEngineStateCapsule({\n    runId: sessionId,\n    branchId,\n    revision: 3,\n    generatedAt: '2026-08-27T18:00:00.000Z',\n    request: {\n      requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n      phase: 'correction',\n      correctionNumber: MAX_PROPOSAL_CORRECTIONS,\n      actors: [actor],\n    },\n    projection: projectEngineDmProjection(projection, engineActionRegistry(state), 1),\n  });\n  return { actor, branchId, capsule, journal, sessionId, state, store };\n}\n\nfunction proposal(\n  f: ReturnType<typeof fixture>,\n  phase: 'initial' | 'correction',\n  selectedBranch: 'primary' | 'fallback',\n  proposalId = `proposal:${phase}`,\n): RoundTurnProposalEnvelope {\n  const primaryOption = {\n    optionId: engineOptionId(`option:${phase}:primary`), actorId: f.actor, revision: f.state.revision,\n    label: 'Dodge',\n    movement: { preference: { willingness: 'none' as const, maximumFeet: 0, opportunityRisk: 'avoid' as const }, engagement: { stance: 'hold_position' as const } },\n    actionSlots: [{ slot: 'main' as const, use: { kind: 'dodge' as const } }], resourceCostLabels: [],\n  };\n  const fallbackOption = selectedBranch === 'fallback'\n    ? { ...primaryOption, optionId: engineOptionId(`option:${phase}:fallback`), label: 'End Turn', actionSlots: [{ slot: 'main' as const, use: { kind: 'end_turn' as const } }] }\n    : null;\n  const selectedOption = fallbackOption ?? primaryOption;\n  const turnProposal = {\n    actorId: f.actor, expectedRevision: f.state.revision, primaryOptionId: primaryOption.optionId,\n    fallbackOptionId: fallbackOption?.optionId ?? null, overrideJustification: null,\n  };\n  return {\n    kind: 'round_turn_proposal',\n    proposalId,\n    runId: f.sessionId,\n    branchId: f.branchId,\n    requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n    expectedRevision: phase === 'initial' ? 2 : f.capsule.revision,\n    stateDigest: f.capsule.digest,\n    stateHandle: 'engine-state:test',\n    phase,\n    idempotencyKey: `idempotency:${phase}:0001`,\n    reactionGuidance: null,\n    resolutions: [{\n      proposal: turnProposal,\n      option: selectedOption,\n      primaryOption,\n      fallbackOption,\n      mechanics: {\n        actorId: f.actor, optionId: selectedOption.optionId, movementCostFeet: 0, path: [],\n        finalPosition: { column: 0, row: 0 },\n        actionSlots: [{ slot: 'main', kind: selectedBranch === 'fallback' ? 'end_turn' : 'dodge', actionId: engineActionId(selectedBranch === 'fallback' ? 'end_turn' : 'dodge'), spellId: null, targetIds: [], objectId: null }],\n      },\n      selectedBranch,\n      resolutionDigest: 'a'.repeat(64),\n      summary: 'The monster dodges.',\n    }],\n  };\n}\n\nfunction runtime(\n  f: ReturnType<typeof fixture>,\n  adapter: SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter,\n  queued: RoundTurnProposalEnvelope[],\n  activated: { value: number },\n): TurnExhaustionCorrectionRuntime {\n  return {\n    capsule: f.capsule,\n    rules: { get: () => null },\n    turnContext: { request: { phase: 'correction', correction_number: 1 } },\n    lifecycle: new AgentSessionLifecycle(f.journal, adapter, 4),\n    invocation: {\n      runId: f.sessionId,\n      prompt: 'must be replaced',\n      model: 'SIMULATED-model',\n      reasoningEffort: 'SIMULATED-effort',\n      launcherToken: 'SIMULATED-launcher-token',\n      timeoutMs: null,\n    },\n    signal: new AbortController().signal,\n    activateCapsule: () => { activated.value += 1; },\n    takeProposal: () => queued.shift() ?? null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction host(input: {\n  readonly authorization?: 'authorized' | 'invalidated' | 'invalid';\n  readonly deterministic?: DeterministicProposalResolution | null;\n  readonly marks?: AutoResolvedProposalMark[];\n  readonly adjudications?: string[];\n} = {}): TurnExhaustionHost {\n  return {\n    authorize: async () => input.authorization ?? 'authorized',\n    resolveDeterministically: async (actorId) => input.deterministic === undefined\n      ? { actorId, expectedRevision: 3, resolutionDigest: 'b'.repeat(64) }\n      : input.deterministic,\n    applyAutoResolved: async (_resolution, mark) => { input.marks?.push(mark); },\n    pauseForDmAdjudication: ({ actorId }) => { input.adjudications?.push(actorId); },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction exhausted(f: ReturnType<typeof fixture>, fallbackResult: ProposalFallbackResult = 'invalid') {\n  return {\n    kind: 'exhausted' as const,\n    requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n    initialProposalId: 'proposal:initial-attempt',\n    actorFailures: [{ actorId: f.actor, fallbackResult }],\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('host turn exhaustion coordinator', () => {\n  it('authorizes an initial declared fallback and journals the selected fallback', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] });\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: { kind: 'proposal', proposal: proposal(f, 'initial', 'fallback') },\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host(),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'authorized', proposalId: 'proposal:initial', phase: 'initial' });\n\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(0);\n    expect(f.journal.history().map((entry) => entry.transition.kind)).toContain('proposal_fallback_resolved');\n  });\n\n  it('dispatches exactly one proposal correction and accepts its complete proposal', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const queued: RoundTurnProposalEnvelope[] = [];\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({\n      startIds: [],\n      onResume: () => { queued.push(proposal(f, 'correction', 'primary')); },\n    });\n    const activated = { value: 0 };\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f),\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, queued, activated),\n      host: host(),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'authorized', proposalId: 'proposal:correction', phase: 'correction' });\n\n    expect(activated.value).toBe(1);\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations[0]?.invocation.prompt).toContain('Correct the complete refused proposal request once.');\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations[0]?.invocation.prompt).toContain('fallback_option_id must be null');\n    expect(f.journal.history().map((entry) => entry.transition.kind)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      'proposal_correction_requested',\n      'agent_session_dispatched',\n      'proposal_correction_resolved',\n    ]));\n  });\n\n  it('marks deterministic controller output auto-resolved after the correction returns no proposal', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] });\n    const marks: AutoResolvedProposalMark[] = [];\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f, 'absent'),\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host({ marks }),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'auto_resolved', actorIds: [f.actor] });\n\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(marks).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      actorId: f.actor,\n      fallbackResult: 'absent',\n      correctionResult: 'no_response',\n      controllerResolutionDigest: 'b'.repeat(64),\n    })]);\n    expect(coordinator.reconstruct('request:exhaustion')).toEqual({\n      requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n      stage: 'auto_resolved',\n      correctionNumber: 1,\n      autoResolvedActorIds: [f.actor],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('pauses for DM adjudication instead of skipping when the deterministic controller fails', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const adjudications: string[] = [];\n    const coordinator = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    await expect(coordinator.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f),\n      correction: runtime(f, new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] }), [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host({ deterministic: null, adjudications }),\n    })).resolves.toEqual({ kind: 'awaiting_dm_adjudication', actorId: f.actor });\n\n    expect(adjudications).toEqual([f.actor]);\n    expect(f.journal.history().map((entry) => entry.transition.kind)).toContain('proposal_auto_resolution_failed');\n  });\n\n  it('reconstructs a browser resume mid-chain without dispatching a second correction', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    f.journal.recordHostTransition({\n      kind: 'proposal_correction_requested',\n      requestId: 'request:exhaustion',\n      initialProposalId: 'proposal:initial-attempt',\n      correctionNumber: 1,\n      actorFailures: [{ actorId: f.actor, fallbackResult: 'invalid' }],\n    });\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: [] });\n    const marks: AutoResolvedProposalMark[] = [];\n    const resumed = new TurnExhaustionCoordinator(f.journal.turnExhaustionPersistence());\n\n    expect(resumed.reconstruct('request:exhaustion')?.stage).toBe('correction_requested');\n    await resumed.coordinate({\n      initial: exhausted(f),\n      correction: runtime(f, adapter, [], { value: 0 }),\n      host: host({ marks }),\n    });\n\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations).toHaveLength(0);\n    expect(f.journal.history().filter((entry) =>\n      entry.transition.kind === 'proposal_correction_requested')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(marks).toHaveLength(1);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/controller-assignment.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1737","name":"DM controller assignment assigns an algorithm controller durably and drives its turn without a human prompt"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  ControllerAssignmentError,\n  DmEncounterHost,\n  type DmEncounterHostSnapshot,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-encounter-host';\nimport { REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter';\nimport { MemoryBrowserSessionStore } from '../../../src/vtt/session-persistence';\n\nasync function settle(): Promise<void> {\n  await Promise.resolve();\n  await Promise.resolve();\n}\n\nfunction waitForSnapshot(\n  host: DmEncounterHost,\n  predicate: (snapshot: DmEncounterHostSnapshot) => boolean,\n): Promise<DmEncounterHostSnapshot> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {\n      unsubscribe();\n      reject(new Error('Timed out waiting for the controller assignment outcome.'));\n    }, 1_000);\n    const unsubscribe = host.subscribe((snapshot) => {\n      if (!predicate(snapshot)) return;\n      clearTimeout(timeout);\n      unsubscribe();\n      resolve(snapshot);\n    });\n  });\n}\n\ndescribe('DM controller assignment', () => {\n  it('assigns an algorithm controller durably and drives its turn without a human prompt', async () => {\n    const host = new DmEncounterHost(\n      'session:controller-assignment-algorithm',\n      new MemoryBrowserSessionStore(),\n    );\n\n    void host.start();\n    await settle();\n    expect(host.snapshot().dm.pendingRequest?.actorId).toBe(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID);\n    expect(() => host.replaceController(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID, 'algorithm')).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<ControllerAssignmentError>>({\n        name: 'ControllerAssignmentError',\n        code: 'action_boundary_required',\n      }),\n    );\n\n    host.interrupt();\n    await settle();\n    host.replaceController(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID, 'algorithm');\n\n    expect(host.snapshot().dm.controllers).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      combatantId: REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID,\n      kind: 'algorithm',\n    }));\n\n    const revisionBeforeResume = host.snapshot().dm.encounter.revision;\n    host.resume();\n    const driven = await waitForSnapshot(\n      host,\n      (snapshot) => snapshot.dm.encounter.revision > revisionBeforeResume,\n    );\n\n    expect(driven.dm.pendingRequest?.actorId).not.toBe(REFERENCE_FIGHTER_ID);\n    host.close();\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/summons.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1738","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_skips_initiative: loads the pack statblock and inserts each upcast summon on the summoner count immediately after them"},{"id":"1739","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_count_boundary_and_placement_edge: exact count and 30-foot edge place; one over and an illegal cell refuse atomically"},{"id":"1740","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_survives_effect_end and despawn_leaves_corpse: concentration end removes a living summon and a dead summon corpse token"},{"id":"1741","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities despawn_before_active_preserves_turn_identity_and_advances_to_the_next_combatant"},{"id":"1742","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities distinguishing_despawn_vs_death_and_enemy_target: a summon is allied to its summoner, hostile to the enemy, and remains targetable after taking lethal damage"},{"id":"1743","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities unknown_monster_id_summons: rejects only a summon spell whose monster id is absent and loads the rest of the pack"},{"id":"1744","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summon_import_count_boundary: accepts 100 and rejects 101 without dropping healthy monster records"},{"id":"1745","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities on_kill_spawn_refusal: names the excluded on-kill spawning shape instead of treating it as this summon operation"},{"id":"1746","name":"D348.1 imported summoned entities summoner_controller_seam: the summoned turn is requested from the exact controller that cast the spell"}],"source":"import { readFileSync } from '../../helpers/test-filesystem';\nimport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { Controller, ControllerDecision, ControllerRequest } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { ControllerRegistry } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport {\n  combatantsAreAllies,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  SUMMON_INITIATIVE_RULE,\n  TargetSelectionRuleError,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { SpellCastCommand } from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { loadContentPack, type LoadedContentPack } from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ninterface MutablePackFixture {\n  spells: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  monsters: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nconst summonOperation = (\n  count: { readonly kind: 'fixed'; readonly count: number } | {\n    readonly kind: 'slot_scaled'; readonly base: number; readonly additionalPerSlot: number;\n  } = { kind: 'fixed', count: 1 },\n) => ({\n  kind: 'summon', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote',\n  count: count.kind === 'fixed' ? count : { ...count, limit: 'exact' },\n  placementRangeFeet: 30,\n  lifecycle: { concentration: true, durationRounds: 10, expiresAt: 'source_start' },\n});\n\nfunction fixture(): MutablePackFixture {\n  return JSON.parse(readFileSync('tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json', 'utf8')) as MutablePackFixture;\n}\n\nfunction packWithOperation(operation: unknown): ReturnType<typeof loadContentPack> {\n  const source = fixture();\n  const template = source.spells[0];\n  if (template === undefined) throw new Error('Summon fixture spell template is missing.');\n  source.spells = [{\n    ...template,\n    recordId: 'call-brassleaf',\n    name: 'Call Brassleaf',\n    level: 2,\n    range: { kind: 'feet', feet: 30 },\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', rounds: 10 },\n    concentration: true,\n    targeting: { kind: 'utility', rangeFeet: 30 },\n    operation,\n  }];\n  return loadContentPack(source);\n}\n\nfunction loadedPack(operation: unknown = summonOperation()): LoadedContentPack {\n  const result = packWithOperation(operation);\n  if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Summon pack refused: ${result.refusal.reason}`);\n  expect(result.content.diagnostics).toEqual([]);\n  return result.content;\n}\n\nfunction summonCommand(\n  caster: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n  destinations: NonNullable<SpellCastCommand['summonDestinations']>,\n  slotLevel = 2,\n): SpellCastCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'cast_spell', actor: caster.id, spellId: 'greenforge:call-brassleaf',\n    slotLevel, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 7, attackBonus: 7, saveDc: 15,\n    spellcastingModifier: 4, targets: [], area: null, summonDestinations: destinations,\n    weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(\n  content: LoadedContentPack,\n  spellSlots: readonly { readonly level: 2 | 3; readonly maximum: number }[] = [{ level: 2, maximum: 2 }],\n): { readonly caster: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>; readonly enemy: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>; readonly state: EncounterState } {\n  const caster = playerProfile('summoner', { initiativeBonus: 20, spellSlots });\n  const enemy = monsterProfile('summon-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [caster, enemy], tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(enemy, 10)],\n    contentPacks: [content],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { caster, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction summonedId(state: EncounterState): CombatantId {\n  const id = state.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? [])[0];\n  if (id === undefined) throw new Error('Expected an effect-owned summoned combatant.');\n  return id;\n}\n\ndescribe('D348.1 imported summoned entities', () => {\n  it('summon_skips_initiative: loads the pack statblock and inserts each upcast summon on the summoner count immediately after them', () => {\n    // Giant Insect shares the caster's count and acts immediately after them:\n    // docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:3714-3716.\n    expect(SUMMON_INITIATIVE_RULE).toBe('summoner_count_immediately_after');\n    const content = loadedPack(summonOperation({ kind: 'slot_scaled', base: 1, additionalPerSlot: 1 }));\n    const fixtureState = started(content, [{ level: 3, maximum: 1 }]);\n    const cast = reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ], 3), () => 0).state;\n    const summons = cast.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? []);\n\n    expect(summons).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(cast.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([\n      fixtureState.caster.id, ...summons, fixtureState.enemy.id,\n    ]);\n    expect(cast.initiative.slice(0, 3).map((entry) => ({ total: entry.total, slot: entry.slot })))\n      .toEqual([{ total: 21, slot: 0 }, { total: 21, slot: 0 }, { total: 21, slot: 0 }]);\n    for (const id of summons) {\n      const summon = cast.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === id);\n      expect(summon).toMatchObject({\n        hitPoints: 9,\n        profile: {\n          name: 'Brassleaf Mote', statblockId: 'greenforge:brassleaf-mote',\n          rules: { armorClass: 12, speed: 30 },\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('summon_count_boundary_and_placement_edge: exact count and 30-foot edge place; one over and an illegal cell refuse atomically', () => {\n    const content = loadedPack(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 2 }));\n    const fixtureState = started(content);\n    const exact = reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0);\n    expect(exact.state.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? [])).toHaveLength(2);\n\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 }, { column: 4, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0)).toThrow(TargetSelectionRuleError);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 7, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0)).toThrow('summon destination is out of range');\n    expect(fixtureState.state.combatants).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n\n  it('summon_survives_effect_end and despawn_leaves_corpse: concentration end removes a living summon and a dead summon corpse token', () => {\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    const cast = reduceEncounter(\n      fixtureState.state,\n      summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(cast);\n    const dead = reduceEncounter(cast, {\n      type: 'adjudicate', target: summon, subject: 'lethal test damage', reasoning: 'fixture',\n      consequence: { kind: 'hit_point_delta', amount: -9 },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(dead.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)?.life).toBe('dead');\n    expect(dead.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(true);\n    const despawned = reduceEncounter(dead, { type: 'end_concentration', actor: fixtureState.caster.id }, () => 0);\n    expect(despawned.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'summoned_combatant_despawned', combatant: summon,\n    }));\n    expect(despawned.state.combatants.some((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)).toBe(false);\n    expect(despawned.state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('despawn_before_active_preserves_turn_identity_and_advances_to_the_next_combatant', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('shift-summoner', {\n      initiativeBonus: 20,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const activeEnemy = monsterProfile('shift-active-enemy', { initiativeBonus: 0, hitPoints: 30 });\n    const nextEnemy = monsterProfile('shift-next-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -10, hitPoints: 30 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [caster, activeEnemy, nextEnemy],\n      tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(activeEnemy, 10), placedToken(nextEnemy, 11)],\n      contentPacks: [loadedPack()],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      summonCommand(caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(state);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: summon }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(activeEnemy.id);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'force_save', actor: activeEnemy.id, target: caster.id,\n      ability: 'dexterity', dc: 30, rollMode: 'normal',\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 1 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n      onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n    }, () => 0).state;\n\n    expect(state.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([\n      caster.id, activeEnemy.id, nextEnemy.id,\n    ]);\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(activeEnemy.id);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: activeEnemy.id }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(nextEnemy.id);\n  });\n\n  it('distinguishing_despawn_vs_death_and_enemy_target: a summon is allied to its summoner, hostile to the enemy, and remains targetable after taking lethal damage', () => {\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    let state = reduceEncounter(\n      fixtureState.state,\n      summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(state);\n    expect(combatantsAreAllies(state, fixtureState.caster.id, summon)).toBe(true);\n    expect(combatantsAreAllies(state, fixtureState.enemy.id, summon)).toBe(false);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixtureState.caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: summon }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack', actor: fixtureState.enemy.id, target: summon, attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal', attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 9 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)?.life).toBe('dead');\n    expect(state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_monster_id_summons: rejects only a summon spell whose monster id is absent and loads the rest of the pack', () => {\n    const source = fixture();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    source.spells = [healthy, {\n      ...healthy, recordId: 'missing-summon', name: 'Missing Summon', level: 2,\n      targeting: { kind: 'utility', rangeFeet: 30 },\n      operation: { ...summonOperation(), monsterId: 'absent-monster' },\n    }];\n    const result = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(result.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Record-isolated load unexpectedly refused the pack.');\n    expect(result.content.spells.map((spell) => spell.recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(result.content.monsters.map((monster) => monster.recordId)).toEqual(['brassleaf-mote']);\n    expect(result.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'missing_monster_reference', recordId: 'missing-summon',\n      monsterId: 'greenforge:absent-monster',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('summon_import_count_boundary: accepts 100 and rejects 101 without dropping healthy monster records', () => {\n    expect(packWithOperation(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 100 })).status).toBe('loaded');\n    const over = packWithOperation(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 101 }));\n    expect(over.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (over.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('One malformed spell should not refuse its pack.');\n    expect(over.content.spells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(over.content.monsters).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(over.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ reason: 'malformed_record' }));\n  });\n\n  it('on_kill_spawn_refusal: names the excluded on-kill spawning shape instead of treating it as this summon operation', () => {\n    const result = packWithOperation({\n      kind: 'on_kill_spawn', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote', trigger: 'creature_killed',\n    });\n    expect(result.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Excluded operation should reject its record only.');\n    expect(result.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'on-kill-spawn-not-modelled', recordId: 'call-brassleaf',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('summoner_controller_seam: the summoned turn is requested from the exact controller that cast the spell', async () => {\n    class RecordingController implements Controller {\n      readonly actors: CombatantId[] = [];\n      choose(request: ControllerRequest): Promise<ControllerDecision> {\n        this.actors.push(request.actorId);\n        const action = request.legalActions.actions[0];\n        if (action === undefined) throw new Error('Recording controller received no legal action.');\n        return Promise.resolve({\n          requestId:
