matrix healing a dying death-save user restores living state without implementing death-save rolls"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, effectStackingIdentity } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst force = damageType('Force');\n\nfunction damage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{ type: force, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount } }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\nfunction attack(\n  actor: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  amount = 1,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: damage(amount),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction start(\n  profiles: readonly CombatantProfile[],\n  columns = profiles.map((_, index) => index * 2),\n): EncounterState {\n  const setup = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 20, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: profiles,\n    tokens: profiles.map((profile, index) =>\n      placedToken(profile, columns[index] ?? index * 2, 1),\n    ),\n  });\n  return reduceEncounter(setup, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction stateOf(state: EncounterState, profile: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === profile.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing fixture combatant ${profile.id}.`);\n  return found;\n}\n\ndescribe('encounter reducer authority and action economy', () => {\n  it('requires exactly one identity-matched board token for every rules profile', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('identity');\n    expect(() =>\n      createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 2, rows: 2 },\n        combatants: [pc],\n        tokens: [],\n      }),\n    ).toThrow('exactly one matching board token');\n  });\n\n  it('rejects an otherwise valid action from a non-active PC', () => {\n    const active = playerProfile('active', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const inactive = playerProfile('inactive', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('monster', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    const state = start([active, inactive, monster]);\n\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(active.id);\n    expect(() =>\n      reduceEncounter(\n        state,\n        {\n          type: 'apply_effect',\n          actor: inactive.id,\n          cost: 'none',\n          effect: {\n            targets: [monster.id],\n            duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n            concentration: false,\n            stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('inactive-pc-control'),\n            stacking: 'coexist',\n            repeatedSave: null,\n            payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Blinded' },\n          },\n        },\n        () => 0.5,\n      ),\n    ).toThrow('is not the active combatant');\n    expect(state.revision).toBe(1);\n  });\n\n  it('advances initiative when an active combatant was killed by a reaction during its turn', () => {\n    const active = monsterProfile('reaction-casualty', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const next = playerProfile('reaction-survivor', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    const started = start([active, next]);\n    const killed: EncounterState = {\n      ...started,\n      combatants: started.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === active.id\n          ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 0, life: 'dead', deathSaves: null }\n          : combatant),\n    };\n\n    const advanced = reduceEncounter(killed, { type: 'end_turn', actor: active.id }, () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(advanced.state.activeCombatant).toBe(next.id);\n    expect(advanced.events.map((event) => event.type)).toContain('turn_ended');\n    expect(advanced.events.map((event) => event.type)).toContain('turn_started');\n  });\n\n  it('splits movement around other choices through the shared movement kernel', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('mover', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('far', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 10]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn.movement).toEqual({ speed: 30, spent: 15, remaining: 15 });\n    expect(state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === pc.id)?.position).toEqual({\n      column: 3,\n      row: 1,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('tracks action, Bonus Action, Reaction, and Dash movement independently', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('resources', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('other', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 10]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'spend_bonus_action', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'fixture feature' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'spend_reaction', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'fixture reaction' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'dash', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn).toMatchObject({\n      action: { kind: 'spent' },\n      bonusActionAvailable: false,\n      reactionAvailable: false,\n      movement: { speed: 60, spent: 0, remaining: 60 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('temp_hp_stacks_additively keeps the higher grant and replaces it only with a larger grant', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('temporary-hit-points', { initiativeBonus: 10, hitPoints: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('temporary-hit-points-attacker', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster]);\n    const grant = (amount: number) => {\n      const reduced = reduceEncounter(state, {\n        type: 'grant_temporary_hit_points',\n        actor: pc.id,\n        target: pc.id,\n        amount,\n        cost: 'none',\n      }, () => 0.5);\n      state = reduced.state;\n      return reduced;\n    };\n\n    grant(10);\n    const smaller = grant(4);\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).temporaryHitPoints).toBe(10);\n    expect(smaller.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'temporary_hit_points_changed',\n      before: 10,\n      after: 10,\n    }));\n\n    const larger = grant(12);\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).temporaryHitPoints).toBe(12);\n    expect(larger.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'temporary_hit_points_changed',\n      before: 10,\n      after: 12,\n    }));\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(monster, pc, 13), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc)).toMatchObject({ hitPoints: 19, temporaryHitPoints: 0 });\n  });\n\n  it('tracks a multiattack sequence across split movement and closes it at the profile limit', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('multiattacker', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      attacksPerAction: 2,\n    });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('multiattack-target', {\n      initiativeBonus: -10,\n      hitPoints: 20,\n    });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 4]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(pc, monster, 1), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn.action).toEqual({\n      kind: 'attack_sequence',\n      attacksRemaining: 1,\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(pc, monster, 1), () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, pc).turn.action).toEqual({ kind: 'spent' });\n    expect(stateOf(state, monster).hitPoints).toBe(18);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(state, attack(pc, monster, 1), () => 0.5)).toThrow(\n      'has no attack available',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('resolves saving throws and half damage through the shared resolution kernel', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('save-source', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('save-target', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    const state = start([pc, monster]);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      {\n        type: 'force_save',\n        actor: pc.id,\n        target: monster.id,\n        ability: 'dexterity',\n        dc: 10,\n        rollMode: 'normal',\n        damage: damage(5),\n        onSuccess: 'half',\n        cost: 'action',\n      },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n\n    expect(result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')).toMatchObject({\n      target: monster.id,\n      save: { outcome: 'success', total: 11 },\n    });\n    expect(stateOf(result.state, monster).hitPoints).toBe(8);\n  });\n\n  it('Incapacitated condition removes action, Bonus Action, and Reaction availability', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('incapacitated', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('other', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    const state = start([pc, monster]);\n    const applied = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      {\n        type: 'apply_effect',\n        actor: pc.id,\n        cost: 'none',\n        effect: {\n          targets: [pc.id],\n          duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n          concentration: false,\n          stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('condition:incapacitated'),\n          stacking: 'replace_any_source',\n          repeatedSave: null,\n          payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Incapacitated' },\n        },\n      },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(applied, pc).turn).toMatchObject({\n      action: { kind: 'spent' },\n      bonusActionAvailable: false,\n      reactionAvailable: false,\n    });\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(applied, { type: 'dash', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5)).toThrow(\n      'is Incapacitated',\n    );\n    expect(() =>\n      reduceEncounter(\n        applied,\n        { type: 'spend_bonus_action', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'forbidden' },\n        () => 0.5,\n      ),\n    ).toThrow('is Incapacitated');\n    expect(() =>\n      reduceEncounter(\n        applied,\n        { type: 'spend_reaction', actor: pc.id, purpose: 'forbidden' },\n        () => 0.5,\n      ),\n    ).toThrow('cannot react');\n  });\n\n  it('Disengage suppresses the shared-kernel Opportunity Attack window', () => {\n    const monster = monsterProfile('reactor', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const pc = playerProfile('walker', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = start([monster, pc], [1, 2]);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: monster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    const offered = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    expect(offered.state.pendingDecisions).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'reaction_offer', reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack', combatant: monster.id,\n    }));\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'disengage', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'move', actor: pc.id, path: [{ column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === pc.id)?.position.column).toBe(3);\n  });\n\n  it('Dodge imposes Disadvantage until the target next starts a turn', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('dodger', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('attacker', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = start([pc, monster], [0, 1]);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'dodge', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: pc.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, attack(monster, pc), () => 0.5);\n    const event = result.events.find((candidate) => candidate.type === 'attack_resolved');\n\n    expect(event?.type).toBe('attack_resolved');\n    if (event?.type !== 'attack_resolved') throw new Error('Missing attack event.');\n    expect(event.attack.roll.mode).toBe('disadvantage');\n    expect(event.attack.roll.faces).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('0-HP, healing, and massive-damage matrix', () => {\n  it.each([\n    ['ordinary monster at exactly 0', monsterProfile('ordinary-exact'), 10, 'dead', false],\n    ['ordinary monster overkilled', monsterProfile('ordinary-over'), 20, 'dead', false],\n    [\n      'named monster opted into death saves at exactly 0',\n      monsterProfile('named-exact', { usesDeathSaves: true }),\n      10,\n      'dying',\n      false,\n    ],\n    [\n      'named monster opted into death saves takes massive damage',\n      monsterProfile('named-massive', { usesDeathSaves: true }),\n      20,\n      'dead',\n      true,\n    ],\n    ['PC at exactly 0', playerProfile('pc-exact', { initiativeBonus: -10 }), 10, 'dying', false],\n    ['PC takes massive damage', playerProfile('pc-massive', { initiativeBonus: -10 }), 20, 'dead', true],\n  ] as const)('%s', (_label, target, amount, expectedLife, massiveDamage) => {\n    const attacker = playerProfile(`attacker-${target.id}`, { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const state = start([attacker, target]);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, attack(attacker, target, amount), () => 0.5);\n    const event = result.events.find((candidate) => candidate.type === 'damage_applied');\n\n    expect(stateOf(result.state, target)).toMatchObject({ hitPoints: 0, life: expectedLife });\n    expect(event?.type).toBe('damage_applied');\n    if (event?.type !== 'damage_applied') throw new Error('Missing damage event.');\n    expect(event.massiveDamage).toBe(massiveDamage);\n  });\n\n  it('healing a dying death-save user restores living state without implementing death-save rolls', () => {\n    const healer = playerProfile('healer', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = playerProfile('patient', { initiativeBonus: -10 });\n    let state = start([healer, target]);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, attack(healer, target, 10), () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      { type: 'heal', actor: healer.id, target: target.id, amount: 3, cost: 'none' },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n\n    expect(stateOf(state, target)).toMatchObject({ hitPoints: 3, life: 'living' });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/persistent-areas.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1868","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks area_triggers_every_step: crossing a three-square zone resolves once per entry, not once per step"},{"id":"1869","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks standing_inside_triggers_start_once: start-of-turn hooks resolve exactly once in each round"},{"id":"1870","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks emanation_uses_stale_origin: an anchored emanation follows every owner step and catches an adjacent creature"},{"id":"1871","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks emanation_origin_occupant_is_affected: an eligible creature on the emanation origin takes the effect"},{"id":"1872","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks emanation_owner_membership_follows_filter: an ally aura includes its anchor while a hostile aura excludes it"},{"id":"1873","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks save_ends_never_ends: a later successful save removes an area-applied condition"},{"id":"1874","name":"persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks membership_order_nondeterministic: overlapping areas always resolve by creation sequence"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  effectiveSkillModifier,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport type { PersistentAreaInput } from '../../../src/combat/persistent-areas';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, feet, persistentAreaId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst force = damageType('Force');\n\nfunction fixedDamage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{ type: force, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount } }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\nfunction started(columns: readonly number[] = [0, 4]): EncounterState {\n  const owner = playerProfile('area-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const target = monsterProfile('area-target', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [owner, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(owner, columns[0] ?? 0, 1), placedToken(target, columns[1] ?? 4, 1)],\n  });\n  return reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction baseArea(state: EncounterState, overrides: Partial<PersistentAreaInput> = {}): PersistentAreaInput {\n  const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n  return {\n    owner,\n    origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n    shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(2) },\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', remaining: 10 },\n    targetFilter: { kind: 'all' },\n    difficultTerrain: false,\n    movable: null,\n    hooks: [],\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction createArea(state: EncounterState, area: PersistentAreaInput, rng: () => number = () => 0.5) {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'create_persistent_area', actor: area.owner, area, cost: 'none',\n  }, rng);\n}\n\nfunction hitPoints(state: EncounterState, id: string): number {\n  const subject = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === id);\n  if (subject === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing combatant ${id}.`);\n  return subject.hitPoints;\n}\n\ndescribe('persistent areas and deterministic membership hooks', () => {\n  it('area_triggers_every_step: crossing a three-square zone resolves once per entry, not once per step', () => {\n    let state = started([8, 0]);\n    const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = state.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n      shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(7) },\n      hooks: [{ hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger', effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(3) } } }],\n    })).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: target,\n      path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 3, row: 1 }, { column: 4, row: 1 }, { column: 5, row: 1 }],\n      cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(moved.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(hitPoints(moved.state, target)).toBe(27);\n  });\n\n  it('standing_inside_triggers_start_once: start-of-turn hooks resolve exactly once in each round', () => {\n    let state = started([0, 2]);\n    const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = state.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n      shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(3) },\n      hooks: [{ hook: 'on_start_of_turn_inside', frequency: 'once_per_turn', effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(2) } } }],\n    })).state;\n\n    const targetTurn = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(targetTurn.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(hitPoints(targetTurn.state, target)).toBe(28);\n    const nextOwner = reduceEncounter(targetTurn.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const nextTarget = reduceEncounter(nextOwner, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(nextTarget.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(hitPoints(nextTarget.state, target)).toBe(26);\n  });\n\n  it('emanation_uses_stale_origin: an anchored emanation follows every owner step and catches an adjacent creature', () => {\n    const owner = playerProfile('moving-aura-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const beneficiary = playerProfile('moving-aura-beneficiary', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 10, rows: 3 }, combatants: [owner, beneficiary],\n      tokens: [placedToken(owner, 0, 1), placedToken(beneficiary, 4, 1)],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(5) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'allies' },\n      hooks: [{\n        hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger',\n        effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'effect', payload: { kind: 'skill_modifier', skill: 'stealth', amount: 4 }, lifetime: { kind: 'while_inside' } } },\n      }],\n    })).state;\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(state, beneficiary.id, 'stealth')).toBe(0);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: owner.id,\n      path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 3, row: 1 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.origin).toEqual({ kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id });\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.members).toContain(beneficiary.id);\n    expect(effectiveSkillModifier(state, beneficiary.id, 'stealth')).toBe(4);\n  });\n\n  it('emanation_origin_occupant_is_affected: an eligible creature on the emanation origin takes the effect', () => {\n    const owner = playerProfile('origin-aura-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 30 });\n    const hostile = monsterProfile('origin-aura-hostile', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 3 }, combatants: [owner, hostile],\n      tokens: [placedToken(owner, 3, 1), placedToken(hostile, 0, 1)],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(0, 5) },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(10) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'enemies' },\n      hooks: [{\n        hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger',\n        effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(5) } },\n      }],\n    })).state;\n\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.members).toContain(hostile.id);\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.members).not.toContain(owner.id);\n    expect(hitPoints(state, hostile.id)).toBe(25);\n    expect(hitPoints(state, owner.id)).toBe(30);\n  });\n\n  it('emanation_owner_membership_follows_filter: an ally aura includes its anchor while a hostile aura excludes it', () => {\n    const owner = playerProfile('filtered-aura-owner', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const hostile = monsterProfile('filtered-aura-hostile', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const initial = (): EncounterState => reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 3 }, combatants: [owner, hostile],\n      tokens: [placedToken(owner, 0, 1), placedToken(hostile, 5, 1)],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const conditionHook = {\n      hook: 'on_enter',\n      frequency: 'every_trigger',\n      effect: {\n        kind: 'automatic',\n        payload: {\n          kind: 'effect',\n          payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Frightened' },\n          lifetime: { kind: 'area_duration' },\n        },\n      },\n    } as const;\n\n    const alliedInitial = initial();\n    const allied = createArea(alliedInitial, baseArea(alliedInitial, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(10) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'allies' },\n      hooks: [conditionHook],\n    })).state;\n    expect(allied.persistentAreas[0]?.members).toContain(owner.id);\n    expect(combatantConditions(allied, owner.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Frightened');\n\n    const hostileInitial = initial();\n    const hostileOnly = createArea(hostileInitial, baseArea(hostileInitial, {\n      owner: owner.id,\n      origin: { kind: 'anchored', combatant: owner.id },\n      shape: { kind: 'emanation', radius: feet(10) },\n      targetFilter: { kind: 'enemies' },\n      hooks: [conditionHook],\n    })).state;\n    expect(hostileOnly.persistentAreas[0]?.members).not.toContain(owner.id);\n    expect(combatantConditions(hostileOnly, owner.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).not.toContain('Frightened');\n  });\n\n  it('save_ends_never_ends: a later successful save removes an area-applied condition', () => {\n    let state = started([8, 0]);\n    const owner = state.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = state.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    state = createArea(state, baseArea(state, {\n      hooks: [{\n        hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger',\n        effect: {\n          kind: 'save_gated', ability: 'wisdom', dc: 10, rollMode: 'normal', onSuccess: 'none',\n          payload: { kind: 'effect', payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Frightened' }, lifetime: { kind: 'save_ends', boundary: 'end' } },\n        },\n      }],\n    })).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: target, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n    }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Frightened');\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target }, () => 0.999).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target).map((condition) => condition.name)).not.toContain('Frightened');\n  });\n\n  it('membership_order_nondeterministic: overlapping areas always resolve by creation sequence', () => {\n    const initial = started([8, 0]);\n    const owner = initial.combatants[0]!.profile.id;\n    const target = initial.combatants[1]!.profile.id;\n    const commands: EncounterCommand[] = [1, 2].map((amount) => ({\n      type: 'create_persistent_area', actor: owner, cost: 'none',\n      area: baseArea(initial, {\n        hooks: [{ hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'every_trigger', effect: { kind: 'automatic', payload: { kind: 'damage', damage: fixedDamage(amount) } } }],\n      }),\n    }));\n    const run = (): EncounterState => {\n      let state = initial;\n      for (const command of commands) state = reduceEncounter(state, command, () => 0.5).state;\n      state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner }, () => 0.5).state;\n      return reduceEncounter(state, {\n        type: 'move', actor: target, path: [{ column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'reactions_resolved',\n      }, () => 0.5).state;\n    };\n    const first = run();\n    const second = run();\n    expect(first.eventLog.filter((event) => event.type === 'persistent_area_triggered').map((event) => event.areaId))\n      .toEqual([persistentAreaId('area:1'), persistentAreaId('area:2')]);\n    expect(canonicalJson(second)).toBe(canonicalJson(first));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/bridge/turn-program-library.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1875","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library derives the prompt documentation and function list from the versioned registry"},{"id":"1876","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'focusFire' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1877","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'retreatWhenBelow' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1878","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'flankWith' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1879","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library 'holdChokepoint' expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1880","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library riderOnCrit expands to the same attached fixed follow-up as its hand-written long form"},{"id":"1881","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library sandboxes helper arguments and rejects fabricated selectors and ambient globals"},{"id":"1882","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library helper_bypasses_validation rejects an invalid cell before it can become a DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1883","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library fraction_hp_not_scaled converts the 0..1 fraction to the contract percentage exactly once"},{"id":"1884","name":"versioned JS turn-program pattern library requires a fixed action rather than a searchable program as the rider follow-up"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { dmVisibleEncounter, projectDmView, type DmVisibleEncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { combatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { decodeDecisionProgramStructure } from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/round-plan-contract';\nimport {\n  JS_TURN_PROGRAM_GRAMMAR,\n  JsTurnProgramRuntimeError,\n  JsTurnProgramSyntaxError,\n  interpretJsTurnProgram,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/js-turn-program';\nimport {\n  TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC,\n  TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_FUNCTIONS,\n  TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_VERSION,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/turn-program-library';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction projection(): DmVisibleEncounterState {\n  const monsterA = monsterProfile('library-a', { hitPoints: 40 });\n  const monsterB = monsterProfile('library-b', { hitPoints: 30 });\n  const playerA = playerProfile('library-player-a');\n  const playerB = playerProfile('library-player-b');\n  const base = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 4 },\n    combatants: [monsterA, monsterB, playerB, playerA],\n    tokens: [\n      placedToken(monsterA, 0),\n      placedToken(monsterB, 1),\n      placedToken(playerB, 3),\n      placedToken(playerA, 3, 1),\n    ],\n  });\n  const state: EncounterState = { ...base, activeCombatant: monsterA.id };\n  return dmVisibleEncounter(projectDmView(state));\n}\n\nconst ACTOR = combatantId('combatant:library-a');\nconst ALLY = combatantId('combatant:library-b');\nconst TARGET = combatantId('combatant:library-player-a');\nconst target = { kind: 'combatant' as const, combatantId: TARGET };\n\ndescribe('versioned JS turn-program pattern library', () => {\n  it('derives the prompt documentation and function list from the versioned registry', () => {\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_VERSION).toBe('turn-program-library:v1');\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_FUNCTIONS).toEqual([\n      'focusFire',\n      'retreatWhenBelow',\n      'flankWith',\n      'holdChokepoint',\n      'riderOnCrit',\n    ]);\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC).toContain('focusFire(targetSelector)');\n    expect(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC).toContain('riderOnCrit(followUpAction)');\n    expect(JS_TURN_PROGRAM_GRAMMAR.endsWith(TURN_PROGRAM_LIBRARY_DOC)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    {\n      helper: 'focusFire',\n      source: 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(focusFire(target));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'priority',\n        choices: [\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n        ],\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      helper: 'retreatWhenBelow',\n      source: 'emit(retreatWhenBelow(0.25, {column: 0, row: 2}));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'if',\n        predicate: { kind: 'hp_percent_below', combatantId: ACTOR, percent: 25 },\n        then: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'disengage' } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'retreat_toward', destination: { column: 0, row: 2 } } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'dash' } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n        else: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target: { kind: 'nearest_enemy' } } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target: { kind: 'nearest_enemy' } } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      helper: 'flankWith',\n      source: 'const ally = lowestHp(alliesWithin(30)); const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(flankWith(ally, target));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'if',\n        predicate: { kind: 'distance_at_most', left: ALLY, right: TARGET, feet: 5 },\n        then: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n        else: {\n          kind: 'priority',\n          choices: [\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target } },\n            { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          ],\n        },\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      helper: 'holdChokepoint',\n      source: 'emit(holdChokepoint({column: 2, row: 2}));',\n      longForm: {\n        kind: 'priority',\n        choices: [\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'retreat_toward', destination: { column: 2, row: 2 } } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'dodge' } },\n          { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n        ],\n      },\n    },\n  ])('$helper expands exactly to its hand-written DecisionProgram', ({ source, longForm }) => {\n    const expanded = interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR).emittedDecisionProgram;\n    expect(expanded).toEqual(longForm);\n    expect(decodeDecisionProgramStructure(expanded)).toEqual(longForm);\n  });\n\n  it('riderOnCrit expands to the same attached fixed follow-up as its hand-written long form', () => {\n    const source = 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(attack(target, riderOnCrit(forceSave(target))));';\n    const expanded = interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR).emittedDecisionProgram;\n    const longForm = {\n      kind: 'action' as const,\n      action: { kind: 'attack' as const, target },\n      riders: [{\n        kind: 'on_critical_hit' as const,\n        followUpAction: { kind: 'force_save' as const, target },\n      }],\n    };\n\n    expect(expanded).toEqual(longForm);\n    expect(decodeDecisionProgramStructure(expanded)).toEqual(longForm);\n  });\n\n  it('sandboxes helper arguments and rejects fabricated selectors and ambient globals', () => {\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(focusFire({kind: \"combatant\", combatantId: \"combatant:library-player-a\"}));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    )).toThrowError(new JsTurnProgramRuntimeError('focusFire requires a combatant reference.'));\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(focusFire(globalThis));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    )).toThrowError(JsTurnProgramSyntaxError);\n  });\n\n  it('helper_bypasses_validation rejects an invalid cell before it can become a DecisionProgram', () => {\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(retreatWhenBelow(0.25, {column: -1, row: 0}));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    )).toThrow('cell selector coordinates must be non-negative safe integers');\n  });\n\n  it('fraction_hp_not_scaled converts the 0..1 fraction to the contract percentage exactly once', () => {\n    const expanded = interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'emit(retreatWhenBelow(0.375, {column: 0, row: 0}));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    ).emittedDecisionProgram;\n    expect(expanded).toMatchObject({\n      predicate: { kind: 'hp_percent_below', combatantId: ACTOR, percent: 37.5 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('requires a fixed action rather than a searchable program as the rider follow-up', () => {\n    const source = 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(attack(target, riderOnCrit(focusFire(target))));';\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR)).toThrow(\n      'riderOnCrit followUpAction must be an action.',\n    );\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/flammable-surfaces.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1885","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells bundled Web is RAW-flammable while Grease is a default-off named optional rule"},{"id":"1886","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells ignition_ignores_exposure: fire ignites the exact exposed cube but not an unexposed neighbor"},{"id":"1887","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells cold_ignites: non-fire damage in the same cell does not ignite while Fire damage does"},{"id":"1888","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells same Fire event ignites flammable overlapping areas and leaves a nonflammable area unchanged"},{"id":"1889","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells optional-rule flag off vs on: 2024 Grease stays nonflammable unless flammable_grease is enabled"},{"id":"1890","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells burning Web deals exactly 2d4 Fire damage at start of turn"},{"id":"1891","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells a banished combatant in an ignited cell takes no burning damage at start of turn"},{"id":"1892","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells burn_lingers: an ignited cube burns away after exactly one full round"},{"id":"1893","name":"D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells restraint_survives_burn: Web restraint ends when its burned cube burns away"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { PersistentAreaInput, PersistentAreaMaterial } from '../../../src/combat/persistent-areas';\nimport {\n  GREASE_MATERIAL,\n  WEB_MATERIAL,\n  persistentAreaContains,\n} from '../../../src/combat/persistent-areas';\nimport { spellDefinition } from '../../../src/combat/spells/definitions';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport {\n  damageType,\n  dieSides,\n  effectStackingIdentity,\n  feet,\n  type DamageType,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst NONFLAMMABLE_MATERIAL: PersistentAreaMaterial = {\n  id: 'stone-dust',\n  flammability: { kind: 'nonflammable' },\n};\n\nfunction faceOne(): number {\n  return 0;\n}\n\nfunction setup(optionalRules: readonly 'flammable_grease'[] = []) {\n  const owner = playerProfile('surface-owner', { initiativeBonus: 30, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const fireDealer = playerProfile('surface-fire-dealer', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const target = monsterProfile('surface-target', { initiativeBonus: 10, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant', optionalRules },\n    bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [owner, fireDealer, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(owner, 0, 1), placedToken(fireDealer, 1, 1), placedToken(target, 3, 1)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, faceOne).state;\n  return { state, owner, fireDealer, target };\n}\n\nfunction webHooks(): PersistentAreaInput['hooks'] {\n  return (['on_enter', 'on_start_of_turn_inside'] as const).map((hook) => ({\n    hook,\n    frequency: 'once_per_turn' as const,\n    effect: {\n      kind: 'save_gated' as const,\n      ability: 'dexterity' as const,\n      dc: 20,\n      rollMode: 'normal' as const,\n      onSuccess: 'none' as const,\n      payload: {\n        kind: 'effect' as const,\n        payload: { kind: 'condition' as const, condition: 'Restrained' as const },\n        lifetime: { kind: 'while_inside' as const },\n      },\n    },\n  }));\n}\n\nfunction area(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  material: PersistentAreaMaterial,\n  hooks: PersistentAreaInput['hooks'] = [],\n): PersistentAreaInput {\n  const owner = state.combatants[0]?.profile.id;\n  const target = state.combatants[2]?.profile.id;\n  if (owner === undefined || target === undefined) throw new Error('Surface fixture is incomplete.');\n  return {\n    owner,\n    origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(15, 5) },\n    shape: { kind: 'sphere', radius: feet(20) },\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', remaining: 10 },\n    targetFilter: { kind: 'selected', combatants: [target] },\n    difficultTerrain: true,\n    material,\n    hooks,\n    movable: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction createArea(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  input: PersistentAreaInput,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'create_persistent_area', actor: input.owner, area: input, cost: 'none',\n  }, faceOne).state;\n}\n\nfunction advanceToFireDealer(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  owner: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: owner.id }, faceOne).state;\n}\n\nfunction dealDamage(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n  target: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>,\n  type: DamageType,\n): EncounterState {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'force_save', actor: actor.id, target: target.id,\n    ability: 'dexterity', dc: 20, rollMode: 'normal', onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type, dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 1 } }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  }, faceOne).state;\n}\n\nfunction hitPoints(state: EncounterState, id: string): number {\n  const subject = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === id);\n  if (subject === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing combatant ${id}.`);\n  return subject.hitPoints;\n}\n\ndescribe('D371.1 and D373.17 flammable persistent-area cells', () => {\n  it('bundled Web is RAW-flammable while Grease is a default-off named optional rule', () => {\n    const web = spellDefinition('web');\n    const grease = spellDefinition('grease');\n    expect(web?.operation).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'persistent_area', material: { id: 'webs', flammability: { kind: 'flammable' } },\n    });\n    expect(grease?.operation).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'persistent_area', material: {\n        id: 'grease', flammability: { kind: 'optional_rule', rule: 'flammable_grease' },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('ignition_ignores_exposure: fire ignites the exact exposed cube but not an unexposed neighbor', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    const web = state.persistentAreas[0];\n    if (web === undefined) throw new Error('Web area was not created.');\n    const exposed = state.tokens.find((token) => token.combatantId === subject.target.id)?.position;\n    if (exposed === undefined) throw new Error('Target token was not placed.');\n    const neighbor = { column: exposed.column + 1, row: exposed.row };\n    expect(persistentAreaContains(web, neighbor, null, state)).toBe(true);\n    expect(web.burningCells.map((entry) => entry.cell)).toEqual([exposed]);\n    expect(web.burningCells.some((entry) =>\n      entry.cell.column === neighbor.column && entry.cell.row === neighbor.row)).toBe(false);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells.map((entry) => entry.cell)).toEqual([exposed]);\n  });\n\n  it('cold_ignites: non-fire damage in the same cell does not ignite while Fire damage does', () => {\n    const run = (type: 'Cold' | 'Fire'): EncounterState => {\n      const subject = setup();\n      let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n      state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n      return dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType(type));\n    };\n    expect(run('Cold').persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(run('Fire').persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toHaveLength(1);\n  });\n\n  it('same Fire event ignites flammable overlapping areas and leaves a nonflammable area unchanged', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = createArea(state, area(state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = createArea(state, area(state, NONFLAMMABLE_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    expect(state.persistentAreas.map((candidate) => candidate.burningCells.length)).toEqual([1, 1, 0]);\n  });\n\n  it('optional-rule flag off vs on: 2024 Grease stays nonflammable unless flammable_grease is enabled', () => {\n    const run = (enabled: boolean): EncounterState => {\n      const subject = setup(enabled ? ['flammable_grease'] : []);\n      let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, GREASE_MATERIAL));\n      state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n      return dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    };\n    expect(run(false).persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(run(true).persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toHaveLength(1);\n  });\n\n  it('burning Web deals exactly 2d4 Fire damage at start of turn', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    expect(hitPoints(state, subject.target.id)).toBe(29);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(hitPoints(state, subject.target.id)).toBe(27);\n  });\n\n  it('a banished combatant in an ignited cell takes no burning damage at start of turn', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'apply_effect',\n      actor: subject.fireDealer.id,\n      cost: 'none',\n      effect: {\n        targets: [subject.target.id],\n        duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n        concentration: false,\n        stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('test:burning-cell-banishment'),\n        stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n        repeatedSave: null,\n        payload: {\n          kind: 'temporary_banishment',\n          returnDamage: {\n            terms: [{\n              type: damageType('Force'),\n              dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 0 },\n            }],\n            critical: false,\n            responses: [],\n          },\n          returnPlacement: 'previous_or_nearest_unoccupied',\n        },\n      },\n    }, faceOne).state;\n    const banishedHitPoints = hitPoints(state, subject.target.id);\n    expect(state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === subject.target.id)).toBe(false);\n\n    expect(() => {\n      state = reduceEncounter(\n        state,\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id },\n        faceOne,\n      ).state;\n    }).not.toThrow();\n    expect(hitPoints(state, subject.target.id)).toBe(banishedHitPoints);\n  });\n\n  it('burn_lingers: an ignited cube burns away after exactly one full round', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL));\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    const exposed = state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells[0]?.cell;\n    if (exposed === undefined) throw new Error('Web cube did not ignite.');\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burnedAwayCells).toEqual([]);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.owner.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burningCells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(state.persistentAreas[0]?.burnedAwayCells).toEqual([exposed]);\n  });\n\n  it('restraint_survives_burn: Web restraint ends when its burned cube burns away', () => {\n    const subject = setup();\n    let state = createArea(subject.state, area(subject.state, WEB_MATERIAL, webHooks()));\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, subject.target.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Restrained');\n    state = advanceToFireDealer(state, subject.owner);\n    state = dealDamage(state, subject.fireDealer, subject.target, damageType('Fire'));\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.fireDealer.id }, faceOne).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, subject.target.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).toContain('Restrained');\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.owner.id }, faceOne).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, subject.target.id).map((condition) => condition.name)).not.toContain('Restrained');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/tools/generate-arena-basis.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1894","name":"arena basis generator parses the explicit difficulty profile and writes deterministic canonical rooms"},{"id":"1895","name":"arena basis generator rejects unknown difficulty profiles before writing"},{"id":"1896","name":"arena basis generator accepts the brutal difficulty profile"}],"source":"import { join } from 'node:path';\nimport { tmpdir } from 'node:os';\nimport { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport { generateRoom } from '../../../src/vtt/room-generator';\nimport {\n  generateArenaBasis,\n  parseBasisGenerationArgs,\n} from '../../../tools/generate-arena-basis';\nimport { mkdtempSync, readFileSync } from '../../helpers/test-filesystem';\n\ndescribe('arena basis generator', () => {\n  it('parses the explicit difficulty profile and writes deterministic canonical rooms', async () => {\n    const outPath = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'dnd-hard-basis-generator-'));\n    const config = parseBasisGenerationArgs([\n      '--difficulty', 'hard',\n      '--seed', '5117001',\n      '--rooms', '2',\n      '--out', outPath,\n    ]);\n\n    expect(config).toEqual({\n      difficulty: 'hard',\n      seed: 5_117_001,\n      rooms: 2,\n      outPath,\n    });\n    await generateArenaBasis(config);\n\n    for (const seed of [5_117_001, 5_117_002]) {\n      expect(readFileSync(join(outPath, `seed-${String(seed)}.json`), 'utf8')).toBe(\n        `${canonicalJson(generateRoom(seed, { difficulty: 'hard' }))}\\n`,\n      );\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('rejects unknown difficulty profiles before writing', () => {\n    expect(() => parseBasisGenerationArgs([\n      '--difficulty', 'nightmare',\n      '--seed', '5117001',\n      '--rooms', '12',\n      '--out', tmpdir(),\n    ])).toThrow('--difficulty must be standard, hard, or brutal.');\n  });\n\n  it('accepts the brutal difficulty profile', () => {\n    const outPath = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'dnd-brutal-basis-generator-'));\n    expect(parseBasisGenerationArgs([\n      '--difficulty', 'brutal',\n      '--seed', '6203001',\n      '--rooms', '3',\n      '--out', outPath,\n    ])).toEqual({ difficulty: 'brutal', seed: 6_203_001, rooms: 3, outPath });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/bridge/js-turn-program.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1897","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter parses the typed grammar: const, arithmetic, comparisons, logic, arrays, objects, calls, if/else, and API-array for-of"},{"id":"1898","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and source error"},{"id":"1900","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter rejects forbidden this with a precise source error"},{"id":"1901","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and exists"},{"id":"1916","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter step_budget_ignored stops a costly API-array loop at the exact configured bound"},{"id":"1917","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter enforces the wall-clock budget through an injected monotonic clock"},{"id":"1918","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter same source and projection emit an identical DecisionProgram"},{"id":"1919","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter projection_order_changes_query uses combatant id as the stable equidistant tie-break"},{"id":"1920","name":"restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter emits explicit selectable programs for granted Bonus Action attacks and Action Surge"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { dmVisibleEncounter, projectDmView, type DmVisibleEncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { combatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  JS_TURN_PROGRAM_CANONICAL_EXAMPLE,\n  JsTurnProgramBudgetError,\n  JsTurnProgramSyntaxError,\n  interpretJsTurnProgram,\n  parseJsTurnProgram,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/js-turn-program';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction projection(): DmVisibleEncounterState {\n  const monsterA = monsterProfile('js-program-a', { hitPoints: 40 });\n  const monsterB = monsterProfile('js-program-b', { hitPoints: 30 });\n  const playerA = playerProfile('js-program-player-a');\n  const playerB = playerProfile('js-program-player-b');\n  const base = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [monsterA, monsterB, playerB, playerA],\n    tokens: [\n      placedToken(monsterA, 0),\n      placedToken(monsterB, 1),\n      placedToken(playerB, 3),\n      placedToken(playerA, 3, 1),\n    ],\n  });\n  const state: EncounterState = { ...base, activeCombatant: monsterA.id };\n  return dmVisibleEncounter(projectDmView(state));\n}\n\nconst ACTOR = combatantId('combatant:js-program-a');\n\ndescribe('restricted JS turn-program parser and interpreter', () => {\n  it('parses the typed grammar: const, arithmetic, comparisons, logic, arrays, objects, calls, if/else, and API-array for-of', () => {\n    const source = `\n      const radius = (2 + 4) * 5;\n      const flags = [true, false, null];\n      const note = {label: \"deterministic\", radius: radius};\n      for (const ally of alliesWithin(radius)) {\n        const allyHealthy = hpPercent(ally) >= 50 && distanceTo(ally) <= radius;\n      }\n      const target = lowestHp(enemiesWithin(radius));\n      if (target !== null && !(1 > 2)) {\n        emit(priority([attack(target), forceSave(target), move(target), retreat(1, 2), dash(), disengage(), dodge(), endTurn()]));\n      } else {\n        emit(endTurn());\n      }\n    `;\n\n    const ast = parseJsTurnProgram(source);\n    const result = interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR);\n\n    expect(ast.kind).toBe('program');\n    expect(ast.statements.map((statement) => statement.kind)).toEqual([\n      'const', 'const', 'const', 'for_of', 'const', 'if',\n    ]);\n    expect(result.emittedDecisionProgram).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'priority',\n      choices: [\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'attack', target: { combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' } } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'force_save' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'move_toward' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'retreat_toward' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'dash' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'disengage' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'dodge' } },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { action: 'end_turn' } },\n      ],\n    });\n    expect(result.steps).toBeGreaterThan(30);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['while loop', 'while (true) {}', 'Forbidden construct \"while loop\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['function declaration', 'function choose() {}', 'Forbidden construct \"function declaration\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['this', 'emit(this);', 'Forbidden construct \"this\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['class declaration', 'class Plan {}', 'Forbidden construct \"class declaration\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['prototype access', 'const x = prototype;', 'Forbidden prototype property \"prototype\" at line 1, column 11.'],\n    ['prototype literal', 'const x = {__proto__: 1};', 'Forbidden prototype property \"__proto__\" at line 1, column 12.'],\n    ['ambient global', 'emit(globalThis);', 'Forbidden global \"globalThis\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['import', 'import x from \"x\";', 'Forbidden construct \"import\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['try', 'try {} catch (error) {}', 'Forbidden construct \"try statement\" at line 1, column 1.'],\n    ['regular expression', 'const x = /attack/;', 'Forbidden construct \"regular expression\" at line 1, column 11.'],\n    ['Date', 'emit(Date);', 'Forbidden global \"Date\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['Math.random', 'emit(Math.random());', 'Forbidden global \"Math\" at line 1, column 6.'],\n    ['member access', 'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(target.id);', 'Member access is forbidden at line 1, column 43.'],\n    ['assignment', 'const target = nearestEnemy(); target = null;', 'Assignment is forbidden at line 1, column 39.'],\n    ['arrow function', 'const f = () => 1;', 'Forbidden construct \"arrow function\" at line 1, column 14.'],\n  ])('rejects forbidden %s with a precise source error', (_name, source, message) => {\n    expect(() => parseJsTurnProgram(source)).toThrowError(new JsTurnProgramSyntaxError(message));\n  });\n\n  it('rejects for-of over a locally constructed array rather than an API-returned array', () => {\n    expect(() => parseJsTurnProgram('const xs = []; for (const x of xs) { emit(endTurn()); }')).toThrow(\n      'For-of accepts only alliesWithin(...) or enemiesWithin(...)',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('rejects an object literal that tries to impersonate a typed API DecisionProgram', () => {\n    const source = 'emit({kind: \"action\", action: {kind: \"use_action\", action: \"end_turn\"}});';\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR)).toThrow(\n      'emit requires a DecisionProgram.',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('forbidden_construct_executes rejects while before an executable AST exists', () => {\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram('while (true) { emit(endTurn()); }', projection(), ACTOR)).toThrow(\n      'Forbidden construct \"while loop\"',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('step_budget_ignored stops a costly API-array loop at the exact configured bound', () => {\n    const source = `\n      for (const enemy of enemiesWithin(100)) {\n        const hp = hpPercent(enemy);\n      }\n      emit(endTurn());\n    `;\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram(source, projection(), ACTOR, { stepBudget: 5 })).toThrowError(\n      new JsTurnProgramBudgetError('JS turn-program exceeded step budget 5.'),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('enforces the wall-clock budget through an injected monotonic clock', () => {\n    let now = 0;\n    expect(() => interpretJsTurnProgram('emit(endTurn());', projection(), ACTOR, {\n      timeBudgetMs: 2,\n      now: () => {\n        now += 2;\n        return now;\n      },\n    })).toThrowError(new JsTurnProgramBudgetError('JS turn-program exceeded time budget 2ms.'));\n  });\n\n  it('same source and projection emit an identical DecisionProgram', () => {\n    const first = interpretJsTurnProgram(JS_TURN_PROGRAM_CANONICAL_EXAMPLE, projection(), ACTOR);\n    const second = interpretJsTurnProgram(JS_TURN_PROGRAM_CANONICAL_EXAMPLE, projection(), ACTOR);\n    expect(JSON.stringify(first.emittedDecisionProgram)).toBe(JSON.stringify(second.emittedDecisionProgram));\n  });\n\n  it('projection_order_changes_query uses combatant id as the stable equidistant tie-break', () => {\n    const result = interpretJsTurnProgram('const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(attack(target));', projection(), ACTOR);\n    expect(result.emittedDecisionProgram).toMatchObject({\n      action: { target: { combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' } },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('emits explicit selectable programs for granted Bonus Action attacks and Action Surge', () => {\n    const result = interpretJsTurnProgram(\n      'const target = nearestEnemy(); emit(priority(bonusAttack(target), actionSurge(), attack(target)));',\n      projection(),\n      ACTOR,\n    );\n    expect(result.emittedDecisionProgram).toEqual({\n      kind: 'priority',\n      choices: [\n        {\n          kind: 'action',\n          action: {\n            kind: 'bonus_attack',\n            target: { kind: 'combatant', combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' },\n          },\n        },\n        { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'action_surge' } },\n        {\n          kind: 'action',\n          action: {\n            kind: 'attack',\n            target: { kind: 'combatant', combatantId: 'combatant:js-program-player-a' },\n          },\n        },\n      ],\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/initiative-modes.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1921","name":"typed encounter initiative modes defaults new encounters to the owner-ruled shared enemy block"},{"id":"1922","name":"typed encounter initiative modes pins the complete first-round order for per_combatant"},{"id":"1923","name":"typed encounter initiative modes pins the complete first-round order for shared_enemy"},{"id":"1924","name":"typed encounter initiative modes pins the complete first-round order for side_alternating"},{"id":"1925","name":"typed encounter initiative modes shared_block_splits keeps every enemy activation in one initiative slot"},{"id":"1926","name":"typed encounter initiative modes block_order_nondeterministic keeps within-block ordering stable across replay seeds"},{"id":"1927","name":"typed encounter initiative modes allows a PC Opportunity Attack to interrupt movement inside the shared enemy block"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  AlgorithmController,\n  ControllerRegistry,\n  type StandingReactionPolicy,\n} from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n  type InitiativeMode,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nfunction sequenceRng(values: readonly number[]): () => number {\n  let index = 0;\n  return () => {\n    const value = values[index];\n    if (value === undefined) throw new Error('Initiative fixture exhausted its RNG values.');\n    index += 1;\n    return value;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction modeFixture(mode?: InitiativeMode): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly ids: Readonly<Record<'pcFast' | 'pcSlow' | 'monsterFast' | 'monsterMid' | 'monsterSlow', CombatantId>>;\n} {\n  const pcFast = playerProfile('mode-pc-fast', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n  const monsterSlow = monsterProfile('mode-monster-slow', { initiativeBonus: 1 });\n  const pcSlow = playerProfile('mode-pc-slow', { initiativeBonus: 0 });\n  const monsterFast = monsterProfile('mode-monster-fast', { initiativeBonus: 3 });\n  const monsterMid = monsterProfile('mode-monster-mid', { initiativeBonus: 2 });\n  const combatants = [pcFast, monsterSlow, pcSlow, monsterFast, monsterMid];\n  return {\n    state: createEncounter({\n      ...(mode === undefined ? {} : { config: { initiativeMode: mode } }),\n      bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n      combatants,\n      tokens: combatants.map((profile, index) => placedToken(profile, index * 2)),\n    }),\n    ids: {\n      pcFast: pcFast.id,\n      pcSlow: pcSlow.id,\n      monsterFast: monsterFast.id,\n      monsterMid: monsterMid.id,\n      monsterSlow: monsterSlow.id,\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nasync function firstRoundOrder(\n  mode: InitiativeMode,\n): Promise<{ readonly order: readonly CombatantId[]; readonly state: EncounterState }> {\n  const fixture = modeFixture(mode);\n  const registry = new ControllerRegistry(fixture.state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n    combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n    controller: new AlgorithmController(),\n  })));\n  const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n    fixture.state,\n    registry,\n    sequenceRng([0.9, 0.7, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2]),\n  );\n  const rolled = await coordinator.step();\n  if (rolled.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(rolled.reason);\n  while (\n    coordinator.state().eventLog.filter(\n      (event) => event.type === 'turn_started' && event.round === 1,\n    ).length < fixture.state.combatants.length\n  ) {\n    const result = await coordinator.step();\n    if (result.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(result.reason);\n  }\n  return {\n    order: coordinator.state().eventLog.flatMap((event) =>\n      event.type === 'turn_started' && event.round === 1 ? [event.combatant] : []),\n    state: coordinator.state(),\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('typed encounter initiative modes', () => {\n  it('defaults new encounters to the owner-ruled shared enemy block', () => {\n    expect(modeFixture().state.config).toEqual({ initiativeMode: 'shared_enemy' });\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [\n      'per_combatant',\n      ['pcFast', 'monsterSlow', 'pcSlow', 'monsterFast', 'monsterMid'],\n    ],\n    [\n      'shared_enemy',\n      ['pcFast', 'monsterFast', 'monsterMid', 'monsterSlow', 'pcSlow'],\n    ],\n    [\n      'side_alternating',\n      ['pcFast', 'pcSlow', 'monsterFast', 'monsterMid', 'monsterSlow'],\n    ],\n  ] as const)('pins the complete first-round order for %s', async (mode, names) => {\n    const fixture = modeFixture(mode);\n    const result = await firstRoundOrder(mode);\n    expect(result.order).toEqual(names.map((name) => fixture.ids[name]));\n  });\n\n  it('shared_block_splits keeps every enemy activation in one initiative slot', async () => {\n    const fixture = modeFixture('shared_enemy');\n    const result = await firstRoundOrder('shared_enemy');\n    const monsterIds = [\n      fixture.ids.monsterFast,\n      fixture.ids.monsterMid,\n      fixture.ids.monsterSlow,\n    ];\n    const monsterIndexes = monsterIds.map((id) => result.order.indexOf(id));\n    expect(monsterIndexes).toEqual([1, 2, 3]);\n    expect(new Set(\n      result.state.initiative\n        .filter((entry) => monsterIds.includes(entry.combatant))\n        .map((entry) => entry.slot),\n    ).size).toBe(1);\n    const ordered = result.state.eventLog.find((event) => event.type === 'initiative_ordered');\n    expect(ordered).toMatchObject({ slots: expect.arrayContaining([monsterIds]) });\n  });\n\n  it('block_order_nondeterministic keeps within-block ordering stable across replay seeds', async () => {\n    const orders = await Promise.all([\n      firstRoundOrder('shared_enemy'),\n      (async () => {\n        const fixture = modeFixture('shared_enemy');\n        const registry = new ControllerRegistry(fixture.state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n          combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n          controller: new AlgorithmController(),\n        })));\n        const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n          fixture.state,\n          registry,\n          sequenceRng([0.05, 0.95, 0.15, 0.4]),\n        );\n        await coordinator.step();\n        return { state: coordinator.state() };\n      })(),\n    ]);\n    const withinBlock = (state: EncounterState): readonly CombatantId[] => {\n      const block = state.eventLog.find((event) => event.type === 'initiative_block_rolled');\n      if (block === undefined || block.type !== 'initiative_block_rolled') {\n        throw new Error('Shared encounter did not emit its block roll.');\n      }\n      return block.combatants;\n    };\n    expect(withinBlock(orders[0].state)).toEqual(withinBlock(orders[1].state));\n  });\n\n  it('allows a PC Opportunity Attack to interrupt movement inside the shared enemy block', async () => {\n    const mover = monsterProfile('block-mover', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 20 });\n    const nextMonster = monsterProfile('block-next', { initiativeBonus: 10 });\n    const reactor = playerProfile('block-reactor', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const state = createEncounter({\n      config: { initiativeMode: 'shared_enemy' },\n      bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [mover, nextMonster, reactor],\n      tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1), placedToken(nextMonster, 5), placedToken(reactor, 0)],\n    });\n    const registry = new ControllerRegistry(state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n      combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n      controller: new AlgorithmController(),\n    })));\n    const move: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'move' }> = {\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: mover.id,\n      path: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }],\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    };\n    const opportunityAttack: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'opportunity_attack' }> = {\n      type: 'opportunity_attack',\n      actor: reactor.id,\n      target: mover.id,\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      rollMode: 'normal',\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n      targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{\n          type: damageType('Force'),\n          dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 },\n        }],\n        critical: false,\n        responses: [],\n      },\n    };\n    const policies = new Map<CombatantId, StandingReactionPolicy>([\n      [reactor.id, { opportunityAttack: 'use' }],\n    ]);\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(state, registry, sequenceRng([0.1, 0.9, 0.5]), {\n      turnLegalActions: (current, actor) => ({\n        actions: actor === mover.id && current.combatants.find(\n          (subject) => subject.profile.id === mover.id,\n        )?.turn.movement.spent === 0\n          ? [move]\n          : [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }],\n      }),\n      reactionLegalActions: () => [opportunityAttack],\n      standingReactionPolicies: policies,\n    });\n\n    await coordinator.step();\n    const movement = await coordinator.step();\n    if (movement.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(movement.reason);\n    expect(movement.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'resource_spent',\n      'damage_applied',\n      'attack_resolved',\n      'movement_completed',\n    ]);\n    await coordinator.step();\n    expect(coordinator.state().activeCombatant).toBe(nextMonster.id);\n    const firstRoundStarts = coordinator.state().eventLog.flatMap((event) =>\n      event.type === 'turn_started' && event.round === 1 ? [event.combatant] : []);\n    expect(firstRoundStarts).toEqual([mover.id, nextMonster.id]);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/controllers.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1928","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection evaluates standing policy {\"opportunityAttack\":\"use\"} as use"},{"id":"1929","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection evaluates standing policy {\"opportunityAttack\":\"decline\"} as decline"},{"id":"1930","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection evaluates standing policy null as prompt"},{"id":"1931","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection AlgorithmController returns the same decision for the same visible request"},{"id":"1932","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection path_not_clipped: clips a movement candidate to the actor remaining movement budget"},{"id":"1933","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection dash_budget_ignored: Dash extends the movement-candidate clipping budget by the actor Speed"},{"id":"1934","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection AgentController refuses a response tied to a superseded request id"},{"id":"1935","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection coordinator refuses a stale encounter revision without applying its action"},{"id":"1936","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection M13-AGENT-CHANGES-ACTOR refuses a response whose action belongs to another combatant"},{"id":"1937","name":"one Controller contract and stale response rejection controller swap aborts the old prompt and reissues at the action boundary"},{"id":"1938","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination standing use resolves an Opportunity Attack without a HumanController prompt"},{"id":"1939","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination standing decline records the refusal and moves without a HumanController prompt"},{"id":"1940","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination ambiguous reaction creates a durable HumanController prompt instead of auto-declining"},{"id":"1941","name":"reaction policy windows and local turn coordination same seed and controller inputs produce the same complete event stream"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  AgentController,\n  AlgorithmController,\n  ControllerRegistry,\n  HumanController,\n  StaleControllerResponseError,\n  evaluateOpportunityAttackPolicy,\n  type Controller,\n  type ControllerRequest,\n  type StandingReactionPolicy,\n} from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { projectPlayerView } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nfunction startedPair() {\n  const active = playerProfile('active-controller', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const other = monsterProfile('other-controller', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [active, other],\n    tokens: [placedToken(active, 0), placedToken(other, 5)],\n  });\n  return {\n    active,\n    other,\n    state: reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction endTurnRequest() {\n  const fixture = startedPair();\n  const request: ControllerRequest = {\n    kind: 'turn',\n    requestId: 'request:1',\n    encounterRevision: fixture.state.revision,\n    actorId: fixture.active.id,\n    visibleState: projectPlayerView(fixture.state, {\n      seatId: String(fixture.active.id),\n      combatantId: fixture.active.id,\n    }),\n    legalActions: {\n      actions: [{ type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.active.id }],\n    },\n  };\n  return { ...fixture, request };\n}\n\ndescribe('one Controller contract and stale response rejection', () => {\n  it.each([\n    [{ opportunityAttack: 'use' }, 'use'],\n    [{ opportunityAttack: 'decline' }, 'decline'],\n    [null, 'prompt'],\n  ] as const)('evaluates standing policy %j as %s', (policy, expected) => {\n    expect(evaluateOpportunityAttackPolicy(policy)).toBe(expected);\n  });\n\n  it('AlgorithmController returns the same decision for the same visible request', async () => {\n    const fixture = endTurnRequest();\n    const controller: Controller = new AlgorithmController();\n    const first = await controller.choose(fixture.request, new AbortController().signal);\n    const second = await controller.choose(fixture.request, new AbortController().signal);\n    expect(first).toEqual(second);\n  });\n\n  it('path_not_clipped: clips a movement candidate to the actor remaining movement budget', async () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('path-budget-controller', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = monsterProfile('path-budget-target', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const initial = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 14, rows: 10 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0, 5), placedToken(target, 13, 5)],\n    });\n    const state = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const fullPath = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({ column: index + 1, row: 5 }));\n    const request: ControllerRequest = {\n      kind: 'turn',\n      requestId: 'request:path-budget',\n      encounterRevision: state.revision,\n      actorId: actor.id,\n      visibleState: projectPlayerView(state, { seatId: String(actor.id), combatantId: actor.id }),\n      legalActions: { actions: [{ type: 'move', actor: actor.id, path: fullPath, cause: 'voluntary' }] },\n    };\n\n    const decision = await new AlgorithmController().choose(request, new AbortController().signal);\n\n    expect(decision.action).toEqual({\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: actor.id,\n      path: fullPath.slice(0, 6),\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('dash_budget_ignored: Dash extends the movement-candidate clipping budget by the actor Speed', async () => {\n    const actor =
