playerProfile('dash-budget-controller', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const target = monsterProfile('dash-budget-target', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const initial = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 14, rows: 10 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0, 5), placedToken(target, 13, 5)],\n    });\n    const started = reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const state = reduceEncounter(started, { type: 'dash', actor: actor.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const fullPath = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({ column: index + 1, row: 5 }));\n    const request: ControllerRequest = {\n      kind: 'turn',\n      requestId: 'request:dash-budget',\n      encounterRevision: state.revision,\n      actorId: actor.id,\n      visibleState: projectPlayerView(state, { seatId: String(actor.id), combatantId: actor.id }),\n      legalActions: { actions: [{ type: 'move', actor: actor.id, path: fullPath, cause: 'voluntary' }] },\n    };\n\n    const decision = await new AlgorithmController().choose(request, new AbortController().signal);\n\n    expect(decision.action).toEqual({\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: actor.id,\n      path: fullPath,\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('AgentController refuses a response tied to a superseded request id', async () => {\n    const fixture = endTurnRequest();\n    const controller: Controller = new AgentController({\n      exchange: async (request) => ({\n        protocolVersion: 1,\n        requestId: `${request.requestId}:stale`,\n        encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n        action: request.legalActions.actions[0],\n      }),\n    });\n    await expect(\n      controller.choose(fixture.request, new AbortController().signal),\n    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(StaleControllerResponseError);\n  });\n\n  it('coordinator refuses a stale encounter revision without applying its action', async () => {\n    const fixture = startedPair();\n    const staleAgent = new AgentController({\n      exchange: async (request) => ({\n        protocolVersion: 1,\n        requestId: request.requestId,\n        encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision - 1,\n        action: request.legalActions.actions[0],\n      }),\n    });\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n      fixture.state,\n      new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: fixture.active.id, controller: staleAgent },\n        { combatantId: fixture.other.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n      ]),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const result = await coordinator.step();\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refused', state: fixture.state });\n    expect(coordinator.state()).toBe(fixture.state);\n  });\n\n  it('M13-AGENT-CHANGES-ACTOR refuses a response whose action belongs to another combatant', async () => {\n    const fixture = startedPair();\n    const wrongActor = new AgentController({\n      exchange: async (request) => ({\n        protocolVersion: 1,\n        requestId: request.requestId,\n        encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n        action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.other.id },\n      }),\n    });\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n      fixture.state,\n      new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: fixture.active.id, controller: wrongActor },\n        { combatantId: fixture.other.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n      ]),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    await expect(coordinator.step()).resolves.toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'refused',\n      state: fixture.state,\n    });\n    expect(coordinator.state()).toBe(fixture.state);\n  });\n\n  it('controller swap aborts the old prompt and reissues at the action boundary', async () => {\n    const fixture = startedPair();\n    const oldHuman = new HumanController();\n    const replacement = new HumanController();\n    const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n      { combatantId: fixture.active.id, controller: oldHuman },\n      { combatantId: fixture.other.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n    ]);\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(fixture.state, registry, () => 0.5);\n    const step = coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const oldRequest = oldHuman.pendingRequest();\n    if (oldRequest === null) throw new Error('Old controller did not receive its request.');\n\n    coordinator.replaceController(fixture.active.id, replacement);\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const newRequest = replacement.pendingRequest();\n    if (newRequest === null) throw new Error('Replacement controller did not receive a request.');\n\n    expect(newRequest.requestId).not.toBe(oldRequest.requestId);\n    expect(() => oldHuman.submit({\n      requestId: oldRequest.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: oldRequest.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.active.id },\n    })).toThrow(StaleControllerResponseError);\n\n    replacement.submit({\n      requestId: newRequest.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: newRequest.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.active.id },\n    });\n    await expect(step).resolves.toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    expect(coordinator.state().revision).toBe(fixture.state.revision + 1);\n  });\n});\n\nfunction reactionFixture(policy: 'use' | 'decline' | null) {\n  const mover = monsterProfile('reaction-mover', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 20 });\n  const reactor = playerProfile('reaction-pc', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [mover, reactor],\n    tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1), placedToken(reactor, 0)],\n  });\n  const reactorHuman = new HumanController();\n  const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n    { combatantId: mover.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n    { combatantId: reactor.id, controller: reactorHuman },\n  ]);\n  const move: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'move' }> = {\n    type: 'move',\n    actor: mover.id,\n    path: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }],\n    cause: 'voluntary',\n  };\n  const opportunityAttack: Extract<\n    EncounterCommand,\n    { readonly type: 'opportunity_attack' }\n  > = {\n    type: 'opportunity_attack',\n    actor: reactor.id,\n    target: mover.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{\n        type: damageType('Force'),\n        dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 1 },\n      }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n  const policies = new Map<CombatantId, StandingReactionPolicy>();\n  if (policy !== null) policies.set(reactor.id, { opportunityAttack: policy });\n  const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(state, registry, () => 0.5, {\n    turnLegalActions: (_current, actor) => ({\n      actions: actor === mover.id ? [move, { type: 'end_turn', actor }] : [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }],\n    }),\n    reactionLegalActions: () => [opportunityAttack],\n    standingReactionPolicies: policies,\n  });\n  return { coordinator, mover, reactor, reactorHuman };\n}\n\ndescribe('reaction policy windows and local turn coordination', () => {\n  it('standing use resolves an Opportunity Attack without a HumanController prompt', async () => {\n    const fixture = reactionFixture('use');\n    await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    const result = await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    expect(fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest()).toBeNull();\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    if (result.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(result.reason);\n    expect(result.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'resource_spent',\n      'damage_applied',\n      'attack_resolved',\n      'movement_completed',\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('standing decline records the refusal and moves without a HumanController prompt', async () => {\n    const fixture = reactionFixture('decline');\n    await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    const result = await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    expect(fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest()).toBeNull();\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    if (result.kind !== 'applied') throw new Error(result.reason);\n    expect(result.events.map((event) => event.type)).toEqual([\n      'reaction_declined',\n      'movement_completed',\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('ambiguous reaction creates a durable HumanController prompt instead of auto-declining', async () => {\n    const fixture = reactionFixture(null);\n    await fixture.coordinator.step();\n    const pendingStep = fixture.coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const request = fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest();\n    if (request === null || request.kind !== 'reaction') {\n      throw new Error('Ambiguous policy did not create the reaction prompt.');\n    }\n    expect(request.legalActions.actions.map((action) => action.type)).toEqual([\n      'opportunity_attack',\n      'decline_reaction',\n    ]);\n    fixture.reactorHuman.submit({\n      requestId: request.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'decline_reaction', actor: fixture.reactor.id, mover: fixture.mover.id },\n    });\n    const result = await pendingStep;\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'applied' });\n    expect(fixture.reactorHuman.pendingRequest()).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('same seed and controller inputs produce the same complete event stream', async () => {\n    async function run(seed: number) {\n      const left = playerProfile('deterministic-left', { initiativeBonus: 1 });\n      const right = monsterProfile('deterministic-right', { initiativeBonus: 1 });\n      const state = createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n        combatants: [left, right],\n        tokens: [placedToken(left, 0), placedToken(right, 3)],\n      });\n      const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: left.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n        { combatantId: right.id, controller: new AlgorithmController() },\n      ]);\n      const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(state, registry, mulberry32(seed));\n      for (let step = 0; step < 7; step += 1) await coordinator.step();\n      return coordinator.state().eventLog;\n    }\n\n    expect(await run(4242)).toEqual(await run(4242));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/search-memory.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1942","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory pins the last-known position when invisibility makes a target unseen"},{"id":"1943","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory expands the suspicion region by hand-computed grid cells each round"},{"id":"1944","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory forces unseen-target disadvantage when a monster attacks the occupied suspected square"},{"id":"1945","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory automatically misses with disadvantage when the remembered square is empty"},{"id":"1946","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory clears expired memory at the typed round boundary"},{"id":"1947","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory records heavy obscurement as a separate unseen transition cause"},{"id":"1948","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory records a successful Hide as the active search-memory cause"},{"id":"1949","name":"D420 persistent monster-side search memory replays the same seed and command transcript to identical search events"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { canonicalJson } from '../../../src/commands/canonical-json';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, effectStackingIdentity } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst fixedD20 = (face: number) => () => (face - 0.5) / 20;\n\nfunction requiredSearchMemories(state: EncounterState) {\n  if (state.searchMemories === undefined) throw new Error('Expected persisted D420 search memory.');\n  return state.searchMemories;\n}\n\nfunction invisibleSelf(actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>): EncounterCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'apply_effect',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    cost: 'none',\n    effect: {\n      targets: [actor.id],\n      duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n      concentration: false,\n      stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('d420:test-invisible'),\n      stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n      repeatedSave: null,\n      payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Invisible' },\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction invisibleEncounter(): {\n  readonly pc: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>;\n  readonly monster: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n} {\n  const pc = playerProfile('search-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const monster = monsterProfile('searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  let state = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 },\n    combatants: [pc, monster],\n    tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2, 2), placedToken(monster, 0, 2)],\n  });\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, invisibleSelf(pc), fixedD20(10)).state;\n  return { pc, monster, state };\n}\n\nfunction endActiveTurn(state: EncounterState): EncounterState {\n  if (state.activeCombatant === null) throw new Error('The fixture has no active turn.');\n  return reduceEncounter(\n    state,\n    { type: 'end_turn', actor: state.activeCombatant },\n    fixedD20(10),\n  ).state;\n}\n\nfunction damage(amount: number) {\n  return {\n    terms: [{\n      type: damageType('Force'),\n      dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: amount },\n    }],\n    critical: false,\n    responses: [],\n  } as const;\n}\n\ndescribe('D420 persistent monster-side search memory', () => {\n  it('pins the last-known position when invisibility makes a target unseen', () => {\n    const { pc, monster, state } = invisibleEncounter();\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      policy: 'search-memory-v1',\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'invisibility',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      lostAtRound: 1,\n      lastExpandedRound: 1,\n      expires: { kind: 'start_of_round', round: 4 },\n      suspicion: {\n        kind: 'grid_radius',\n        center: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n        radius: 0,\n        cells: [{ column: 2, row: 2 }],\n      },\n    })]);\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'search_memory_recorded',\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'invisibility',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n    }));\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.legalOptions.map((option) => option.kind)).toEqual([\n      'move_and_search',\n      'ready_action',\n      'attack_suspected_square',\n      'area_effect_over_region',\n    ]);\n    const serialized = JSON.stringify(state);\n    const roundTripped = JSON.parse(serialized) as unknown as EncounterState;\n    expect(JSON.stringify(roundTripped)).toBe(serialized);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(roundTripped)).toEqual(requiredSearchMemories(state));\n  });\n\n  it('expands the suspicion region by hand-computed grid cells each round', () => {\n    let { state } = invisibleEncounter();\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n\n    expect(state.round).toBe(2);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion).toEqual({\n      kind: 'grid_radius',\n      center: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      radius: 5,\n      cells: [\n        { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 3, row: 1 },\n        { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 }, { column: 3, row: 2 },\n        { column: 1, row: 3 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }, { column: 3, row: 3 },\n      ],\n    });\n\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    expect(state.round).toBe(3);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.radius).toBe(10);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.cells).toHaveLength(25);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(state)[0]?.suspicion.cells).toEqual(\n      Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_rowValue, row) =>\n        Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_columnValue, column) => ({ column, row }))).flat(),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('forces unseen-target disadvantage when a monster attacks the occupied suspected square', () => {\n    const fixture = invisibleEncounter();\n    const state = endActiveTurn(fixture.state);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack_suspected_square',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damage: damage(0),\n    }, fixedD20(10));\n\n    const attack = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'attack_resolved');\n    const suspected = result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'suspected_square_attacked');\n    expect(attack?.type === 'attack_resolved' ? attack.attack.roll : null).toEqual({\n      mode: 'disadvantage',\n      faces: [10, 10],\n      chosen: 10,\n    });\n    expect(suspected).toMatchObject({\n      type: 'suspected_square_attacked',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      outcome: 'target_present',\n      roll: { mode: 'disadvantage', faces: [10, 10], chosen: 10 },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('automatically misses with disadvantage when the remembered square is empty', () => {\n    const fixture = invisibleEncounter();\n    let state = reduceEncounter(fixture.state, {\n      type: 'move',\n      actor: fixture.pc.id,\n      path: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }],\n      cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n    state = endActiveTurn(state);\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack_suspected_square',\n      actor: fixture.monster.id,\n      suspectedTarget: fixture.pc.id,\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damage: damage(10),\n    }, fixedD20(10));\n\n    expect(result.events.find((event) => event.type === 'suspected_square_attacked')).toMatchObject({\n      type: 'suspected_square_attacked',\n      outcome: 'empty',\n      square: { column: 2, row: 2 },\n      roll: { mode: 'disadvantage', faces: [10, 10], chosen: 10 },\n    });\n    expect(result.events.some((event) => event.type === 'damage_applied')).toBe(false);\n    expect(requiredSearchMemories(result.state)[0]?.lastKnownPosition).toEqual({ column: 2, row: 2 });\n  });\n\n  it('clears expired memory at the typed round boundary', () => {\n    let { state } = invisibleEncounter();\n    while (state.round < 4) state = endActiveTurn(state);\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'search_memory_cleared',\n      reason: 'expired',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('records heavy obscurement as a separate unseen transition cause', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('obscured-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('obscurement-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2), placedToken(monster, 0)],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'world_operation',\n      actor: null,\n      cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'set_obscurement',\n        region: { id: 'd420-heavy', cells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] },\n        obscurement: 'heavy',\n      },\n    }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'obscurement',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n    })]);\n  });\n\n  it('records a successful Hide as the active search-memory cause', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('hidden-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('hide-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2), placedToken(monster, 0)],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'world_operation',\n      actor: null,\n      cost: 'none',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'set_obscurement',\n        region: { id: 'd420-hide-cover', cells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] },\n        obscurement: 'heavy',\n      },\n    }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'hide', actor: pc.id }, fixedD20(15)).state;\n\n    expect(state.eventLog).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'hide_resolved',\n      combatant: pc.id,\n      outcome: 'hidden',\n    }));\n    expect(state.searchMemories).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n      observer: monster.id,\n      target: pc.id,\n      cause: 'hiding',\n      lastKnownPosition: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n    })]);\n  });\n\n  it('replays the same seed and command transcript to identical search events', () => {\n    const run = () => {\n      const pc = playerProfile('deterministic-target', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n      const monster = monsterProfile('deterministic-searcher', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n      const rng = mulberry32(0xD420);\n      let state = createEncounter({\n        bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 },\n        combatants: [pc, monster],\n        tokens: [placedToken(pc, 2, 2), placedToken(monster, 0, 2)],\n      });\n      const transcript: readonly EncounterCommand[] = [\n        { type: 'roll_initiative' },\n        invisibleSelf(pc),\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: pc.id },\n        { type: 'end_turn', actor: monster.id },\n      ];\n      for (const command of transcript) state = reduceEncounter(state, command, rng).state;\n      return state;\n    };\n\n    const first = run();\n    const replayed = run();\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.eventLog)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.eventLog));\n    expect(canonicalJson(replayed.searchMemories)).toBe(canonicalJson(first.searchMemories));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/integration/vtt/monster-on-hit.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1950","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer charge_precondition_unmet: offers the declared base attack without its charge rider"},{"id":"1951","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer squeeze_survives_release: bear grapple carries its DC, ticks at target start, and escape ends grapple plus squeeze"},{"id":"1952","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer applies a real raptor Blinded rider only after its declared DC 15 save fails, then expires at target turn end"},{"id":"1953","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer a real spider Web failure restrains, then Venom Bite stacks Piercing and Poison damage with its Poisoned rider"},{"id":"1954","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer rider_applies_on_miss: the same bear, raptor, and spider attacks deal no damage and apply no effects when they miss"},{"id":"1955","name":"monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer declared_effect_skipped: a real raises_as_zombie declaration refuses loudly until its lifecycle lands"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { combatToken, monsterCombatantProfile, type CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport {\n  monsterAttackCommand,\n  monsterSavingThrowCommand,\n} from '../../../src/combat/monster-commands';\nimport type {\n  MonsterAction,\n  MonsterAttackAction,\n  MonsterSavingThrowAction,\n  MonsterStatblock,\n} from '../../../src/combat/statblock';\nimport {\n  HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER,\n  type HomebrewBeastFamily,\n} from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/homebrew-beast-families';\nimport { STARTER_MONSTER_ROSTER } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/roster';\nimport { regretTurnLegalActions } from '../../../src/vtt/regret/legal-actions';\nimport { playerProfile } from '../../unit/combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction beast(family: HomebrewBeastFamily, challengeRating: 3) {\n  const row = HOMEBREW_BEAST_ROSTER.find((candidate) =>\n    candidate.design.family === family && candidate.design.challengeRating === challengeRating);\n  if (row === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing ${family} CR ${String(challengeRating)} row.`);\n  return row;\n}\n\nfunction actions(statblock: MonsterStatblock): readonly MonsterAction[] {\n  if (statblock.sourceDetails.actions.kind === 'absent') throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no actions.`);\n  return statblock.sourceDetails.actions.value;\n}\n\nfunction attack(statblock: MonsterStatblock, id: string): MonsterAttackAction {\n  const action = actions(statblock).find((candidate): candidate is MonsterAttackAction =>\n    candidate.kind === 'attack' && candidate.id === id);\n  if (action === undefined) throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no attack ${id}.`);\n  return action;\n}\n\nfunction savingThrowAction(statblock: MonsterStatblock, id: string): MonsterSavingThrowAction {\n  const action = actions(statblock).find((candidate): candidate is MonsterSavingThrowAction =>\n    candidate.kind === 'saving_throw' && candidate.id === id);\n  if (action === undefined) throw new Error(`${statblock.name} has no saving-throw action ${id}.`);\n  return action;\n}\n\nfunction knownTarget(key: string): CombatantProfile {\n  const target = playerProfile(key, { hitPoints: 250, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  return {\n    ...target,\n    rules: { ...target.rules, sizeCategory: 'Medium', creatureType: 'Humanoid' },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(statblock: MonsterStatblock, target = knownTarget('monster-rider-target')): {\n  readonly actor: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly target: CombatantProfile;\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n} {\n  const actor = monsterCombatantProfile(statblock, {\n    combatantId: `combatant:${statblock.id}:on-hit`,\n    tokenId: `token:${statblock.id}:on-hit`,\n  });\n  const created = createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' },\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [actor, target],\n    tokens: [combatToken(actor, { column: 0, row: 0 }), combatToken(target, { column: 1, row: 0 })],\n  });\n  return {\n    actor,\n    target,\n    state: reduceEncounter(created, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction hitPoints(state: EncounterState, target: CombatantProfile): number {\n  const subject = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === target.id);\n  if (subject === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing target ${target.id}.`);\n  return subject.hitPoints;\n}\n\nfunction attackEvent(events: readonly EncounterEvent[]) {\n  const event = events.find((candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'attack_resolved' }> =>\n    candidate.type === 'attack_resolved');\n  if (event === undefined) throw new Error('Attack did not resolve.');\n  return event;\n}\n\ndescribe('monster statblock effects execute through the encounter reducer', () => {\n  it('charge_precondition_unmet: offers the declared base attack without its charge rider', () => {\n    // Charge applies only after straight movement immediately before the hit:\n    // docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:22805-22809.\n    const row = beast('pterosaur', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('charge-domain-target'));\n    const declared = attack(row.statblock, 'raking-pass');\n    expect(declared.damage).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      trigger: expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'charge', minimumStraightFeet: 20 }),\n    }));\n    expect(declared.onHit).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'condition', condition: 'Prone', trigger: expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'charge' }),\n    }));\n\n    const command = regretTurnLegalActions(subject.state, subject.actor.id).actions.find(\n      (candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> =>\n        candidate.type === 'attack' && candidate.attackId === 'raking-pass',\n    );\n    if (command === undefined) throw new Error('The pterosaur base attack is missing from the legal domain.');\n    expect(command.damage.terms).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toEqual([]);\n\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(attackEvent(hit.events)).toMatchObject({\n      actor: subject.actor.id,\n      target: subject.target.id,\n      damage: expect.objectContaining({ terms: [expect.objectContaining({ type: 'Piercing' })] }),\n    });\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual(\n      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Prone' }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('squeeze_survives_release: bear grapple carries its DC, ticks at target start, and escape ends grapple plus squeeze', () => {\n    const row = beast('ursine', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('bear-grapple-target'));\n    const command = monsterAttackCommand(\n      attack(row.statblock, 'bear-hug'),\n      subject.actor.id,\n      subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toMatchObject([\n      { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Grappled', escapeDc: 15, duration: 'until_escape' },\n      { kind: 'condition_bound_ongoing_damage', boundCondition: 'Grappled' },\n    ]);\n\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({\n      name: 'Grappled', source: subject.actor.id,\n    });\n    const grapple = hit.state.effects.find((effect) =>\n      effect.payload.kind === 'condition' && effect.payload.condition === 'Grappled');\n    const squeeze = hit.state.effects.find((effect) => effect.payload.kind === 'ongoing_damage');\n    expect(grapple?.escapeCheck).toEqual({ ability: 'strength', skill: 'athletics', dc: 15 });\n    expect(squeeze?.parentEffectId).toBe(grapple?.id);\n\n    const afterHitPoints = hitPoints(hit.state, subject.target);\n    const targetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      hit.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const squeezeDamage = targetStart.events.find((event) =>\n      event.type === 'damage_applied' && event.target === subject.target.id);\n    expect(squeezeDamage).toMatchObject({ source: subject.actor.id, amount: 7 });\n    expect(hitPoints(targetStart.state, subject.target)).toBe(afterHitPoints - 7);\n\n    if (grapple === undefined) throw new Error('Grapple effect was not created.');\n    const escaped = reduceEncounter(targetStart.state, {\n      type: 'roll_ability_check',\n      actor: subject.target.id,\n      ability: 'strength',\n      skill: 'athletics',\n      bonus: 100,\n      dc: 15,\n      rollMode: 'normal',\n      cost: 'action',\n      escapeEffectId: grapple.id,\n    }, () => 0);\n    expect(escaped.state.effects.some((effect) =>\n      effect.id === grapple.id || effect.parentEffectId === grapple.id)).toBe(false);\n    expect(combatantConditions(escaped.state, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual(\n      expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Grappled' }),\n    );\n\n    const afterEscapeHitPoints = hitPoints(escaped.state, subject.target);\n    const nextBearTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      escaped.state,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const nextTargetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      nextBearTurn,\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id },\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    expect(hitPoints(nextTargetStart.state, subject.target)).toBe(afterEscapeHitPoints);\n    expect(nextTargetStart.events.some((event) =>\n      event.type === 'damage_applied' && event.target === subject.target.id)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('applies a real raptor Blinded rider only after its declared DC 15 save fails, then expires at target turn end', () => {\n    const row = beast('raptor', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('blinded-rider-target'));\n    const command = monsterAttackCommand(\n      attack(row.statblock, 'talon-rake'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(command.monsterOnHit).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'condition', condition: 'Blinded',\n      savingThrow: { ability: 'constitution', dc: 15 },\n      duration: 'until_end_of_target_next_turn',\n    }));\n    const hit = reduceEncounter(subject.state, command, () => 0.5);\n    expect(hit.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'save_resolved', target: subject.target.id,\n      ability: 'constitution', dc: 15,\n      save: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'failure' }),\n    }));\n    expect(combatantConditions(hit.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n\n    const targetStart = reduceEncounter(\n      hit.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(targetStart, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n    const targetEnd = reduceEncounter(\n      targetStart, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    expect(combatantConditions(targetEnd, subject.target.id)).not.toContainEqual({ name: 'Blinded' });\n  });\n\n  it('a real spider Web failure restrains, then Venom Bite stacks Piercing and Poison damage with its Poisoned rider', () => {\n    const row = beast('arachnid', 3);\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('spider-rider-target'));\n    const web = monsterSavingThrowCommand(\n      savingThrowAction(row.statblock, 'web'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id,\n    );\n    expect(web.monsterFailureEffects).toMatchObject([\n      { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Restrained', escapeDc: 15, duration: 'until_escape' },\n    ]);\n    const webbed = reduceEncounter(subject.state, web, () => 0);\n    expect(webbed.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'save_resolved', dc: 15, save: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'failure' }),\n    }));\n    expect(combatantConditions(webbed.state, subject.target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n\n    const targetTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      webbed.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.actor.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const nextSpiderTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      targetTurn, { type: 'end_turn', actor: subject.target.id }, () => 0.5,\n    ).state;\n    const beforeBite = hitPoints(nextSpiderTurn, subject.target);\n    const bitten = reduceEncounter(\n      nextSpiderTurn,\n      monsterAttackCommand(attack(row.statblock, 'venom-bite'), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    const resolved = attackEvent(bitten.events);\n    expect(resolved.damage?.terms.map((term) => term.type)).toEqual(['Piercing', 'Poison']);\n    expect(hitPoints(bitten.state, subject.target)).toBe(beforeBite - (resolved.damage?.total ?? 0));\n    expect(combatantConditions(bitten.state, subject.target.id)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      { name: 'Restrained' }, { name: 'Poisoned' },\n    ]));\n  });\n\n  it('rider_applies_on_miss: the same bear, raptor, and spider attacks deal no damage and apply no effects when they miss', () => {\n    for (const [family, actionId] of [\n      ['ursine', 'bear-hug'],\n      ['raptor', 'talon-rake'],\n      ['arachnid', 'venom-bite'],\n    ] as const) {\n      const row = beast(family, 3);\n      const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget(`${family}-miss-target`));\n      const before = hitPoints(subject.state, subject.target);\n      const missed = reduceEncounter(\n        subject.state,\n        monsterAttackCommand(attack(row.statblock, actionId), subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n        () => 0,\n      );\n      expect(attackEvent(missed.events).attack.outcome, family).toBe('miss');\n      expect(hitPoints(missed.state, subject.target), family).toBe(before);\n      expect(missed.state.effects, family).toEqual([]);\n      expect(combatantConditions(missed.state, subject.target.id), family).toEqual([]);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('declared_effect_skipped: a real raises_as_zombie declaration refuses loudly until its lifecycle lands', () => {\n    const row = STARTER_MONSTER_ROSTER.find((candidate) => candidate.id === 'statblock:wight');\n    if (row === undefined) throw new Error('Missing Wight row.');\n    const subject = started(row.statblock, knownTarget('zombie-raise-target'));\n    const lifeDrain = savingThrowAction(row.statblock, 'life-drain');\n    expect(lifeDrain.failure.effects.map((effect) => effect.kind)).toEqual([\n      'hit_point_maximum_reduction', 'raises_as_zombie',\n    ]);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(\n      subject.state,\n      monsterSavingThrowCommand(lifeDrain, subject.actor.id, subject.target.id),\n      () => 0,\n    )).toThrow('raises_as_zombie monster effect has no landed delayed out-of-combat lifecycle');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/stable-dom-render.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1956","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps a pending tray option connected and clickable across live publishes"},{"id":"1957","name":"stable VTT control rendering does not orphan a pressed tray option when a preview rerenders before click"},{"id":"1958","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps controller controls connected while adding a deferred roster member"},{"id":"1959","name":"stable VTT control rendering timeline_rewind_control_replaced: keeps the live rewind button connected while the timeline republishes"},{"id":"1960","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps the encounter pause acknowledgement connected while its state changes"},{"id":"1961","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps a boundary-refusal surface connected while its message republishes"},{"id":"1962","name":"stable VTT control rendering rejects a keyed control whose unkeyed wrapper would still replace it"},{"id":"1963","name":"stable VTT control rendering keeps every short-rest control connected through its keyed form and labels"},{"id":"1964","name":"stable VTT control rendering rejects colliding logical identities before mutating the live tree"},{"id":"1965","name":"stable VTT control rendering encodes every key segment and reports the rejected identity verbatim"},{"id":"1966","name":"stable VTT control rendering uses native attribute names when available and synchronizes additions, changes, and removals"},{"id":"1967","name":"stable VTT control rendering ignores non-string fallback attribute keys"},{"id":"1968","name":"stable VTT control rendering treats an unavailable fallback attribute collection as empty"},{"id":"1969","name":"stable VTT control rendering copies mutable state only when that property exists on both relevant controls"},{"id":"1970","name":"stable VTT control rendering ignores child-shaped non-elements instead of trying to reconcile them"},{"id":"1971","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed button as interactive"},{"id":"1972","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed input as interactive"},{"id":"1973","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed select as interactive"},{"id":"1974","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed textarea as interactive"},{"id":"1975","name":"stable VTT control rendering recognizes an unkeyed summary as interactive"},{"id":"1976","name":"stable VTT control rendering distinguishes linked anchors and tabindex controls from inert lookalikes"},{"id":"1977","name":"stable VTT control rendering reports a duplicate in the live tree before applying the draft"},{"id":"1978","name":"stable VTT control rendering reorders retained nodes, inserts a new node, and removes stale and tag-mismatched nodes"},{"id":"1979","name":"stable VTT control rendering removes a trailing stale node that never occupies a desired index"}],"source":"import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  StableInteractivePathError,\n  StableRenderKeyCollisionError,\n  StableRenderKeyFormatError,\n  reconcileStableRenderedChildren,\n  stableRenderKey,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/stable-dom-render';\nimport {\n  installInteractiveDocument,\n  interactiveElement,\n} from '../../fixtures/interactive-dom';\n\ndescribe('stable VTT control rendering', () => {\n  let restoreDocument: () => void;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => restoreDocument());\n\n  it('keeps a pending tray option connected and clickable across live publishes', () => {\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveTray = document.createElement('section');\n    liveTray.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray');\n    const liveRow = document.createElement('article');\n    liveRow.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7');\n    const liveButton = document.createElement('button');\n    liveButton.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey(\n      'dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7', 'option', 'accept',\n    );\n    const clicked = vi.fn();\n    liveButton.addEventListener('click', clicked);\n    liveRow.append(liveButton);\n    liveTray.append(liveRow);\n    live.append(liveTray);\n    document.body.append(live);\n\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const nextTray = document.createElement('section');\n    nextTray.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray');\n    const nextRow = document.createElement('article');\n    nextRow.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7');\n    const nextButton = document.createElement('button');\n    nextButton.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey(\n      'dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7', 'option', 'accept',\n    );\n    nextButton.textContent = 'Make Opportunity Attack for Vane Spear';\n    nextRow.append(nextButton);\n    nextTray.append(nextRow);\n    draft.append(nextTray);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    const rendered = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey(\n        'dm', 'decision-tray', 'decision', 'reaction-7', 'option', 'accept',\n      )}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(rendered).toBe(interactiveElement(liveButton));\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveButton).isConnected).toBe(true);\n    interactiveElement(liveButton).click();\n    expect(clicked).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n  });\n\n  it('does not orphan a pressed tray option when a preview rerenders before click', () => {\n    const tray = (button: HTMLElement): HTMLElement => {\n      const section = document.createElement('section');\n      section.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'pending-request');\n      section.append(button);\n      return section;\n    };\n    const actionKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'pending-request', 'turn-7', 'move-4-3');\n    const clicked = vi.fn();\n    const liveButton = document.createElement('button');\n    liveButton.dataset.renderKey = actionKey;\n    liveButton.addEventListener('click', clicked);\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveBoard = document.createElement('div');\n    liveBoard.dataset.preview = 'false';\n    live.append(liveBoard, tray(liveButton));\n    document.body.append(live);\n\n    let pointerIsDown = false;\n    let orphanedWhilePressed = false;\n    const pressedTarget = interactiveElement(liveButton);\n    const remove = pressedTarget.remove.bind(pressedTarget);\n    vi.spyOn(pressedTarget, 'remove').mockImplementation(() => {\n      if (pointerIsDown && pressedTarget.isConnected) orphanedWhilePressed = true;\n      remove();\n    });\n    pressedTarget.dispatchEvent(new Event('pointerdown'));\n    pointerIsDown = true;\n\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const previewBoard = document.createElement('div');\n    previewBoard.dataset.preview = 'true';\n    const nextButton = document.createElement('button');\n    nextButton.dataset.renderKey = actionKey;\n    draft.append(previewBoard, tray(nextButton));\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    pressedTarget.dispatchEvent(new Event('pointerup'));\n    pointerIsDown = false;\n    if (!orphanedWhilePressed && pressedTarget.isConnected) pressedTarget.click();\n    expect(orphanedWhilePressed).toBe(false);\n    expect(clicked).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n  });\n\n  it('keeps controller controls connected while adding a deferred roster member', () => {\n    const assignment = (\n      combatantId: string,\n      kind: 'human' | 'algorithm',\n      changed?: () => void,\n    ): HTMLElement => {\n      const row = document.createElement('label');\n      row.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'controller-assignments', combatantId);\n      const select = document.createElement('select');\n      select.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey(\n        'dm', 'controller-assignments', combatantId, 'kind',\n      );\n      select.value = kind;\n      if (changed !== undefined) select.addEventListener('change', changed);\n      row.append(select);\n      return row;\n    };\n    const section = (rows: readonly HTMLElement[]): HTMLElement => {\n      const assignments = document.createElement('section');\n      assignments.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'controller-assignments');\n      assignments.append(...rows);\n      return assignments;\n    };\n\n    const changed = vi.fn();\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const originalRow = assignment('combatant:cinder-guard-a', 'human', changed);\n    const originalSelect = originalRow.children[0];\n    if (originalSelect === undefined) throw new Error('Controller select fixture is missing.');\n    live.append(section([originalRow]));\n    document.body.append(live);\n\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    draft.append(section([\n      assignment('combatant:cinder-guard-a', 'algorithm'),\n      assignment('combatant:cinder-wave-1-a', 'human'),\n    ]));\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    const renderedRow = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey(\n        'dm', 'controller-assignments', 'combatant:cinder-guard-a',\n      )}\"]`,\n    );\n    if (renderedRow === null) throw new Error('Original controller row was not reconciled.');\n    const renderedOriginal = renderedRow.querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey(\n        'dm', 'controller-assignments', 'combatant:cinder-guard-a', 'kind',\n      )}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(renderedOriginal).toBe(interactiveElement(originalSelect as HTMLElement));\n    expect(interactiveElement(originalSelect as HTMLElement).isConnected).toBe(true);\n    expect(Reflect.get(originalSelect, 'value')).toBe('algorithm');\n    const renderedSection = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey('dm', 'controller-assignments')}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(renderedSection?.children).toHaveLength(2);\n    interactiveElement(originalSelect as HTMLElement).dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));\n    expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n  });\n\n  it('timeline_rewind_control_replaced: keeps the live rewind button connected while the timeline republishes', () => {\n    const timeline = (revision: number, button?: HTMLElement): HTMLElement => {\n      const section = document.createElement('section');\n      section.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'initiative-timeline');\n      const rewind = document.createElement('div');\n      rewind.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'initiative-timeline', 'rewind');\n      const control = button ?? document.createElement('button');\n      control.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey(\n        'dm', 'initiative-timeline', 'rewind', 'round-1',\n      );\n      control.setAttribute('data-revision', String(revision));\n      rewind.append(control);\n      section.append(rewind);\n      return section;\n    };\n    const clicked = vi.fn();\n    const liveButton = document.createElement('button');\n    liveButton.addEventListener('click', clicked);\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    live.append(timeline(2, liveButton));\n    document.body.append(live);\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    draft.append(timeline(9));\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    const rendered = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey(\n        'dm', 'initiative-timeline', 'rewind', 'round-1',\n      )}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(rendered).toBe(interactiveElement(liveButton));\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveButton).isConnected).toBe(true);\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveButton).getAttribute('data-revision')).toBe('9');\n    interactiveElement(liveButton).click();\n    expect(clicked).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n  });\n\n  it('keeps the encounter pause acknowledgement connected while its state changes', () => {\n    const status = (pause: 'none' | 'interrupted'): HTMLElement => {\n      const node = document.createElement('p');\n      node.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'encounter-status');\n      node.dataset.pause = pause;\n      node.textContent = pause === 'none' ? 'Encounter running' : 'Paused: interrupted';\n      return node;\n    };\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveStatus = status('interrupted');\n    live.append(liveStatus);\n    document.body.append(live);\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    draft.append(status('none'));\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    const rendered = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey('dm', 'encounter-status')}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(rendered).toBe(interactiveElement(liveStatus));\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveStatus).getAttribute('data-pause')).toBe('none');\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveStatus).textContent).toBe('Encounter running');\n  });\n\n  it('keeps a boundary-refusal surface connected while its message republishes', () => {\n    const refusal = (text: string): HTMLElement => {\n      const node = document.createElement('p');\n      node.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray', 'boundary-refusal');\n      node.dataset.refusalCode = 'turn_boundary_blocked';\n      node.textContent = text;\n      return node;\n    };\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveRefusal = refusal('first boundary message');\n    live.append(liveRefusal);\n    document.body.append(live);\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    draft.append(refusal('current boundary message'));\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    const rendered = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey('dm', 'decision-tray', 'boundary-refusal')}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(rendered).toBe(interactiveElement(liveRefusal));\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveRefusal).textContent).toBe('current boundary message');\n  });\n\n  it('rejects a keyed control whose unkeyed wrapper would still replace it', () => {\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const form = document.createElement('form');\n    const button = document.createElement('button');\n    button.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'short-rest', 'submit');\n    form.append(button);\n    draft.append(form);\n\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableInteractivePathError>>({\n        name: 'StableInteractivePathError',\n        code: 'unstable_interactive_render_path',\n        interactiveTag: 'BUTTON',\n        unkeyedTag: 'FORM',\n        tree: 'draft',\n        message: 'Interactive BUTTON has an unkeyed FORM ancestor in the draft tree.',\n      }),\n    );\n    expect(live.children).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it('keeps every short-rest control connected through its keyed form and labels', () => {\n    const renderRest = (room: number, submit?: HTMLElement): HTMLElement => {\n      const roomKey = `room-${String(room)}`;\n      const rest = document.createElement('form');\n      rest.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'short-rest', roomKey);\n      const label = document.createElement('label');\n      label.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'short-rest', roomKey, 'mirel', 'd8', 'label');\n      const input = document.createElement('input');\n      input.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'short-rest', roomKey, 'mirel', 'd8', 'input');\n      label.append(input);\n      const button = submit ?? document.createElement('button');\n      button.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'short-rest', roomKey, 'submit');\n      rest.append(label, button);\n      return rest;\n    };\n    const clicked = vi.fn();\n    const liveButton = document.createElement('button');\n    liveButton.addEventListener('click', clicked);\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    live.append(renderRest(2, liveButton));\n    document.body.append(live);\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    draft.append(renderRest(2));\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    const rendered = interactiveElement(live).querySelector(\n      `[data-render-key=\"${stableRenderKey('dm', 'short-rest', 'room-2', 'submit')}\"]`,\n    );\n    expect(rendered).toBe(interactiveElement(liveButton));\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveButton).isConnected).toBe(true);\n    interactiveElement(liveButton).click();\n    expect(clicked).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();\n\n    const nextRoom = document.createElement('main');\n    nextRoom.append(renderRest(3));\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, nextRoom);\n    expect(interactiveElement(liveButton).isConnected).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('rejects colliding logical identities before mutating the live tree', () => {\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const first = document.createElement('button');\n    const second = document.createElement('button');\n    const collision = stableRenderKey('dm', 'controls', 'interrupt');\n    first.dataset.renderKey = collision;\n    second.dataset.renderKey = collision;\n    draft.append(first, second);\n\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableRenderKeyCollisionError>>({\n        name: 'StableRenderKeyCollisionError',\n        code: 'duplicate_stable_render_key',\n        key: collision,\n        tree: 'draft',\n      }),\n    );\n    expect(live.children).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it('encodes every key segment and reports the rejected identity verbatim', () => {\n    expect(stableRenderKey('dm controls', 'turn/7', 'option:accept')).toBe(\n      'dm%20controls:turn%2F7:option%3Aaccept',\n    );\n\n    expect(() => stableRenderKey('dm', '', 'accept')).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableRenderKeyFormatError>>({\n        name: 'StableRenderKeyFormatError',\n        code: 'invalid_stable_render_key',\n        key: 'dm::accept',\n        message: 'Stable render key dm::accept must contain a namespace and logical identity.',\n      }),\n    );\n\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const malformed = document.createElement('div');\n    malformed.dataset.renderKey = 'missing-namespace';\n    draft.append(malformed);\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableRenderKeyFormatError>>({\n        key: 'missing-namespace',\n      }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('uses native attribute names when available and synchronizes additions, changes, and removals', () => {\n    const removed: string[] = [];\n    const installNativeAttributes = (\n      element: HTMLElement,\n      initial: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,\n    ): Map<string, string> => {\n      const values = new Map(Object.entries(initial));\n      Object.defineProperty(element, 'attributes', { configurable: true, value: {} });\n      Reflect.set(element, 'getAttributeNames', () => [...values.keys()]);\n      Reflect.set(element, 'getAttribute', (name: string) => values.get(name) ?? null);\n      Reflect.set(element, 'setAttribute', (name: string, value: string) => values.set(name, value));\n      Reflect.set(element, 'removeAttribute', (name: string) => {\n        removed.push(name);\n        values.delete(name);\n      });\n      return values;\n    };\n    const liveRoot = document.createElement('main');\n    const draftRoot = document.createElement('main');\n    const live = document.createElement('div');\n    const draft = document.createElement('div');\n    const key = stableRenderKey('dm', 'native-attributes');\n    live.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    draft.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    const liveAttributes = installNativeAttributes(live, {\n      'data-render-key': key,\n      'data-retained': 'old',\n      'data-stale': 'remove-me',\n    });\n    installNativeAttributes(draft, {\n      'data-render-key': key,\n      'data-retained': 'new',\n      'aria-label': 'current label',\n    });\n    liveRoot.append(live);\n    draftRoot.append(draft);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(liveRoot, draftRoot);\n\n    expect(Object.fromEntries(liveAttributes)).toEqual({\n      'data-render-key': key,\n      'data-retained': 'new',\n      'aria-label': 'current label',\n    });\n    expect(removed).toEqual(['data-stale']);\n  });\n\n  it('ignores non-string fallback attribute keys', () => {\n    const key = stableRenderKey('dm', 'fallback-attributes');\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveChild = document.createElement('div');\n    liveChild.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    live.append(liveChild);\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const draftChild = document.createElement('div');\n    draftChild.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    draft.append(draftChild);\n    expect(Reflect.apply(\n      Map.prototype.set,\n      interactiveElement(draftChild).attributes,\n      [17, 'numeric'],\n    )).toBe(interactiveElement(draftChild).attributes);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    expect(Reflect.apply(Map.prototype.has, interactiveElement(liveChild).attributes, [17])).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('treats an unavailable fallback attribute collection as empty', () => {\n    const key = stableRenderKey('dm', 'no-attribute-collection');\n    const liveRoot = document.createElement('main');\n    const draftRoot = document.createElement('main');\n    const live = document.createElement('div');\n    const draft = document.createElement('div');\n    live.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    draft.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    live.setAttribute('Stryker was here', 'must be removed');\n    const liveValues = interactiveElement(live).attributes;\n    Object.defineProperty(draft, 'attributes', { configurable: true, value: {} });\n    Reflect.set(draft, 'getAttribute', () => null);\n    liveRoot.append(live);\n    draftRoot.append(draft);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(liveRoot, draftRoot);\n\n    expect(liveValues).toEqual(new Map());\n  });\n\n  it('copies mutable state only when that property exists on both relevant controls', () => {\n    const key = stableRenderKey('dm', 'stateful-control');\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const liveControl = document.createElement('input');\n    liveControl.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    liveControl.disabled = false;\n    liveControl.hidden = false;\n    liveControl.checked = true;\n    Reflect.set(liveControl, 'selected', false);\n    liveControl.value = 'old';\n    live.append(liveControl);\n\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const draftControl = document.createElement('input');\n    draftControl.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    draftControl.disabled = true;\n    draftControl.hidden = true;\n    draftControl.checked = false;\n    Reflect.set(draftControl, 'selected', true);\n    draftControl.value = 'new';\n    Reflect.deleteProperty(draftControl, 'checked');\n    Reflect.deleteProperty(liveControl, 'selected');\n    draft.append(draftControl);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    expect(liveControl).toMatchObject({\n      disabled: true,\n      hidden: true,\n      checked: true,\n      value: 'new',\n    });\n    expect('selected' in liveControl).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('ignores child-shaped non-elements instead of trying to reconcile them', () => {\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    expect(Reflect.apply(Array.prototype.push, interactiveElement(draft).children, [\n      null,\n      { tagName: 'DIV' },\n      { append: (): void => undefined },\n    ])).toBe(3);\n\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).not.toThrow();\n    expect(live.children).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it.each(['button', 'input', 'select', 'textarea', 'summary'])(\n    'recognizes an unkeyed %s as interactive',\n    (tag) => {\n      const live = document.createElement('main');\n      const draft = document.createElement('main');\n      draft.append(document.createElement(tag));\n      expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n        expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableInteractivePathError>>({\n          interactiveTag: tag.toUpperCase(),\n          unkeyedTag: tag.toUpperCase(),\n          tree: 'draft',\n        }),\n      );\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('distinguishes linked anchors and tabindex controls from inert lookalikes', () => {\n    const reconcileOne = (element: HTMLElement): void => {\n      const live = document.createElement('main');\n      const draft = document.createElement('main');\n      draft.append(element);\n      reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n    };\n    const inertAnchor = document.createElement('a');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(inertAnchor)).not.toThrow();\n    const linkedAnchor = document.createElement('a');\n    linkedAnchor.setAttribute('href', '/encounter');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(linkedAnchor)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining({ interactiveTag: 'A' }),\n    );\n    const hrefDiv = document.createElement('div');\n    hrefDiv.setAttribute('href', '/not-a-link');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(hrefDiv)).not.toThrow();\n    const tabStop = document.createElement('div');\n    tabStop.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(tabStop)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining({ interactiveTag: 'DIV' }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('reports a duplicate in the live tree before applying the draft', () => {\n    const collision = stableRenderKey('dm', 'live-collision');\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) {\n      const child = document.createElement('div');\n      child.dataset.renderKey = collision;\n      live.append(child);\n    }\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableRenderKeyCollisionError>>({\n        key: collision,\n        tree: 'live',\n        message: `Stable render key ${collision} is duplicated in the live tree.`,\n      }),\n    );\n    expect(live.children).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n\n  it('reorders retained nodes, inserts a new node, and removes stale and tag-mismatched nodes', () => {\n    const keyed = (tag: 'div' | 'section', identity: string): HTMLElement => {\n      const element = document.createElement(tag);\n      element.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', identity);\n      return element;\n    };\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const first = keyed('div', 'first');\n    const second = keyed('div', 'second');\n    const stale = keyed('div', 'stale');\n    const wrongTag = keyed('div', 'replace-tag');\n    live.append(first, second, stale, wrongTag);\n    const firstRemove = vi.spyOn(interactiveElement(first), 'remove');\n    const insertBefore = vi.spyOn(interactiveElement(live), 'insertBefore');\n    document.body.append(live);\n\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const nextSecond = keyed('div', 'second');\n    nextSecond.textContent = 'second-current';\n    const nextFirst = keyed('div', 'first');\n    const inserted = keyed('div', 'inserted');\n    const replacement = keyed('section', 'replace-tag');\n    draft.append(nextSecond, nextFirst, inserted, replacement);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    expect(Array.from(live.children)).toEqual([second, first, inserted, replacement]);\n    expect(second.textContent).toBe('second-current');\n    expect(stale.isConnected).toBe(false);\n    expect(wrongTag.isConnected).toBe(false);\n    expect(first.isConnected).toBe(true);\n    expect(second.isConnected).toBe(true);\n    expect(firstRemove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(insertBefore).toHaveBeenCalledWith(interactiveElement(inserted), null);\n  });\n\n  it('removes a trailing stale node that never occupies a desired index', () => {\n    const key = stableRenderKey('dm', 'retained');\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const retained = document.createElement('div');\n    retained.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    const trailing = document.createElement('aside');\n    trailing.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'trailing-stale');\n    live.append(retained, trailing);\n    document.body.append(live);\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const desired = document.createElement('div');\n    desired.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    draft.append(desired);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    expect(Array.from(live.children)).toEqual([retained]);\n    expect(trailing.isConnected).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/tools/scrape-content-pack.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1980","name":"scraper content-pack emission reports every synthetic page as emitted or unemitted with one reason at"},{"id":"2017","name":"scraper content-pack emission numeric operation boundary: die sides maximum above"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { loadContentPackBytes } from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport {\n  buildContentPackDocuments,\n  mapParsedSpellToContentPack,\n  type ContentPackUnemittedReason,\n} from '../../../tools/scrape/build-content-pack';\nimport type { BuiltPage } from '../../../tools/scrape/build-catalog';\nimport type { QueueItem } from '../../../tools/scrape/queue';\nimport { parseSpellPage } from '../../../tools/scrape/parse-spell';\nimport { SCRAPE_SENTINEL } from '../../../tools/scrape/provenance';\nimport { syntheticSpellPage } from '../../fixtures/scrape/synthetic-pages';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ninterface SyntheticSpellInput {\n  readonly title: string;\n  readonly descriptor: string;\n  readonly castingTime: string;\n  readonly range: string;\n  readonly components: string;\n  readonly duration: string;\n  readonly body: readonly string[];\n  readonly tags: readonly string[];\n}\n\nconst ATTACK_DESCRIPTION =\n  'Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within range. On a hit, that creature takes 2d6 Fire damage.';\nconst SAVE_DESCRIPTION =\n  'One creature within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, that creature takes 3d4 Thunder damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.';\n\nfunction syntheticInput(overrides: Partial<SyntheticSpellInput> = {}): SyntheticSpellInput {\n  return {\n    title: 'Ember Needle',\n    descriptor: 'Level 1 Evocation (Wizard)',\n    castingTime: 'Action',\n    range: '60 feet',\n    components: 'V, S',\n    duration: 'Instantaneous',\n    body: [ATTACK_DESCRIPTION],\n    tags: ['evocation', 'wizard'],\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction parsedPage(overrides: Partial<SyntheticSpellInput> = {}): BuiltPage {\n  const input = syntheticInput(overrides);\n  const parsed = parseSpellPage(syntheticSpellPage({\n    ...input,\n    source: \"Cartographer's Almanac\",\n  }), { edition: '2024', slug: `spell:${input.title.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-')}` });\n  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.reason);\n  return {\n    url: `http://example.invalid/spell:${input.title.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-')}`,\n    record: parsed.value.record,\n    description: parsed.value.description,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction expectReason(page: BuiltPage, reason: ContentPackUnemittedReason): void {\n  expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(page.record, page.description)).toEqual({\n    status: 'unemitted',\n    reason,\n  });\n}\n\nconst ATTACK_PAGE = parsedPage();\nconst SAVE_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Hollow Pulse',\n  descriptor: 'Level 2 Evocation (Cleric)',\n  body: [SAVE_DESCRIPTION],\n  tags: ['cleric', 'evocation'],\n});\nconst AMBIGUOUS_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Barbed Ember Needle',\n  body: [`${ATTACK_DESCRIPTION} The target also glows until dawn.`],\n});\nconst UNMAPPED_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Quiet Compass',\n  descriptor: 'Level 1 Divination (Wizard)',\n  body: ['A tiny invented compass points toward the last doorway you touched.'],\n  tags: ['divination', 'wizard'],\n});\nconst OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Patient Ember Needle',\n  castingTime: '1 minute',\n});\nconst SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET = [\n  ATTACK_PAGE,\n  SAVE_PAGE,\n  AMBIGUOUS_PAGE,\n  UNMAPPED_PAGE,\n  OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE,\n] as const;\n\nfunction doneQueue(\n  pages: readonly BuiltPage[],\n  extraUrls: readonly string[] = [],\n): QueueItem[] {\n  return [...pages.map((page) => page.url), ...extraUrls].map((url) => ({\n    url,\n    lastmod: null,\n    state: 'done',\n    reason: null,\n  }));\n}\n\ndescribe('scraper content-pack emission', () => {\n  it('reports every synthetic page as emitted or unemitted with one reason enum', () => {\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({\n      pages: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n      queue: doneQueue(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET),\n      parseFailures: [],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    });\n\n    expect(output.report).toEqual({\n      provenance: SCRAPE_SENTINEL,\n      pagesSeen: 5,\n      partial: false,\n      skippedQueueItems: [],\n      emitted: 2,\n      unemitted: 3,\n      unemittedByReason: {\n        'ambiguous-parameters': 1,\n        'out-of-combat': 1,\n        'parse-failure': 0,\n        'unmapped-vocabulary': 1,\n      },\n      unemittedPages: [\n        {\n          url: AMBIGUOUS_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: AMBIGUOUS_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'ambiguous-parameters',\n        },\n        {\n          url: UNMAPPED_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: UNMAPPED_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'unmapped-vocabulary',\n        },\n        {\n          url: OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'out-of-combat',\n        },\n      ].sort((left, right) => left.url.localeCompare(right.url)),\n    });\n    expect(loadContentPackBytes(output.packBytes).status).toBe('loaded');\n    expect(output.pack.namespaces).toEqual(['scraped.wikidot']);\n    expect(output.packBytes).toContain(SCRAPE_SENTINEL);\n  });\n\n  it('is byte-identical across repeated builds and independent of input order', () => {\n    const input = {\n      pages: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n      queue: doneQueue(\n        SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n        ['http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished'],\n      ),\n      parseFailures: [{ url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished', reason: 'synthetic parse miss' }],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    } as const;\n    const first = buildContentPackDocuments(input);\n    const second = buildContentPackDocuments(input);\n    const reversed = buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, pages: [...input.pages].reverse() });\n\n    expect(second.packBytes).toBe(first.packBytes);\n    expect(second.reportBytes).toBe(first.reportBytes);\n    expect(reversed.packBytes).toBe(first.packBytes);\n    expect(reversed.reportBytes).toBe(first.reportBytes);\n    expect(first.report.unemittedByReason['parse-failure']).toBe(1);\n    expect(first.report.unemittedPages).toContainEqual({\n      url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished',\n      recordId: null,\n      reason: 'parse-failure',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('partial_emission_silent: refuses pending work and reports it when partial emission is explicit', () => {\n    const pending: QueueItem = {\n      url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:not-fetched',\n      lastmod: null,\n      state: 'pending',\n      reason: 'awaiting fetch',\n    };\n    const input = {\n      pages: [ATTACK_PAGE],\n      queue: [...doneQueue([ATTACK_PAGE]), pending],\n      parseFailures: [],\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    } as const;\n\n    expect(() => buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, allowPartial: false }))\n      .toThrow(/pending\\s+http:\\/\\/example\\.invalid\\/spell:not-fetched/u);\n\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, allowPartial: true });\n    expect(output.report.partial).toBe(true);\n    expect(output.report.skippedQueueItems).toEqual([{\n      url: pending.url,\n      state: 'pending',\n      reason: 'awaiting fetch',\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('roundtrip_not_executed: imports and executes an emitted operation in an encounter', () => {\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({\n      pages: [ATTACK_PAGE],\n      queue: doneQueue([ATTACK_PAGE]),\n      parseFailures: [],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    });\n    const loaded = loadContentPackBytes(output.packBytes);\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(loaded.refusal.reason);\n\n    const caster = playerProfile('scrape-pack-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 20,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('scrape-pack-target', {\n      initiativeBonus: -20,\n      hitPoints: 20,\n    });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [caster, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(target, 1)],\n      contentPacks: [loaded.content],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'cast_spell',\n      actor: caster.id,\n      spellId: 'scraped.wikidot:scraped-ember-needle',\n      slotLevel: 1,\n      castAsRitual: false,\n      casterLevel: 3,\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      saveDc: 13,\n      spellcastingModifier: 3,\n      targets: [target.id],\n      area: null,\n      weaponAttack: null,\n      selectedOption: null,\n    }, () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(result.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'spell_cast',\n      spellId: 'scraped.wikidot:scraped-ember-needle',\n    }));\n    expect(result.state.combatants.find(({ profile }) => profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(12);\n  });\n\n  it('approximate_mapping_accepted: refuses an otherwise exact operation with one extra rider clause', () => {\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: `${ATTACK_PAGE.description} The target also glows until dawn.` },\n      'ambiguous-parameters',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('refusal_reason_collapsed: preserves each specific refusal reason', () => {\n    const ambiguous = { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: `${ATTACK_PAGE.description} It also moves.` };\n    const unmapped = { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: 'A harmless invented marker appears nearby.' };\n    const outOfCombat = {\n      ...ATTACK_PAGE,\n      record: { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, castingTime: '1 minute' },\n    };\n    expectReason(ambiguous, 'ambiguous-parameters');\n    expectReason(unmapped, 'unmapped-vocabulary');\n    expectReason(outOfCombat, 'out-of-combat');\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['casting time', { castingTime: '1 minute' }, 'out-of-combat'],\n    ['unknown casting vocabulary', { castingTime: 'Swift Action' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['material consumption', { components: 'V, S, M (an invented copper spiral)' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['unknown component', { components: 'V, X' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['duplicate component', { components: 'V, V' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['empty components', { components: '' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['unstructured range', { range: 'about 60 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['pluralized one-foot range', { range: '1 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['non-instantaneous duration', { duration: '1 round' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['concentration', { concentration: true }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing casting time', { castingTime: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing range', { range: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing components', { components: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing duration', { duration: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['invalid record id', { identityKey: 'Not An Identifier' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n  ] as const)(\n    'distinguishing metadata input: %s differs only in the deciding field',\n    (_label, change, reason) => {\n      expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n      expectReason({ ...ATTACK_PAGE, record: { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, ...change } }, reason);\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('distinguishes attack and save vocabulary from unknown or incomplete vocabulary', () => {\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(SAVE_PAGE.record, SAVE_PAGE.description)).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'emitted',\n      spell: { operation: { kind: 'save_damage', ability: 'dexterity', onSuccess: 'half' } },\n    });\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: ATTACK_PAGE.description.replace('Fire damage', 'Dream damage') },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n    expectReason(\n      { ...SAVE_PAGE, description: SAVE_PAGE.description.replace('Dexterity', 'Luck') },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n
