ControllerRequest } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { ControllerRegistry } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport {\n  combatantsAreAllies,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  SUMMON_INITIATIVE_RULE,\n  TargetSelectionRuleError,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { SpellCastCommand } from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { loadContentPack, type LoadedContentPack } from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ninterface MutablePackFixture {\n  spells: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  monsters: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nconst summonOperation = (\n  count: { readonly kind: 'fixed'; readonly count: number } | {\n    readonly kind: 'slot_scaled'; readonly base: number; readonly additionalPerSlot: number;\n  } = { kind: 'fixed', count: 1 },\n) => ({\n  kind: 'summon', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote',\n  count: count.kind === 'fixed' ? count : { ...count, limit: 'exact' },\n  placementRangeFeet: 30,\n  lifecycle: { concentration: true, durationRounds: 10, expiresAt: 'source_start' },\n});\n\nfunction fixture(): MutablePackFixture {\n  return JSON.parse(readFileSync('tests/fixtures/content-pack-v1-homebrew.json', 'utf8')) as MutablePackFixture;\n}\n\nfunction packWithOperation(operation: unknown): ReturnType<typeof loadContentPack> {\n  const source = fixture();\n  const template = source.spells[0];\n  if (template === undefined) throw new Error('Summon fixture spell template is missing.');\n  source.spells = [{\n    ...template,\n    recordId: 'call-brassleaf',\n    name: 'Call Brassleaf',\n    level: 2,\n    range: { kind: 'feet', feet: 30 },\n    duration: { kind: 'rounds', rounds: 10 },\n    concentration: true,\n    targeting: { kind: 'utility', rangeFeet: 30 },\n    operation,\n  }];\n  return loadContentPack(source);\n}\n\nfunction loadedPack(operation: unknown = summonOperation()): LoadedContentPack {\n  const result = packWithOperation(operation);\n  if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Summon pack refused: ${result.refusal.reason}`);\n  expect(result.content.diagnostics).toEqual([]);\n  return result.content;\n}\n\nfunction summonCommand(\n  caster: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n  destinations: NonNullable<SpellCastCommand['summonDestinations']>,\n  slotLevel = 2,\n): SpellCastCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'cast_spell', actor: caster.id, spellId: 'greenforge:call-brassleaf',\n    slotLevel, castAsRitual: false, casterLevel: 7, attackBonus: 7, saveDc: 15,\n    spellcastingModifier: 4, targets: [], area: null, summonDestinations: destinations,\n    weaponAttack: null, selectedOption: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(\n  content: LoadedContentPack,\n  spellSlots: readonly { readonly level: 2 | 3; readonly maximum: number }[] = [{ level: 2, maximum: 2 }],\n): { readonly caster: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>; readonly enemy: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>; readonly state: EncounterState } {\n  const caster = playerProfile('summoner', { initiativeBonus: 20, spellSlots });\n  const enemy = monsterProfile('summon-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 30 });\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [caster, enemy], tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(enemy, 10)],\n    contentPacks: [content],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { caster, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction summonedId(state: EncounterState): CombatantId {\n  const id = state.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? [])[0];\n  if (id === undefined) throw new Error('Expected an effect-owned summoned combatant.');\n  return id;\n}\n\ndescribe('D348.1 imported summoned entities', () => {\n  it('summon_skips_initiative: loads the pack statblock and inserts each upcast summon on the summoner count immediately after them', () => {\n    // Giant Insect shares the caster's count and acts immediately after them:\n    // docs/srd/source/spell-descriptions.txt:3714-3716.\n    expect(SUMMON_INITIATIVE_RULE).toBe('summoner_count_immediately_after');\n    const content = loadedPack(summonOperation({ kind: 'slot_scaled', base: 1, additionalPerSlot: 1 }));\n    const fixtureState = started(content, [{ level: 3, maximum: 1 }]);\n    const cast = reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ], 3), () => 0).state;\n    const summons = cast.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? []);\n\n    expect(summons).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(cast.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([\n      fixtureState.caster.id, ...summons, fixtureState.enemy.id,\n    ]);\n    expect(cast.initiative.slice(0, 3).map((entry) => ({ total: entry.total, slot: entry.slot })))\n      .toEqual([{ total: 21, slot: 0 }, { total: 21, slot: 0 }, { total: 21, slot: 0 }]);\n    for (const id of summons) {\n      const summon = cast.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === id);\n      expect(summon).toMatchObject({\n        hitPoints: 9,\n        profile: {\n          name: 'Brassleaf Mote', statblockId: 'greenforge:brassleaf-mote',\n          rules: { armorClass: 12, speed: 30 },\n        },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('summon_count_boundary_and_placement_edge: exact count and 30-foot edge place; one over and an illegal cell refuse atomically', () => {\n    const content = loadedPack(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 2 }));\n    const fixtureState = started(content);\n    const exact = reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0);\n    expect(exact.state.effects.flatMap((effect) => effect.ownedCombatants ?? [])).toHaveLength(2);\n\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 6, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 }, { column: 4, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0)).toThrow(TargetSelectionRuleError);\n    expect(() => reduceEncounter(fixtureState.state, summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [\n      { column: 7, row: 0 }, { column: 5, row: 1 },\n    ]), () => 0)).toThrow('summon destination is out of range');\n    expect(fixtureState.state.combatants).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n\n  it('summon_survives_effect_end and despawn_leaves_corpse: concentration end removes a living summon and a dead summon corpse token', () => {\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    const cast = reduceEncounter(\n      fixtureState.state,\n      summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(cast);\n    const dead = reduceEncounter(cast, {\n      type: 'adjudicate', target: summon, subject: 'lethal test damage', reasoning: 'fixture',\n      consequence: { kind: 'hit_point_delta', amount: -9 },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(dead.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)?.life).toBe('dead');\n    expect(dead.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(true);\n    const despawned = reduceEncounter(dead, { type: 'end_concentration', actor: fixtureState.caster.id }, () => 0);\n    expect(despawned.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'summoned_combatant_despawned', combatant: summon,\n    }));\n    expect(despawned.state.combatants.some((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)).toBe(false);\n    expect(despawned.state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('despawn_before_active_preserves_turn_identity_and_advances_to_the_next_combatant', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('shift-summoner', {\n      initiativeBonus: 20,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const activeEnemy = monsterProfile('shift-active-enemy', { initiativeBonus: 0, hitPoints: 30 });\n    const nextEnemy = monsterProfile('shift-next-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -10, hitPoints: 30 });\n    let state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n      config: { initiativeMode: 'per_combatant' }, bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [caster, activeEnemy, nextEnemy],\n      tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(activeEnemy, 10), placedToken(nextEnemy, 11)],\n      contentPacks: [loadedPack()],\n    }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      summonCommand(caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(state);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: summon }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(activeEnemy.id);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'force_save', actor: activeEnemy.id, target: caster.id,\n      ability: 'dexterity', dc: 30, rollMode: 'normal',\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 1 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n      onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n    }, () => 0).state;\n\n    expect(state.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([\n      caster.id, activeEnemy.id, nextEnemy.id,\n    ]);\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(activeEnemy.id);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: activeEnemy.id }, () => 0).state;\n    expect(state.activeCombatant).toBe(nextEnemy.id);\n  });\n\n  it('distinguishing_despawn_vs_death_and_enemy_target: a summon is allied to its summoner, hostile to the enemy, and remains targetable after taking lethal damage', () => {\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    let state = reduceEncounter(\n      fixtureState.state,\n      summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]),\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const summon = summonedId(state);\n    expect(combatantsAreAllies(state, fixtureState.caster.id, summon)).toBe(true);\n    expect(combatantsAreAllies(state, fixtureState.enemy.id, summon)).toBe(false);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixtureState.caster.id }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: summon }, () => 0).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'attack', actor: fixtureState.enemy.id, target: summon, attackBonus: 100,\n      criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal', attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: 9 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(state.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === summon)?.life).toBe('dead');\n    expect(state.tokens.some((token) => token.combatantId === summon)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_monster_id_summons: rejects only a summon spell whose monster id is absent and loads the rest of the pack', () => {\n    const source = fixture();\n    const healthy = source.spells[0];\n    if (healthy === undefined) throw new Error('Healthy spell fixture is missing.');\n    source.spells = [healthy, {\n      ...healthy, recordId: 'missing-summon', name: 'Missing Summon', level: 2,\n      targeting: { kind: 'utility', rangeFeet: 30 },\n      operation: { ...summonOperation(), monsterId: 'absent-monster' },\n    }];\n    const result = loadContentPack(source);\n    expect(result.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Record-isolated load unexpectedly refused the pack.');\n    expect(result.content.spells.map((spell) => spell.recordId)).toEqual(['prism-pebble']);\n    expect(result.content.monsters.map((monster) => monster.recordId)).toEqual(['brassleaf-mote']);\n    expect(result.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'missing_monster_reference', recordId: 'missing-summon',\n      monsterId: 'greenforge:absent-monster',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('summon_import_count_boundary: accepts 100 and rejects 101 without dropping healthy monster records', () => {\n    expect(packWithOperation(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 100 })).status).toBe('loaded');\n    const over = packWithOperation(summonOperation({ kind: 'fixed', count: 101 }));\n    expect(over.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (over.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('One malformed spell should not refuse its pack.');\n    expect(over.content.spells).toEqual([]);\n    expect(over.content.monsters).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(over.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ reason: 'malformed_record' }));\n  });\n\n  it('on_kill_spawn_refusal: names the excluded on-kill spawning shape instead of treating it as this summon operation', () => {\n    const result = packWithOperation({\n      kind: 'on_kill_spawn', monsterId: 'brassleaf-mote', trigger: 'creature_killed',\n    });\n    expect(result.status).toBe('loaded');\n    if (result.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error('Excluded operation should reject its record only.');\n    expect(result.content.diagnostics).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      reason: 'on-kill-spawn-not-modelled', recordId: 'call-brassleaf',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('summoner_controller_seam: the summoned turn is requested from the exact controller that cast the spell', async () => {\n    class RecordingController implements Controller {\n      readonly actors: CombatantId[] = [];\n      choose(request: ControllerRequest): Promise<ControllerDecision> {\n        this.actors.push(request.actorId);\n        const action = request.legalActions.actions[0];\n        if (action === undefined) throw new Error('Recording controller received no legal action.');\n        return Promise.resolve({\n          requestId: request.requestId,\n          encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n          action,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const fixtureState = started(loadedPack());\n    const summonerController = new RecordingController();\n    const enemyController = new RecordingController();\n    const registry = new ControllerRegistry([\n      { combatantId: fixtureState.caster.id, controller: summonerController, controllerId: 'controller:summoner' },\n      { combatantId: fixtureState.enemy.id, controller: enemyController, controllerId: 'controller:enemy' },\n    ]);\n    const cast = summonCommand(fixtureState.caster, [{ column: 6, row: 0 }]);\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(fixtureState.state, registry, () => 0, {\n      turnLegalActions: (state, actor) => ({ actions:\n        actor === fixtureState.caster.id && state.effects.length === 0\n          ? [cast]\n          : [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }],\n      }),\n    });\n\n    expect((await coordinator.step()).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect((await coordinator.step()).kind).toBe('applied');\n    const summon = summonedId(coordinator.state());\n    expect((await coordinator.step()).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect(summonerController.actors).toEqual([fixtureState.caster.id, fixtureState.caster.id, summon]);\n    expect(registry.identities().find((identity) => identity.combatantId === summon)?.controllerId)\n      .toBe('controller:summoner');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/wild-shape.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1747","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay derives known-form counts, use counts, rest recovery, and rounded duration from the Druid level tables"},{"id":"1748","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay cr_cap_exact_and_one_step_beyond: accepts CR 1/2 at level 4 and gives the one-step-higher CR 1 refusal a named gate"},{"id":"1749","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay movement_gates_named: refuses a Fly Speed form one level below the level-8 gate"},{"id":"1750","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay allows a CR-eligible Fly Speed form starting at level 8"},{"id":"1751","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay allows a CR-eligible swim-speed form at level 2"},{"id":"1752","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay unknown_form_allowed: refuses a bundled Beast that is not on the character sheet"},{"id":"1753","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay mental_stats_replaced: two physical lenses differ and change attack outcomes while true-form mental scores and spell save DC stay fixed"},{"id":"1754","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay excess_damage_dropped: exact form-pool depletion reverts with zero excess and one point beyond damages the true form by exactly one"},{"id":"1755","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay duration_exact_expiry: remains shaped immediately before its expiry round and reverts at the exact boundary"},{"id":"1756","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay concentration_dropped_on_shift: concentration, conditions, pending decisions, and policies survive shape and duration reversion"},{"id":"1757","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay voluntary reversion is a Bonus Action and all three SRD equipment choices remain explicit"},{"id":"1758","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay death_saves_use_true_form: lethal excess reverts first, then starts the PC true form dying"},{"id":"1759","name":"2024 Wild Shape overlay known-form construction includes homebrew families but requires the exact sheet count and unique bundled Beasts"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  effectiveCombatRules,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n  type PendingDecision,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { monsterAttackCommand } from '../../../src/combat/monster-commands';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, effectStackingIdentity, statblockId, type StatblockId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  WildShapeRuleError,\n  createWildShapeCharacterSheet,\n  recoverWildShapeUses,\n  wildShapeDurationRounds,\n  wildShapeForm,\n  wildShapeKnownFormMaximum,\n  wildShapeUseMaximum,\n} from '../../../src/combat/wild-shape';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst WOLF = statblockId('statblock:wolf');\nconst BOAR = statblockId('statblock:boar');\nconst BLACK_BEAR = statblockId('statblock:black-bear');\nconst CROCODILE = statblockId('statblock:crocodile');\nconst DIRE_WOLF = statblockId('statblock:dire-wolf');\nconst BLOOD_HAWK = statblockId('statblock:blood-hawk');\nconst BRUSH_BEAR = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/brush-bear');\nconst THREADLING = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/threadling-weaver');\nconst RIDGE_RUNNER = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/ridge-runner');\nconst REEF_PROWLER = statblockId('statblock:homebrew-beast/reef-prowler');\n\nconst LEVEL_TWO_FORMS = [WOLF, BOAR, BRUSH_BEAR, THREADLING] as const;\nconst LEVEL_FOUR_FORMS = [WOLF, BOAR, BLACK_BEAR, CROCODILE, DIRE_WOLF, BRUSH_BEAR] as const;\nconst LEVEL_EIGHT_FORMS = [\n  WOLF, BOAR, BLACK_BEAR, CROCODILE, DIRE_WOLF, BLOOD_HAWK, BRUSH_BEAR, RIDGE_RUNNER,\n] as const;\n\nfunction druidProfile(\n  key: string,\n  level: 2 | 4 | 7 | 8,\n  knownForms: readonly StatblockId[],\n  hitPoints = 20,\n): Extract<CombatantProfile, { readonly kind: 'player_character' }> {\n  const profile = playerProfile(key, { hitPoints, initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  if (profile.kind !== 'player_character') throw new Error('Druid fixture is not a player character.');\n  return {\n    ...profile,\n    wildShape: createWildShapeCharacterSheet(level, knownForms),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction started(\n  level: 2 | 4 | 7 | 8 = 2,\n  knownForms: readonly StatblockId[] = LEVEL_TWO_FORMS,\n  hitPoints = 20,\n) {\n  const druid = druidProfile('wild-druid', level, knownForms, hitPoints);\n  const enemyBase = monsterProfile('wild-enemy', { hitPoints: 40, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const enemy = { ...enemyBase, rules: { ...enemyBase.rules, sizeCategory: 'Medium' as const } };\n  const state = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [druid, enemy],\n    tokens: [placedToken(druid, 0), placedToken(enemy, 1)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  return { druid, enemy, state };\n}\n\nfunction subject(state: EncounterState, profile: CombatantProfile) {\n  const found = state.combatants.find((candidate) => candidate.profile.id === profile.id);\n  if (found === undefined) throw new Error(`Missing combatant ${profile.id}.`);\n  return found;\n}\n\nfunction shape(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  druid: Extract<CombatantProfile, { readonly kind: 'player_character' }>,\n  formId: StatblockId,\n  equipmentDisposition: 'dropped_at_origin' | 'merged_into_form' | 'worn_if_practical' = 'merged_into_form',\n) {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'assume_wild_shape', actor: druid.id, formId, equipmentDisposition,\n  }, () => 0);\n}\n\nfunction fixedDamage(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  source: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  amount: number,\n) {\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'force_save', actor: source.id, target: target.id,\n    ability: 'dexterity', dc: 99, rollMode: 'normal',\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(4), modifier: amount } }],\n      critical: false, responses: [],\n    },\n    onSuccess: 'none', cost: 'none',\n  }, () => 0);\n}\n\nfunction firstAttack(formId: StatblockId) {\n  const form = wildShapeForm(formId);\n  if (form === null || form.sourceDetails.actions.kind !== 'present') {\n    throw new Error(`Wild Shape attack fixture ${formId} is missing.`);\n  }\n  const attack = form.sourceDetails.actions.value.find((action) => action.kind === 'attack');\n  if (attack === undefined || attack.kind !== 'attack') throw new Error(`Wild Shape form ${formId} has no attack.`);\n  return attack;\n}\n\ndescribe('2024 Wild Shape overlay', () => {\n  it('derives known-form counts, use counts, rest recovery, and rounded duration from the Druid level tables', () => {\n    // Uses and known forms: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2533-2552,2580-2611.\n    // Duration and general rounding: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2571-2579,320-325.\n    expect(([2, 4, 8] as const).map((level) => wildShapeKnownFormMaximum(level))).toEqual([4, 6, 8]);\n    expect(([2, 6, 17] as const).map((level) => wildShapeUseMaximum(level))).toEqual([2, 3, 4]);\n    expect(wildShapeDurationRounds(5)).toBe(1_200);\n    expect(recoverWildShapeUses({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 0 }, 'short_rest'))\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 1 });\n    expect(recoverWildShapeUses({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 1 }, 'long_rest'))\n      .toEqual({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 3, remaining: 3 });\n  });\n\n  it('cr_cap_exact_and_one_step_beyond: accepts CR 1/2 at level 4 and gives the one-step-higher CR 1 refusal a named gate', () => {\n    // Beast Shapes thresholds: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2587-2611.\n    const exact = started(4, LEVEL_FOUR_FORMS);\n    expect(subject(shape(exact.state, exact.druid, BLACK_BEAR).state, exact.druid).wildShape?.formId)\n      .toBe(BLACK_BEAR);\n\n    const beyond = started(4, LEVEL_FOUR_FORMS);\n    expect(() => shape(beyond.state, beyond.druid, DIRE_WOLF)).toThrow(WildShapeRuleError);\n    try {\n      shape(beyond.state, beyond.druid, DIRE_WOLF);\n      expect.fail('A CR 1 form unexpectedly crossed the level-4 gate.');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toMatchObject({\n        code: 'challenge_rating_gate',\n        gate: { kind: 'challenge_rating', maximum: '1/2', actual: 1 },\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('movement_gates_named: refuses a Fly Speed form one level below the level-8 gate', () => {\n    // Fly gate: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2598-2599,2604-2611.\n    const flying = started(7, [WOLF, BOAR, BLACK_BEAR, BLOOD_HAWK, DIRE_WOLF, BRUSH_BEAR]);\n    expect(() => shape(flying.state, flying.druid, BLOOD_HAWK)).toThrowError(expect.objectContaining({\n      code: 'fly_speed_gate', gate: { kind: 'fly_speed', minimumDruidLevel: 8 },\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('allows a CR-eligible Fly Speed form starting at level 8', () => {\n    // Fly permission boundary: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2598-2599,2604-2611.\n    const flying = started(8, LEVEL_EIGHT_FORMS);\n    const result = shape(flying.state, flying.druid, BLOOD_HAWK);\n    expect(subject(result.state, flying.druid).wildShape?.formId).toBe(BLOOD_HAWK);\n  });\n\n  it('allows a CR-eligible swim-speed form at level 2', () => {\n    // The Beast Shapes table gates only Fly Speed: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2604-2611.\n    const swimming = started(2, [WOLF, BOAR, REEF_PROWLER, THREADLING]);\n    const result = shape(swimming.state, swimming.druid, REEF_PROWLER);\n    expect(subject(result.state, swimming.druid).wildShape?.formId).toBe(REEF_PROWLER);\n  });\n\n  it('unknown_form_allowed: refuses a bundled Beast that is not on the character sheet', () => {\n    // The form must be learned: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2571-2576,2587-2594.\n    const fixture = started();\n    expect(() => shape(fixture.state, fixture.druid, RIDGE_RUNNER)).toThrowError(expect.objectContaining({\n      code: 'form_not_known', gate: null,\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('mental_stats_replaced: two physical lenses differ and change attack outcomes while true-form mental scores and spell save DC stay fixed', () => {\n    // Retained mental scores and replaced game statistics: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2619-2634.\n    const wolfFixture = started();\n    const boarFixture = started();\n    const wolfState = shape(wolfFixture.state, wolfFixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const boarState = shape(boarFixture.state, boarFixture.druid, BOAR).state;\n    const trueRules = wolfFixture.druid.rules;\n    const wolfRules = effectiveCombatRules(wolfState, wolfFixture.druid.id);\n    const boarRules = effectiveCombatRules(boarState, boarFixture.druid.id);\n    expect(wolfRules.abilityScores).toMatchObject({ intelligence: 10, wisdom: 18, charisma: 10 });\n    expect(boarRules.abilityScores).toMatchObject({ intelligence: 10, wisdom: 18, charisma: 10 });\n    expect(wolfRules.abilityScores?.strength).not.toBe(boarRules.abilityScores?.strength);\n    const spellSaveDc = (rules: typeof trueRules) => 8 + (rules.proficiencyBonus ?? 0) +\n      Math.floor(((rules.abilityScores?.wisdom ?? 10) - 10) / 2);\n    expect([spellSaveDc(trueRules), spellSaveDc(wolfRules), spellSaveDc(boarRules)]).toEqual([14, 14, 14]);\n\n    const wolfAttack = reduceEncounter(\n      wolfState,\n      monsterAttackCommand(firstAttack(WOLF), wolfFixture.druid.id, wolfFixture.enemy.id),\n      () => 0.35,\n    );\n    const boarAttack = reduceEncounter(\n      boarState,\n      monsterAttackCommand(firstAttack(BOAR), boarFixture.druid.id, boarFixture.enemy.id),\n      () => 0.35,\n    );\n    expect(wolfAttack.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'attack_resolved', attack: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'hit' }),\n    }));\n    expect(boarAttack.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'attack_resolved', attack: expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'miss' }),\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('excess_damage_dropped: exact form-pool depletion reverts with zero excess and one point beyond damages the true form by exactly one', () => {\n    const exactFixture = started();\n    const exactShaped = shape(exactFixture.state, exactFixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const exactPool = (subject(exactShaped, exactFixture.druid).wildShape?.physical.hitPoints ?? 0) +\n      subject(exactShaped, exactFixture.druid).temporaryHitPoints;\n    const exact = fixedDamage(exactShaped, exactFixture.druid, exactFixture.druid, exactPool);\n    expect(subject(exact.state, exactFixture.druid).hitPoints).toBe(20);\n    expect(subject(exact.state, exactFixture.druid).wildShape).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(exact.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'wild_shape_reverted', reason: 'form_hit_points_depleted', excessDamage: 0,\n    }));\n\n    const overFixture = started();\n    const overShaped = shape(overFixture.state, overFixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const overPool = (subject(overShaped, overFixture.druid).wildShape?.physical.hitPoints ?? 0) +\n      subject(overShaped, overFixture.druid).temporaryHitPoints;\n    const over = fixedDamage(overShaped, overFixture.druid, overFixture.druid, overPool + 1);\n    expect(subject(over.state, overFixture.druid).hitPoints).toBe(19);\n    expect(subject(over.state, overFixture.druid).wildShape).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(over.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'wild_shape_reverted', reason: 'form_hit_points_depleted', excessDamage: 1,\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('duration_exact_expiry: remains shaped immediately before its expiry round and reverts at the exact boundary', () => {\n    // Duration and early Bonus Action exit: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2571-2579.\n    const fixture = started();\n    const shaped = shape(fixture.state, fixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const expiry = subject(shaped, fixture.druid).wildShape?.expiresAtRound;\n    if (expiry === undefined) throw new Error('Wild Shape expiry was not recorded.');\n    expect(expiry).toBe(601);\n    const enemyTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      { ...shaped, pendingDecisions: [] },\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.druid.id },\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const immediatelyBefore = { ...enemyTurn, round: expiry - 1 };\n    expect(subject(immediatelyBefore, fixture.druid).wildShape).toBeDefined();\n    const expired = reduceEncounter(immediatelyBefore, { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.enemy.id }, () => 0);\n    expect(subject(expired.state, fixture.druid).wildShape).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(expired.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'wild_shape_reverted', reason: 'duration_expired', excessDamage: 0,\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('concentration_dropped_on_shift: concentration, conditions, pending decisions, and policies survive shape and duration reversion', () => {\n    // Shape-shifting preserves ongoing conditions/spells: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:12026-12033.\n    // Wild Shape does not break concentration: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2635-2637.\n    const fixture = started();\n    const concentrated = reduceEncounter(fixture.state, {\n      type: 'apply_effect', actor: fixture.druid.id, cost: 'none',\n      effect: {\n        targets: [fixture.druid.id], duration: { kind: 'permanent' }, concentration: true,\n        stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('wild-shape-concentration-control'),\n        stacking: 'coexist', repeatedSave: null,\n        payload: { kind: 'skill_modifier', skill: 'stealth', amount: 1 },\n      },\n    }, () => 0).state;\n    const conditioned = reduceEncounter(concentrated, {\n      type: 'apply_effect', actor: fixture.druid.id, cost: 'none',\n      effect: {\n        targets: [fixture.druid.id], duration: { kind: 'permanent' }, concentration: false,\n        stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('wild-shape-condition-control'),\n        stacking: 'coexist', repeatedSave: null,\n        payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Poisoned' },\n      },\n    }, () => 0).state;\n    const pending: PendingDecision = {\n      id: 'decision:wild-shape-control', kind: 'death_save', combatant: fixture.enemy.id,\n      boundary: { activeCombatant: fixture.druid.id, round: conditioned.round },\n      options: [{ id: 'roll', label: 'Roll' }],\n    };\n    const before = { ...conditioned, pendingDecisions: [pending] };\n    const shaped = shape(before, fixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    expect(shaped.effects).toEqual(before.effects);\n    expect(shaped.pendingDecisions).toEqual([pending]);\n    expect(shaped.reactionPolicies).toEqual(before.reactionPolicies);\n    expect(combatantConditions(shaped, fixture.druid.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Poisoned' });\n    expect(shaped.effects.some((effect) => effect.concentrationOwner === fixture.druid.id)).toBe(true);\n\n    const enemyTurn = reduceEncounter(\n      { ...shaped, pendingDecisions: [] },\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.druid.id },\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    const expiry = subject(shaped, fixture.druid).wildShape?.expiresAtRound;\n    if (expiry === undefined) throw new Error('Wild Shape expiry was not recorded.');\n    const expired = reduceEncounter(\n      { ...enemyTurn, round: expiry - 1, pendingDecisions: [] },\n      { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.enemy.id },\n      () => 0,\n    ).state;\n    expect(subject(expired, fixture.druid).wildShape).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(expired.effects.some((effect) => effect.concentrationOwner === fixture.druid.id)).toBe(true);\n    expect(combatantConditions(expired, fixture.druid.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Poisoned' });\n  });\n\n  it('voluntary reversion is a Bonus Action and all three SRD equipment choices remain explicit', () => {\n    // Equipment choices: docs/srd/full/srd-5.2.1.txt:2638-2650.\n    for (const disposition of ['dropped_at_origin', 'merged_into_form', 'worn_if_practical'] as const) {\n      const fixture = started();\n      const shaped = shape(fixture.state, fixture.druid, WOLF, disposition).state;\n      expect(subject(shaped, fixture.druid).wildShape?.equipmentDisposition).toBe(disposition);\n    }\n    const fixture = started();\n    const shaped = shape(fixture.state, fixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const enemyTurn = reduceEncounter(shaped, { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.druid.id }, () => 0).state;\n    const nextDruidTurn = reduceEncounter(enemyTurn, { type: 'end_turn', actor: fixture.enemy.id }, () => 0).state;\n    const reverted = reduceEncounter(nextDruidTurn, { type: 'revert_wild_shape', actor: fixture.druid.id }, () => 0);\n    expect(subject(reverted.state, fixture.druid).wildShape).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(reverted.events).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      expect.objectContaining({ type: 'resource_spent', resource: 'bonus_action' }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ type: 'wild_shape_reverted', reason: 'voluntary_bonus_action' }),\n    ]));\n  });\n\n  it('death_saves_use_true_form: lethal excess reverts first, then starts the PC true form dying', () => {\n    const fixture = started(2, LEVEL_TWO_FORMS, 1);\n    const shaped = shape(fixture.state, fixture.druid, WOLF).state;\n    const pool = (subject(shaped, fixture.druid).wildShape?.physical.hitPoints ?? 0) +\n      subject(shaped, fixture.druid).temporaryHitPoints;\n    const dropped = fixedDamage(shaped, fixture.druid, fixture.druid, pool + 1).state;\n    expect(subject(dropped, fixture.druid)).toMatchObject({\n      hitPoints: 0,\n      life: 'dying',\n      deathSaves: { successes: 0, failures: 0 },\n      profile: { rules: { usesDeathSaves: true, hitPointMaximum: 1 } },\n    });\n    expect(subject(dropped, fixture.druid).wildShape).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('known-form construction includes homebrew families but requires the exact sheet count and unique bundled Beasts', () => {\n    expect(createWildShapeCharacterSheet(2, [WOLF, BOAR, BRUSH_BEAR, RIDGE_RUNNER]).knownForms)\n      .toContain(RIDGE_RUNNER);\n    expect(() => createWildShapeCharacterSheet(2, [WOLF, BOAR, BRUSH_BEAR]))\n      .toThrow('exactly 4');\n    expect(() => createWildShapeCharacterSheet(2, [WOLF, BOAR, BRUSH_BEAR, WOLF]))\n      .toThrow('must be unique');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/bridge/steering.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1760","name":"E06 steering split STEERING-APPROVE sends the full algorithm proposal and uses an empty approval"},{"id":"1761","name":"E06 steering split STEERING-OVERRIDE deterministically retargets the proposal through the normal program executor"},{"id":"1762","name":"E06 steering split STEERING-REPLACE accepts the unbounded full replacement arm and validates it as a RoundPlan"},{"id":"1763","name":"E06 steering split TRIGGER-POLICY-MATRIX consults only for every-round or the five registered E06 reasons"},{"id":"1764","name":"E06 steering split TRIGGER-EVENT-DERIVATION detects down/death, control, and retreat-threshold crossings"},{"id":"1765","name":"E06 steering split trigger_policy_ignored does not call the fake exchange on a quiet later round"},{"id":"1766","name":"E06 steering split override_invents_action rejects an override that smuggles an action outside the typed set"},{"id":"1767","name":"E06 steering split override_order_nondeterministic applies the typed override set identically in either wire order"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { ControllerRequest } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { projectDmView } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, agentSessionId, encounterEffectId, encounterSessionId, type CombatantId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { projectDmBoard } from '../../../src/vtt/encounter-projections';\nimport { DmRoundPlanSession } from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/decision-program';\nimport {\n  DM_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,\n  STEERING_REPLY_JSON_SCHEMA,\n  decodeSteeringReply,\n  type DmBridgeExchange,\n  type DmBridgeRequest,\n  type SteeringRoundRequest,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/contracts';\nimport {\n  E06_TRIGGER_POLICY,\n  applySteeringOverrides,\n  steeringConsultReason,\n  steeringTriggerEvents,\n  type SteeringTelemetry,\n  type SteeringTriggerEvents,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/steering';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst IDLE = {\n  requestSequence: 1,\n  pendingRequest: null,\n  pendingCommand: null,\n  continuation: { kind: 'idle' as const },\n  pause: null,\n};\n\nfunction fixture(round = 2) {\n  const monsterA = monsterProfile('steering-a', { hitPoints: 40 });\n  const monsterB = monsterProfile('steering-b', { hitPoints: 35 });\n  const playerA = playerProfile('steering-player-a');\n  const playerB = playerProfile('steering-player-b');\n  const base = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 4 },\n    combatants: [monsterA, monsterB, playerA, playerB],\n    tokens: [\n      placedToken(monsterA, 0),\n      placedToken(monsterB, 1),\n      placedToken(playerA, 3),\n      placedToken(playerB, 8),\n    ],\n  });\n  const state: EncounterState = { ...base, revision: 9, round, activeCombatant: monsterA.id };\n  return { monsterA, monsterB, playerA, playerB, state };\n}\n\nfunction board(state: EncounterState) {\n  return projectDmBoard({ view: projectDmView(state), coordinator: IDLE, controllers: [], history: [] });\n}\n\nfunction context(state: EncounterState) {\n  return {\n    encounterId: encounterSessionId('encounter:steering'),\n    agentSessionId: agentSessionId('codex:steering'),\n    projection: board(state),\n    history: [],\n    initiativeMode: state.config.initiativeMode,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attack(actor: CombatantId, target: CombatantId): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor,\n    target,\n    attackBonus: 5,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Slashing'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 2 } }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction controllerRequest(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  actor: CombatantId,\n  actions: readonly EncounterCommand[],\n): ControllerRequest {\n  return {\n    kind: 'turn',\n    requestId: `turn:${state.revision}:${actor}`,\n    encounterRevision: state.revision,\n    actorId: actor,\n    visibleState: board(state).encounter,\n    legalActions: { actions },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction steeringIdentity(request: SteeringRoundRequest) {\n  return {\n    protocolVersion: DM_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,\n    encounterId: request.encounterId,\n    requestId: request.requestId,\n    expectedRevision: request.expectedRevision,\n    round: request.round,\n  };\n}\n\nclass FakeSteeringExchange implements DmBridgeExchange {\n  readonly requests: DmBridgeRequest[] = [];\n  constructor(private readonly reply: (request: DmBridgeRequest) => unknown) {}\n  async exchange(request: DmBridgeRequest): Promise<unknown> {\n    this.requests.push(request);\n    return this.reply(request);\n  }\n}\n\ndescribe('E06 steering split', () => {\n  it('STEERING-APPROVE sends the full algorithm proposal and uses an empty approval', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const telemetry: SteeringTelemetry[] = [];\n    const exchange = new FakeSteeringExchange((request) => {\n      if (request.kind !== 'steering_round_request') throw new Error('Expected steering request.');\n      return { kind: 'steering_approve', ...steeringIdentity(request) };\n    });\n    const session = new DmRoundPlanSession(\n      exchange,\n      undefined,\n      undefined,\n      'json_ast',\n      {},\n      { kind: 'algorithm_with_overrides' },\n      (value) => telemetry.push(value),\n    );\n    const result = await session.choose(\n      controllerRequest(f.state, f.monsterA.id, [\n        attack(f.monsterA.id, f.playerB.id),\n        attack(f.monsterA.id, f.playerA.id),\n      ]),\n      context(f.state),\n      new AbortController().signal,\n    );\n\n    expect(result.action).toEqual(attack(f.monsterA.id, f.playerA.id));\n    expect(exchange.requests[0]).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'steering_round_request',\n      consultReason: 'every_round',\n      proposal: { monsters: [{ monsterId: f.monsterA.id }, { monsterId: f.monsterB.id }] },\n      projection: { audience: 'dm', encounter: { revision: 9 } },\n    });\n    expect(telemetry).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(telemetry[0]).toMatchObject({\n      replyKind: 'approve',\n      overrideCount: 0,\n      consultReason: 'every_round',\n    });\n    expect(telemetry[0]?.proposalSize).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n  });\n\n  it('STEERING-OVERRIDE deterministically retargets the proposal through the normal program executor', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const exchange = new FakeSteeringExchange((request) => {\n      if (request.kind !== 'steering_round_request') throw new Error('Expected steering request.');\n      return {\n        kind: 'steering_overrides',\n        ...steeringIdentity(request),\n        overrides: [{\n          kind: 'retarget',\n          monsterId: f.monsterA.id,\n          target: { kind: 'combatant', combatantId: f.playerB.id },\n        }],\n      };\n    });\n    const session = new DmRoundPlanSession(\n      exchange, undefined, undefined, 'json_ast', {}, { kind: 'algorithm_with_overrides' },\n    );\n    const result = await session.choose(\n      controllerRequest(f.state, f.monsterA.id, [\n        attack(f.monsterA.id, f.playerA.id),\n        attack(f.monsterA.id, f.playerB.id),\n      ]),\n      context(f.state),\n      new AbortController().signal,\n    );\n    expect(result.action).toEqual(attack(f.monsterA.id, f.playerB.id));\n  });\n\n  it('STEERING-REPLACE accepts the unbounded full replacement arm and validates it as a RoundPlan', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const exchange = new FakeSteeringExchange((request) => {\n      if (request.kind !== 'steering_round_request') throw new Error('Expected steering request.');\n      return {\n        kind: 'steering_replacement',\n        ...steeringIdentity(request),\n        replacement: {\n          ...request.proposal,\n          monsters: request.proposal.monsters.map((entry) => ({\n            monsterId: entry.monsterId,\n            program: { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n          })),\n        },\n      };\n    });\n    const session = new DmRoundPlanSession(\n      exchange, undefined, undefined, 'json_ast', {}, { kind: 'algorithm_with_overrides' },\n    );\n    await expect(session.choose(\n      controllerRequest(f.state, f.monsterA.id, [{ type: 'end_turn', actor: f.monsterA.id }]),\n      context(f.state),\n      new AbortController().signal,\n    )).resolves.toMatchObject({ action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: f.monsterA.id } });\n  });\n\n  it('TRIGGER-POLICY-MATRIX consults only for every-round or the five registered E06 reasons', () => {\n    const quiet: SteeringTriggerEvents = {\n      combatantDownOrDied: false,\n      controlChanged: false,\n      retreatThresholdCrossed: false,\n    };\n    const triggered = (events: Partial<SteeringTriggerEvents>, topActionGapPercent = 10, round = 2) =>\n      steeringConsultReason({\n        mode: { kind: 'algorithm_triggered', policy: E06_TRIGGER_POLICY },\n        round,\n        topActionGapPercent,\n        events: { ...quiet, ...events },\n      });\n    expect(steeringConsultReason({\n      mode: { kind: 'algorithm_with_overrides' }, round: 8, topActionGapPercent: 99, events: quiet,\n    })).toBe('every_round');\n    expect(triggered({}, 10, 1)).toBe('round_one');\n    expect(triggered({}, 4.999)).toBe('near_tie_top_actions');\n    expect(triggered({ combatantDownOrDied: true })).toBe('combatant_down_or_dead');\n    expect(triggered({ controlChanged: true })).toBe('control_change');\n    expect(triggered({ retreatThresholdCrossed: true })).toBe('retreat_threshold');\n    expect(triggered({})).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('TRIGGER-EVENT-DERIVATION detects down/death, control, and retreat-threshold crossings', () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const previous = board(f.state).encounter;\n    const current = {\n      ...previous,\n      revision: previous.revision + 1,\n      combatants: previous.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.id === f.monsterA.id\n          ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 10 }\n          : combatant.id === f.playerA.id\n            ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 0, life: 'dead' as const }\n            : combatant,\n      ),\n      recentEvents: [\n        ...previous.recentEvents,\n        {\n          sequence: 1,\n          type: 'effect_applied' as const,\n          effectId: encounterEffectId('effect:control-change'),\n          source: f.monsterA.id,\n          targets: [f.playerB.id],\n        },\n      ],\n    };\n    expect(steeringTriggerEvents(previous, current, 25)).toEqual({\n      combatantDownOrDied: true,\n      controlChanged: true,\n      retreatThresholdCrossed: true,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('trigger_policy_ignored does not call the fake exchange on a quiet later round', async () => {\n    const f = fixture(3);\n    const exchange = new FakeSteeringExchange(() => {\n      throw new Error('Quiet trigger-only round must not consult.');\n    });\n    const telemetry: SteeringTelemetry[] = [];\n    const session = new DmRoundPlanSession(\n      exchange,\n      undefined,\n      undefined,\n      'json_ast',\n      {},\n      {\n        kind: 'algorithm_triggered',\n        policy: { nearTiePercent: 0, retreatHitPointPercent: 25 },\n      },\n      (value) => telemetry.push(value),\n    );\n    await session.startRound(context(f.state), new AbortController().signal);\n    expect(exchange.requests).toEqual([]);\n    expect(telemetry).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(telemetry[0]).toMatchObject({\n      replyKind: 'not_consulted',\n      overrideCount: 0,\n      consultReason: null,\n    });\n    expect(telemetry[0]?.proposalSize).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n  });\n\n  it('override_invents_action rejects an override that smuggles an action outside the typed set', () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    const request: SteeringRoundRequest = {\n      kind: 'steering_round_request',\n      protocolVersion: DM_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,\n      encounterId: encounterSessionId('encounter:steering'),\n      requestId: 'request:strict-override',\n      expectedRevision: f.state.revision,\n      round: f.state.round,\n      agentSessionId: agentSessionId('codex:steering'),\n      model: { model: 'fake', reasoningEffort: 'low' },\n      projection: board(f.state),\n      history: [],\n      proposal: {\n        kind: 'round_plan',\n        protocolVersion: DM_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION,\n        encounterId: encounterSessionId('encounter:steering'),\n        requestId: 'request:strict-override',\n        expectedRevision: f.state.revision,\n        round: f.state.round,\n        monsters: [{\n          monsterId: f.monsterA.id,\n          program: { kind: 'action', action: { kind: 'use_action', action: 'end_turn' } },\n        }],\n      },\n      consultReason: 'every_round',\n      replyContract: { schemaVersion: 1, jsonSchema: STEERING_REPLY_JSON_SCHEMA },\n      correctionAttempt: 0,\n    };\n    expect(() => decodeSteeringReply({\n      kind: 'steering_overrides',\n      ...steeringIdentity(request),\n      overrides: [{\n        kind: 'invoke_action',\n        monsterId: f.monsterA.id,\n        action: { kind: 'teleport_everyone' },\n      }],\n    }, request)).toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it('override_order_nondeterministic applies the typed override set identically in either wire order', async () => {\n    const f = fixture();\n    let captured: SteeringRoundRequest | null = null;\n    const exchange = new FakeSteeringExchange((request) => {\n      if (request.kind !== 'steering_round_request') throw new Error('Expected steering request.');\n      captured = request;\n      return { kind: 'steering_approve', ...steeringIdentity(request) };\n    });\n    await new DmRoundPlanSession(\n      exchange, undefined, undefined, 'json_ast', {}, { kind: 'algorithm_with_overrides' },\n    ).startRound(context(f.state), new AbortController().signal);\n    if (captured === null) throw new Error('Missing steering request.');\n    const request: SteeringRoundRequest = captured;\n    const proposal = request.proposal.monsters.find((entry) => entry.monsterId === f.monsterA.id)?.program;\n    if (proposal?.kind !== 'priority') throw new Error('Algorithm proposal must be a priority program.');\n    const overrides = [\n      {\n        kind: 'retarget' as const,\n        monsterId: f.monsterA.id,\n        target: { kind: 'combatant' as const, combatantId: f.playerB.id },\n      },\n      {\n        kind: 'priority_reorder' as const,\n        monsterId: f.monsterA.id,\n        order: proposal.choices.map((_choice, index) => proposal.choices.length - index - 1),\n      },\n      {\n        kind: 'stance_change' as const,\n        monsterId: f.monsterA.id,\n        stance: 'defensive' as const,\n      },\n      {\n        kind: 'special_ability_invocation' as const,\n        monsterId: f.monsterA.id,\n        ability: 'force_save' as const,\n        target: { kind: 'nearest_enemy' as const },\n      },\n    ];\n    expect(applySteeringOverrides(request.proposal, overrides, request)).toEqual(\n      applySteeringOverrides(request.proposal, [...overrides].reverse(), request),\n    );\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/agent-session-lifecycle.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1768","name":"SIMULATED agent persists one visible recovery successor only for resume_not_found"},{"id":"1770","name":"SIMULATED agent session lifecycle creates and persists one visible recovery successor only for resume_corrupt"},{"id":"1771","name":"SIMULATED agent session lifecycle pauses other classified failures without silently creating a successor"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport {\n  agentSessionId,\n  encounterBranchId,\n  encounterSessionId,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { sha256 } from '../../../src/crypto/sha256';\nimport type { AgentInvocation } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session';\nimport { AgentSessionLifecycle } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session-lifecycle';\nimport { referenceEncounterSetup } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter';\nimport {\n  EncounterSessionJournal,\n  exportSavedSession,\n  importSavedSession,\n  MemoryBrowserSessionStore,\n  MemoryMirrorSink,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/session-persistence';\nimport {\n  SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter,\n  SIMULATEDResumeFailure,\n} from '../../fixtures/simulated-agent-session-adapter';\n\nfunction invocation(runId: ReturnType<typeof encounterSessionId>, prompt: string): AgentInvocation {\n  return {\n    runId,\n    prompt,\n    model: 'SIMULATED-model',\n    reasoningEffort: 'SIMULATED-effort',\n    launcherToken: 'SIMULATED-launcher-token',\n    timeoutMs: 5_000,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction setup(adapter: SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter) {\n  const sessionId = encounterSessionId('session:simulated-agent-lifecycle');\n  const store = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n  const journal = EncounterSessionJournal.create({\n    sessionId,\n    branchId: encounterBranchId('branch:simulated-agent-lifecycle'),\n    encounterState: createEncounter(referenceEncounterSetup()),\n    coordinatorState: {\n      requestSequence: 1,\n      pendingRequest: null,\n      pendingCommand: null,\n      continuation: { kind: 'idle' },\n      pause: null,\n    },\n    controllers: [],\n    rng: mulberry32(948_217),\n    store,\n    mirror: new MemoryMirrorSink(),\n  });\n  return {\n    sessionId,\n    store,\n    journal,\n    lifecycle: new AgentSessionLifecycle(journal, adapter, 4),\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('SIMULATED agent session lifecycle', () => {\n  it('cold-starts once, then resumes one persisted run-scoped session for round, room transition, and correction', async () => {\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({ startIds: ['agent-session:stable'] });\n    const { lifecycle, journal, sessionId, store } = setup(adapter);\n    const signal = new AbortController().signal;\n\n    expect(journal.agentSession()).toBeNull();\n    await lifecycle.coldStart(invocation(sessionId, 'cold-start bootstrap'), signal);\n    await lifecycle.resumeRound(invocation(sessionId, 'round:1'), signal);\n    await lifecycle.resumeRoomTransition(invocation(sessionId, 'room_transition:2'), signal);\n    await lifecycle.resumeCorrection(invocation(sessionId, 'correction:1'), signal);\n\n    expect(adapter.startInvocations.map((entry) => entry.prompt)).toEqual(['cold-start bootstrap']);\n    expect(adapter.resumeInvocations.map((entry) => entry.invocation.prompt)).toEqual([\n      'round:1',\n      'room_transition:2',\n      'correction:1',\n    ]);\n    expect(new Set(adapter.resumeInvocations.map((entry) => entry.binding.sessionId))).toEqual(\n      new Set([agentSessionId('agent-session:stable')]),\n    );\n    expect(store.revisions(sessionId).map((revision) => revision.transition.kind)).toEqual([\n      'session_started',\n      'agent_session_started',\n      'agent_session_dispatched',\n      'agent_session_dispatched',\n      'agent_session_dispatched',\n    ]);\n    expect(journal.agentSession()).toMatchObject({\n      cli: 'codex',\n      sessionId: agentSessionId('agent-session:stable'),\n      adapterVersion: 4,\n      recoveryGeneration: 0,\n      predecessorSessionHash: null,\n      startedAtRevision: 2,\n      lastDispatchedRevision: 4,\n      status: 'active',\n    });\n    const reloadedStore = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n    importSavedSession(reloadedStore, exportSavedSession(store, sessionId));\n    expect(EncounterSessionJournal.resume(\n      sessionId,\n      reloadedStore,\n      new MemoryMirrorSink(),\n    ).agentSession).toEqual(journal.agentSession());\n  });\n\n  it.each(['resume_not_found', 'resume_corrupt'] as const)(\n    'creates and persists one visible recovery successor only for %s',\n    async (classification) => {\n      const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({\n        startIds: ['agent-session:failed', 'agent-session:successor'],\n        resumeFailures: [new SIMULATEDResumeFailure(classification)],\n      });\n      const { lifecycle, journal, sessionId, store } = setup(adapter);\n      const signal = new AbortController().signal;\n      await lifecycle.coldStart(invocation(sessionId, 'cold-start bootstrap'), signal);\n\n      const result = await lifecycle.resumeRound({\n        ...invocation(sessionId, 'pending-round'),\n        launcherToken: 'SIMULATED-delta-launcher-token',\n        recoveryLauncherToken: 'SIMULATED-full-launcher-token',\n      }, signal);\n\n      const predecessorHash = sha256('agent-session:failed');\n      expect(result.resumeSessionId).toBe(agentSessionId('agent-session:successor'));\n      expect(result.sessionId).toBeNull();\n      expect(adapter.startInvocations).toHaveLength(2);\n      expect(adapter.startInvocations[1]?.prompt).toContain('\"format\":\"recovery_bootstrap\"');\n      expect(adapter.startInvocations[1]?.prompt).toContain(predecessorHash);\n      expect(adapter.startInvocations[1]?.prompt).not.toContain('agent-session:failed');\n      expect(adapter.startInvocations[1]?.prompt).toContain('[RECOVERY_DISPATCH]\\npending-round');\n      expect(adapter.startInvocations[1]?.launcherToken).toBe('SIMULATED-full-launcher-token');\n      expect(adapter.resumeInvocations.map((entry) => entry.binding.sessionId)).toEqual([\n        agentSessionId('agent-session:failed'),\n      ]);\n      expect(adapter.resumeInvocations.map((entry) => entry.invocation.launcherToken)).toEqual([\n        'SIMULATED-delta-launcher-token',\n      ]);\n      const recovered = store.revisions(sessionId).find(\n        (revision) => revision.transition.kind === 'agent_session_recovered',\n      );\n      expect(recovered?.transition).toMatchObject({\n        kind: 'agent_session_recovered',\n        failure: classification,\n        failedBinding: {\n          sessionId: agentSessionId('agent-session:failed'),\n          status: 'superseded_after_resume_failure',\n        },\n        binding: {\n          sessionId: agentSessionId('agent-session:successor'),\n          recoveryGeneration: 1,\n          predecessorSessionHash: predecessorHash,\n          status: 'active',\n        },\n      });\n      expect(journal.agentSession()).toMatchObject({\n        sessionId: agentSessionId('agent-session:successor'),\n        recoveryGeneration: 1,\n        predecessorSessionHash: predecessorHash,\n        status: 'active',\n      });\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('pauses other classified failures without silently creating a successor', async () => {\n    const adapter = new SIMULATEDAgentSessionAdapter({\n      startIds: ['agent-session:still-active'],\n      resumeFailures: [new SIMULATEDResumeFailure('authentication')],\n    });\n    const { lifecycle, journal, sessionId, store } = setup(adapter);\n    const signal = new AbortController().signal;\n    await lifecycle.coldStart(invocation(sessionId, 'cold-start bootstrap'), signal);\n\n    await expect(lifecycle.resumeCorrection(invocation(sessionId, 'correction'), signal))\n      .rejects.toThrow('SIMULATED authentication');\n\n    expect(adapter.startInvocations).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(store.revisions(sessionId).some(\n      (revision) => revision.transition.kind === 'agent_session_recovered',\n    )).toBe(false);\n    expect(journal.agentSession()).toMatchObject({\n      sessionId: agentSessionId('agent-session:still-active'),\n      recoveryGeneration: 0,\n      predecessorSessionHash: null,\n      status: 'active',\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/detection-reactions.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1772","name":"D356 full detection vocabulary
