value: 'new',\n    });\n    expect('selected' in liveControl).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('ignores child-shaped non-elements instead of trying to reconcile them', () => {\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    expect(Reflect.apply(Array.prototype.push, interactiveElement(draft).children, [\n      null,\n      { tagName: 'DIV' },\n      { append: (): void => undefined },\n    ])).toBe(3);\n\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).not.toThrow();\n    expect(live.children).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it.each(['button', 'input', 'select', 'textarea', 'summary'])(\n    'recognizes an unkeyed %s as interactive',\n    (tag) => {\n      const live = document.createElement('main');\n      const draft = document.createElement('main');\n      draft.append(document.createElement(tag));\n      expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n        expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableInteractivePathError>>({\n          interactiveTag: tag.toUpperCase(),\n          unkeyedTag: tag.toUpperCase(),\n          tree: 'draft',\n        }),\n      );\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('distinguishes linked anchors and tabindex controls from inert lookalikes', () => {\n    const reconcileOne = (element: HTMLElement): void => {\n      const live = document.createElement('main');\n      const draft = document.createElement('main');\n      draft.append(element);\n      reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n    };\n    const inertAnchor = document.createElement('a');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(inertAnchor)).not.toThrow();\n    const linkedAnchor = document.createElement('a');\n    linkedAnchor.setAttribute('href', '/encounter');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(linkedAnchor)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining({ interactiveTag: 'A' }),\n    );\n    const hrefDiv = document.createElement('div');\n    hrefDiv.setAttribute('href', '/not-a-link');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(hrefDiv)).not.toThrow();\n    const tabStop = document.createElement('div');\n    tabStop.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');\n    expect(() => reconcileOne(tabStop)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining({ interactiveTag: 'DIV' }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('reports a duplicate in the live tree before applying the draft', () => {\n    const collision = stableRenderKey('dm', 'live-collision');\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) {\n      const child = document.createElement('div');\n      child.dataset.renderKey = collision;\n      live.append(child);\n    }\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n\n    expect(() => reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft)).toThrowError(\n      expect.objectContaining<Partial<StableRenderKeyCollisionError>>({\n        key: collision,\n        tree: 'live',\n        message: `Stable render key ${collision} is duplicated in the live tree.`,\n      }),\n    );\n    expect(live.children).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n\n  it('reorders retained nodes, inserts a new node, and removes stale and tag-mismatched nodes', () => {\n    const keyed = (tag: 'div' | 'section', identity: string): HTMLElement => {\n      const element = document.createElement(tag);\n      element.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', identity);\n      return element;\n    };\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const first = keyed('div', 'first');\n    const second = keyed('div', 'second');\n    const stale = keyed('div', 'stale');\n    const wrongTag = keyed('div', 'replace-tag');\n    live.append(first, second, stale, wrongTag);\n    const firstRemove = vi.spyOn(interactiveElement(first), 'remove');\n    const insertBefore = vi.spyOn(interactiveElement(live), 'insertBefore');\n    document.body.append(live);\n\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const nextSecond = keyed('div', 'second');\n    nextSecond.textContent = 'second-current';\n    const nextFirst = keyed('div', 'first');\n    const inserted = keyed('div', 'inserted');\n    const replacement = keyed('section', 'replace-tag');\n    draft.append(nextSecond, nextFirst, inserted, replacement);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    expect(Array.from(live.children)).toEqual([second, first, inserted, replacement]);\n    expect(second.textContent).toBe('second-current');\n    expect(stale.isConnected).toBe(false);\n    expect(wrongTag.isConnected).toBe(false);\n    expect(first.isConnected).toBe(true);\n    expect(second.isConnected).toBe(true);\n    expect(firstRemove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(insertBefore).toHaveBeenCalledWith(interactiveElement(inserted), null);\n  });\n\n  it('removes a trailing stale node that never occupies a desired index', () => {\n    const key = stableRenderKey('dm', 'retained');\n    const live = document.createElement('main');\n    const retained = document.createElement('div');\n    retained.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    const trailing = document.createElement('aside');\n    trailing.dataset.renderKey = stableRenderKey('dm', 'trailing-stale');\n    live.append(retained, trailing);\n    document.body.append(live);\n    const draft = document.createElement('main');\n    const desired = document.createElement('div');\n    desired.dataset.renderKey = key;\n    draft.append(desired);\n\n    reconcileStableRenderedChildren(live, draft);\n\n    expect(Array.from(live.children)).toEqual([retained]);\n    expect(trailing.isConnected).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/tools/scrape-content-pack.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"1980","name":"scraper content-pack emission reports every synthetic page as emitted or unemitted with one reason at"},{"id":"2017","name":"scraper content-pack emission numeric operation boundary: die sides maximum above"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { loadContentPackBytes } from '../../../src/content/content-pack';\nimport {\n  buildContentPackDocuments,\n  mapParsedSpellToContentPack,\n  type ContentPackUnemittedReason,\n} from '../../../tools/scrape/build-content-pack';\nimport type { BuiltPage } from '../../../tools/scrape/build-catalog';\nimport type { QueueItem } from '../../../tools/scrape/queue';\nimport { parseSpellPage } from '../../../tools/scrape/parse-spell';\nimport { SCRAPE_SENTINEL } from '../../../tools/scrape/provenance';\nimport { syntheticSpellPage } from '../../fixtures/scrape/synthetic-pages';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ninterface SyntheticSpellInput {\n  readonly title: string;\n  readonly descriptor: string;\n  readonly castingTime: string;\n  readonly range: string;\n  readonly components: string;\n  readonly duration: string;\n  readonly body: readonly string[];\n  readonly tags: readonly string[];\n}\n\nconst ATTACK_DESCRIPTION =\n  'Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within range. On a hit, that creature takes 2d6 Fire damage.';\nconst SAVE_DESCRIPTION =\n  'One creature within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, that creature takes 3d4 Thunder damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.';\n\nfunction syntheticInput(overrides: Partial<SyntheticSpellInput> = {}): SyntheticSpellInput {\n  return {\n    title: 'Ember Needle',\n    descriptor: 'Level 1 Evocation (Wizard)',\n    castingTime: 'Action',\n    range: '60 feet',\n    components: 'V, S',\n    duration: 'Instantaneous',\n    body: [ATTACK_DESCRIPTION],\n    tags: ['evocation', 'wizard'],\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction parsedPage(overrides: Partial<SyntheticSpellInput> = {}): BuiltPage {\n  const input = syntheticInput(overrides);\n  const parsed = parseSpellPage(syntheticSpellPage({\n    ...input,\n    source: \"Cartographer's Almanac\",\n  }), { edition: '2024', slug: `spell:${input.title.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-')}` });\n  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.reason);\n  return {\n    url: `http://example.invalid/spell:${input.title.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-')}`,\n    record: parsed.value.record,\n    description: parsed.value.description,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction expectReason(page: BuiltPage, reason: ContentPackUnemittedReason): void {\n  expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(page.record, page.description)).toEqual({\n    status: 'unemitted',\n    reason,\n  });\n}\n\nconst ATTACK_PAGE = parsedPage();\nconst SAVE_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Hollow Pulse',\n  descriptor: 'Level 2 Evocation (Cleric)',\n  body: [SAVE_DESCRIPTION],\n  tags: ['cleric', 'evocation'],\n});\nconst AMBIGUOUS_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Barbed Ember Needle',\n  body: [`${ATTACK_DESCRIPTION} The target also glows until dawn.`],\n});\nconst UNMAPPED_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Quiet Compass',\n  descriptor: 'Level 1 Divination (Wizard)',\n  body: ['A tiny invented compass points toward the last doorway you touched.'],\n  tags: ['divination', 'wizard'],\n});\nconst OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE = parsedPage({\n  title: 'Patient Ember Needle',\n  castingTime: '1 minute',\n});\nconst SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET = [\n  ATTACK_PAGE,\n  SAVE_PAGE,\n  AMBIGUOUS_PAGE,\n  UNMAPPED_PAGE,\n  OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE,\n] as const;\n\nfunction doneQueue(\n  pages: readonly BuiltPage[],\n  extraUrls: readonly string[] = [],\n): QueueItem[] {\n  return [...pages.map((page) => page.url), ...extraUrls].map((url) => ({\n    url,\n    lastmod: null,\n    state: 'done',\n    reason: null,\n  }));\n}\n\ndescribe('scraper content-pack emission', () => {\n  it('reports every synthetic page as emitted or unemitted with one reason enum', () => {\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({\n      pages: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n      queue: doneQueue(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET),\n      parseFailures: [],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    });\n\n    expect(output.report).toEqual({\n      provenance: SCRAPE_SENTINEL,\n      pagesSeen: 5,\n      partial: false,\n      skippedQueueItems: [],\n      emitted: 2,\n      unemitted: 3,\n      unemittedByReason: {\n        'ambiguous-parameters': 1,\n        'out-of-combat': 1,\n        'parse-failure': 0,\n        'unmapped-vocabulary': 1,\n      },\n      unemittedPages: [\n        {\n          url: AMBIGUOUS_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: AMBIGUOUS_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'ambiguous-parameters',\n        },\n        {\n          url: UNMAPPED_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: UNMAPPED_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'unmapped-vocabulary',\n        },\n        {\n          url: OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE.url,\n          recordId: OUT_OF_COMBAT_PAGE.record.identityKey,\n          reason: 'out-of-combat',\n        },\n      ].sort((left, right) => left.url.localeCompare(right.url)),\n    });\n    expect(loadContentPackBytes(output.packBytes).status).toBe('loaded');\n    expect(output.pack.namespaces).toEqual(['scraped.wikidot']);\n    expect(output.packBytes).toContain(SCRAPE_SENTINEL);\n  });\n\n  it('is byte-identical across repeated builds and independent of input order', () => {\n    const input = {\n      pages: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n      queue: doneQueue(\n        SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_SET,\n        ['http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished'],\n      ),\n      parseFailures: [{ url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished', reason: 'synthetic parse miss' }],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    } as const;\n    const first = buildContentPackDocuments(input);\n    const second = buildContentPackDocuments(input);\n    const reversed = buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, pages: [...input.pages].reverse() });\n\n    expect(second.packBytes).toBe(first.packBytes);\n    expect(second.reportBytes).toBe(first.reportBytes);\n    expect(reversed.packBytes).toBe(first.packBytes);\n    expect(reversed.reportBytes).toBe(first.reportBytes);\n    expect(first.report.unemittedByReason['parse-failure']).toBe(1);\n    expect(first.report.unemittedPages).toContainEqual({\n      url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:unfinished',\n      recordId: null,\n      reason: 'parse-failure',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('partial_emission_silent: refuses pending work and reports it when partial emission is explicit', () => {\n    const pending: QueueItem = {\n      url: 'http://example.invalid/spell:not-fetched',\n      lastmod: null,\n      state: 'pending',\n      reason: 'awaiting fetch',\n    };\n    const input = {\n      pages: [ATTACK_PAGE],\n      queue: [...doneQueue([ATTACK_PAGE]), pending],\n      parseFailures: [],\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    } as const;\n\n    expect(() => buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, allowPartial: false }))\n      .toThrow(/pending\\s+http:\\/\\/example\\.invalid\\/spell:not-fetched/u);\n\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({ ...input, allowPartial: true });\n    expect(output.report.partial).toBe(true);\n    expect(output.report.skippedQueueItems).toEqual([{\n      url: pending.url,\n      state: 'pending',\n      reason: 'awaiting fetch',\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('roundtrip_not_executed: imports and executes an emitted operation in an encounter', () => {\n    const output = buildContentPackDocuments({\n      pages: [ATTACK_PAGE],\n      queue: doneQueue([ATTACK_PAGE]),\n      parseFailures: [],\n      allowPartial: false,\n      importedAt: '2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z',\n    });\n    const loaded = loadContentPackBytes(output.packBytes);\n    if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(loaded.refusal.reason);\n\n    const caster = playerProfile('scrape-pack-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 20,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('scrape-pack-target', {\n      initiativeBonus: -20,\n      hitPoints: 20,\n    });\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [caster, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0), placedToken(target, 1)],\n      contentPacks: [loaded.content],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, {\n      type: 'cast_spell',\n      actor: caster.id,\n      spellId: 'scraped.wikidot:scraped-ember-needle',\n      slotLevel: 1,\n      castAsRitual: false,\n      casterLevel: 3,\n      attackBonus: 100,\n      saveDc: 13,\n      spellcastingModifier: 3,\n      targets: [target.id],\n      area: null,\n      weaponAttack: null,\n      selectedOption: null,\n    }, () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(result.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'spell_cast',\n      spellId: 'scraped.wikidot:scraped-ember-needle',\n    }));\n    expect(result.state.combatants.find(({ profile }) => profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(12);\n  });\n\n  it('approximate_mapping_accepted: refuses an otherwise exact operation with one extra rider clause', () => {\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: `${ATTACK_PAGE.description} The target also glows until dawn.` },\n      'ambiguous-parameters',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('refusal_reason_collapsed: preserves each specific refusal reason', () => {\n    const ambiguous = { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: `${ATTACK_PAGE.description} It also moves.` };\n    const unmapped = { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: 'A harmless invented marker appears nearby.' };\n    const outOfCombat = {\n      ...ATTACK_PAGE,\n      record: { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, castingTime: '1 minute' },\n    };\n    expectReason(ambiguous, 'ambiguous-parameters');\n    expectReason(unmapped, 'unmapped-vocabulary');\n    expectReason(outOfCombat, 'out-of-combat');\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['casting time', { castingTime: '1 minute' }, 'out-of-combat'],\n    ['unknown casting vocabulary', { castingTime: 'Swift Action' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['material consumption', { components: 'V, S, M (an invented copper spiral)' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['unknown component', { components: 'V, X' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['duplicate component', { components: 'V, V' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['empty components', { components: '' }, 'unmapped-vocabulary'],\n    ['unstructured range', { range: 'about 60 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['pluralized one-foot range', { range: '1 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['non-instantaneous duration', { duration: '1 round' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['concentration', { concentration: true }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing casting time', { castingTime: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing range', { range: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing components', { components: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['missing duration', { duration: null }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['invalid record id', { identityKey: 'Not An Identifier' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n  ] as const)(\n    'distinguishing metadata input: %s differs only in the deciding field',\n    (_label, change, reason) => {\n      expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n      expectReason({ ...ATTACK_PAGE, record: { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, ...change } }, reason);\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('distinguishes attack and save vocabulary from unknown or incomplete vocabulary', () => {\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, ATTACK_PAGE.description).status).toBe('emitted');\n    expect(mapParsedSpellToContentPack(SAVE_PAGE.record, SAVE_PAGE.description)).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'emitted',\n      spell: { operation: { kind: 'save_damage', ability: 'dexterity', onSuccess: 'half' } },\n    });\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: ATTACK_PAGE.description.replace('Fire damage', 'Dream damage') },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n    expectReason(\n      { ...SAVE_PAGE, description: SAVE_PAGE.description.replace('Dexterity', 'Luck') },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: ATTACK_PAGE.description.replace('On a hit,', 'Later,') },\n      'ambiguous-parameters',\n    );\n    expectReason(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE, description: 'A harmless invented marker appears nearby.' },\n      'unmapped-vocabulary',\n    );\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['range minimum below', { range: '0 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['range minimum at', { range: '1 foot' }, 'emitted'],\n    ['range maximum at', { range: '100000 feet' }, 'emitted'],\n    ['range maximum above', { range: '100001 feet' }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['level minimum below', { level: 0 }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['level minimum at', { level: 1 }, 'emitted'],\n    ['level maximum at', { level: 9 }, 'emitted'],\n    ['level maximum above', { level: 10 }, 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n  ] as const)('numeric metadata boundary: %s', (_label, change, expected) => {\n    const result = mapParsedSpellToContentPack(\n      { ...ATTACK_PAGE.record, ...change },\n      ATTACK_PAGE.description,\n    );\n    if (expected === 'emitted') {\n      expect(result.status).toBe('emitted');\n    } else {\n      expect(result).toEqual({ status: 'unemitted', reason: expected });\n    }\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    ['dice count minimum below', '0d6', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['dice count minimum at', '1d6', 'emitted'],\n    ['dice count maximum at', '100d6', 'emitted'],\n    ['dice count maximum above', '101d6', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['die sides minimum below', '2d1', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n    ['die sides minimum at', '2d2', 'emitted'],\n    ['die sides maximum at', '2d100', 'emitted'],\n    ['die sides maximum above', '2d101', 'ambiguous-parameters'],\n  ] as const)('numeric operation boundary: %s', (_label, dice, expected) => {\n    const description = ATTACK_PAGE.description.replace('2d6', dice);\n    const result = mapParsedSpellToContentPack(ATTACK_PAGE.record, description);\n    if (expected === 'emitted') {\n      expect(result.status).toBe('emitted');\n    } else {\n      expect(result).toEqual({ status: 'unemitted', reason: expected });\n    }\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/recovery-capability.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2018","name":"recovery-capability-v1 proves an in-range loaded healer with a remaining slot before the dying target turn"},{"id":"2019","name":"recovery-capability-v1 qualifies Cure Wounds by available movement when it starts out of range"},{"id":"2020","name":"recovery-capability-v1 does not treat healing as revival for a dead target"},{"id":"2021","name":"recovery-capability-v1 returns a typed unresolved result when the loaded party is unavailable"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { combatToken } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { projectEncounterTimeline, type TimelineBoundary } from '../../../src/vtt/session-timeline';\nimport {\n  loadExternalPartyPack,\n  type LoadedPartyMember,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/party-pack';\nimport {\n  recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary,\n  RECOVERY_CAPABILITY_POLICY,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/intel/recovery-capability';\n\nfunction loadedParty(spells: readonly string[]): readonly LoadedPartyMember[] {\n  const loaded = loadExternalPartyPack({\n    schemaVersion: 2,\n    partyId: 'party:recovery-capability',\n    allowPartial: false,\n    members: [\n      {\n        combatantId: 'combatant:recovery-healer',\n        tokenId: 'token:recovery-healer',\n        characterId: 1,\n        classes: [{ classId: 'Cleric', level: 5 }],\n        abilities: { strength: 10, dexterity: 10, constitution: 14, intelligence: 10, wisdom: 16, charisma: 10 },\n        armorClass: 16,\n        hitPointMaximum: 35,\n        sizeCategory: 'Medium',\n        walkingSpeedFeet: 30,\n        initiativeBonus: 10,\n        savingThrowBonuses: { strength: 0, dexterity: 0, constitution: 2, intelligence: 0, wisdom: 5, charisma: 0 },\n        attacksPerAction: 1,\n        attacks: [{\n          attackId: 'attack:recovery-healer', kind: 'melee', attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20,\n          reachFeet: 5, rangeFeet: 5,\n          damage: [{ damageTypeId: 'Bludgeoning', count: 1, sides: 6, modifier: 2 }],\n        }],\n        startingConditions: [],\n        spellcasting: [{\n          ability: 'wisdom', spellSaveDc: 13, spellAttackBonus: 5,\n          preparedSpellIds: spells,\n          knownSpellIds: [],\n        }],\n        sharedSpellSlots: [\n          { level: 1, count: 2, recharge: 'long_rest' },\n          { level: 3, count: 1, recharge: 'long_rest' },\n        ],\n      },\n      {\n        combatantId: 'combatant:recovery-target',\n        tokenId: 'token:recovery-target',\n        characterId: 2,\n        classes: [{ classId: 'Fighter', level: 5 }],\n        abilities: { strength: 16, dexterity: 10, constitution: 14, intelligence: 10, wisdom: 10, charisma: 10 },\n        armorClass: 16,\n        hitPointMaximum: 44,\n        sizeCategory: 'Medium',\n        walkingSpeedFeet: 30,\n        initiativeBonus: 0,\n        savingThrowBonuses: { strength: 5, dexterity: 0, constitution: 2, intelligence: 0, wisdom: 0, charisma: 0 },\n        attacksPerAction: 2,\n        attacks: [{\n          attackId: 'attack:recovery-target', kind: 'melee', attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20,\n          reachFeet: 5, rangeFeet: 5,\n          damage: [{ damageTypeId: 'Slashing', count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 3 }],\n        }],\n        startingConditions: [],\n      },\n      {\n        combatantId: 'combatant:recovery-observer',\n        tokenId: 'token:recovery-observer',\n        characterId: 3,\n        classes: [{ classId: 'Rogue', level: 5 }],\n        abilities: { strength: 10, dexterity: 16, constitution: 12, intelligence: 10, wisdom: 10, charisma: 10 },\n        armorClass: 14,\n        hitPointMaximum: 32,\n        sizeCategory: 'Medium',\n        walkingSpeedFeet: 30,\n        initiativeBonus: -1,\n        savingThrowBonuses: { strength: 0, dexterity: 5, constitution: 1, intelligence: 0, wisdom: 0, charisma: 0 },\n        attacksPerAction: 1,\n        attacks: [{\n          attackId: 'attack:recovery-observer', kind: 'melee', attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20,\n          reachFeet: 5, rangeFeet: 5,\n          damage: [{ damageTypeId: 'Piercing', count: 1, sides: 6, modifier: 3 }],\n        }],\n        startingConditions: [],\n      },\n    ],\n  });\n  expect(loaded.status).toBe('loaded');\n  if (loaded.status !== 'loaded') throw new Error(`Party refused: ${loaded.refusal.reason}`);\n  return loaded.party.members;\n}\n\nfunction encounter(\n  members: readonly LoadedPartyMember[],\n  targetColumn: number,\n  life: 'dying' | 'dead' = 'dying',\n): EncounterState {\n  const healer = members[0];\n  const target = members[1];\n  if (healer === undefined || target === undefined) throw new Error('Fixture party is incomplete.');\n  const started = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 20, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [healer.profile, target.profile],\n    tokens: [\n      combatToken(healer.profile, { column: 0, row: 0 }),\n      combatToken(target.profile, { column: targetColumn, row: 0 }),\n    ],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n  return {\n    ...started,\n    combatants: started.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n      combatant.profile.id !== target.profile.id\n        ? combatant\n        : {\n            ...combatant,\n            hitPoints: 0,\n            life,\n            deathSaves: life === 'dying' ? { successes: 0, failures: 1 } : null,\n            deathAt: life === 'dead' ? { round: 1, initiativeIndex: 1 } : null,\n          }),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction targetStart(state: EncounterState, target: LoadedPartyMember): TimelineBoundary {\n  return { round: 1, combatant: target.profile.id, boundary: 'start' };\n}\n\ndescribe('recovery-capability-v1', () => {\n  it('proves an in-range loaded healer with a remaining slot before the dying target turn', () => {\n    const members = loadedParty(['healing-word']);\n    const target = members[1];\n    if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const state = encounter(members, 6);\n    const result = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      state, projectEncounterTimeline(state, []), members, target.profile.id, targetStart(state, target),\n    );\n\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({ policy: RECOVERY_CAPABILITY_POLICY, status: 'resolved' });\n    if (result.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(result.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toEqual([{\n      rescuer: members[0]?.profile.id,\n      spellId: 'healing-word',\n      kind: 'healing',\n      slotLevel: 1,\n      castingTime: 'bonus_action',\n      turnRound: 1,\n      reach: 'in_range',\n      movementFeet: 0,\n      knowledge: 'dm_omniscient_party_resources',\n      source: 'encounter_state_and_loaded_party',\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('qualifies Cure Wounds by available movement when it starts out of range', () => {\n    const members = loadedParty(['cure-wounds']);\n    const target = members[1];\n    if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const state = encounter(members, 7);\n    const result = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      state, projectEncounterTimeline(state, []), members, target.profile.id, targetStart(state, target),\n    );\n\n    if (result.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(result.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(result.known_recovery_before_boundary.options[0]).toMatchObject({\n      spellId: 'cure-wounds', reach: 'movement_qualified', movementFeet: 30, castingTime: 'action',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('does not treat healing as revival for a dead target', () => {\n    const healingOnlyMembers = loadedParty(['healing-word']);\n    const healingOnlyTarget = healingOnlyMembers[1];\n    if (healingOnlyTarget === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const healingOnlyState = encounter(healingOnlyMembers, 1, 'dead');\n    const healingOnly = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      healingOnlyState,\n      projectEncounterTimeline(healingOnlyState, []),\n      healingOnlyMembers,\n      healingOnlyTarget.profile.id,\n      targetStart(healingOnlyState, healingOnlyTarget),\n    );\n    if (healingOnly.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(healingOnly.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toEqual([]);\n\n    const revivalMembers = loadedParty(['healing-word', 'revivify']);\n    const revivalTarget = revivalMembers[1];\n    if (revivalTarget === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const revivalState = encounter(revivalMembers, 1, 'dead');\n    const revival = recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      revivalState, projectEncounterTimeline(revivalState, []), revivalMembers,\n      revivalTarget.profile.id, targetStart(revivalState, revivalTarget),\n    );\n    if (revival.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected recovery capability to resolve.');\n    expect(revival.known_recovery_before_boundary.options).toMatchObject([{\n      spellId: 'revivify', kind: 'revival', slotLevel: 3,\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('returns a typed unresolved result when the loaded party is unavailable', () => {\n    const members = loadedParty(['healing-word']);\n    const target = members[1];\n    if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Target fixture member is missing.');\n    const state = encounter(members, 1);\n\n    expect(recoveryCapabilityBeforeBoundary(\n      state, projectEncounterTimeline(state, []), null, target.profile.id, targetStart(state, target),\n    )).toEqual({\n      policy: RECOVERY_CAPABILITY_POLICY,\n      status: 'unresolved',\n      reason: 'party_data_unavailable',\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/spells-ranking-r9.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2022","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster pins Divine Favor as a one-minute non-concentration 1d4 Radiant rider"},{"id":"2023","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster pins Ensnaring Strike save, restraint, recurring dice, scaling, and concentration literals"},{"id":"2024","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster pins the Searing Smite next-hit and slot-scaling literals"},{"id":"2025","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster armed_rider_persists_after_hit: Searing Smite fires on the next weapon hit only once"},{"id":"2026","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster Divine Favor remains an active rider across subsequent weapon hits"},{"id":"2027","name":"r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster Ensnaring Strike consumes on hit and applies its failed-save restrained damage lifecycle"},{"id":"2028","name":"r9 single-spell manifest wins heal_value_drifted: Heal pins and restores the flat 70 HP literal"},{"id":"2029","name":"r9 single-spell manifest wins moonbeam_save_dropped: Moonbeam pins 2d10 Radiant plus Constitution save-half and repeats the save at turn end"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport {\n  combatantConditions,\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand, EncounterEvent } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { spellDefinition } from '../../../src/combat/spells/definitions';\nimport type { SpellCastCommand } from '../../../src/combat/spells/types';\nimport { feetPoint } from '../../../src/combat/templates';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, feet, persistentAreaId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nfunction startedEncounter(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n  targetColumn = 1,\n): EncounterState {\n  const created = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 8, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [caster, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(caster, 0, 1), placedToken(target, targetColumn, 1)],\n  });\n  return reduceEncounter(created, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\nfunction cast(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  spellId: string,\n  slotLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 6,\n  options: Partial<Pick<SpellCastCommand, 'targets' | 'area'>> = {},\n): SpellCastCommand {\n  return {\n    type: 'cast_spell',\n    actor: caster.id,\n    spellId,\n    slotLevel,\n    castAsRitual: false,\n    casterLevel: 7,\n    attackBonus: 8,\n    saveDc: 100,\n    spellcastingModifier: 4,\n    targets: options.targets ?? [],\n    area: options.area ?? null,\n    weaponAttack: null,\n    selectedOption: null,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction weaponAttack(\n  caster: CombatantProfile,\n  target: CombatantProfile,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: caster.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{ type: damageType('Slashing'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(8), modifier: 0 } }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction attackEvent(events: readonly EncounterEvent[]) {\n  const event = events.findLast(\n    (candidate): candidate is Extract<EncounterEvent, { readonly type: 'attack_resolved' }> =>\n      candidate.type === 'attack_resolved',\n  );\n  if (event === undefined) throw new Error('Expected an attack resolution.');\n  return event;\n}\n\ndescribe('r9 spell weapon-attack augmentation cluster', () => {\n  it('pins Divine Favor as a one-minute non-concentration 1d4 Radiant rider', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('divine-favor')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 1,\n      castingTime: 'bonus_action',\n      targeting: { kind: 'self' },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'weapon_attack_augmentation',\n        extraDamage: { type: damageType('Radiant'), dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 4, perSlotCount: 0 } },\n        consumeOnHit: false,\n        concentration: false,\n        durationRounds: 10,\n        followUp: null,\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('pins Ensnaring Strike save, restraint, recurring dice, scaling, and concentration literals', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('ensnaring-strike')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 1,\n      castingTime: 'bonus_action',\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'weapon_attack_augmentation',\n        extraDamage: null,\n        consumeOnHit: true,\n        concentration: true,\n        followUp: {\n          kind: 'save_then_restrain',\n          saveAbility: 'strength',\n          damageType: damageType('Piercing'),\n          dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 6, perSlotCount: 1 },\n          timing: 'target_start',\n        },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('pins the Searing Smite next-hit and slot-scaling literals', () => {\n    const definition = spellDefinition('searing-smite');\n    expect(definition).toMatchObject({\n      level: 1,\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'weapon_attack_augmentation',\n        extraDamage: { type: damageType('Fire'), dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 6, perSlotCount: 1 } },\n        consumeOnHit: true,\n        followUp: {\n          kind: 'ongoing_damage_save_ends',\n          dice: { baseCount: 1, sides: 6, perSlotCount: 1 },\n          saveAbility: 'constitution',\n          timing: 'target_start',\n        },\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('armed_rider_persists_after_hit: Searing Smite fires on the next weapon hit only once', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('searing-caster', {\n      hitPoints: 100,\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      attacksPerAction: 2,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 3, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('searing-target', { hitPoints: 200, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'searing-smite', 3), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(state.effects[0]?.payload).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'damage_rider',\n      damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Fire'), dice: { count: 3, sides: 6 } }] },\n      followUp: { damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Fire'), dice: { count: 3, sides: 6 } }] } },\n    });\n\n    const first = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n    expect(attackEvent(first.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(first.state.effects.map((effect) => effect.payload.kind)).toEqual(['ongoing_damage']);\n\n    const second = reduceEncounter(first.state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n    expect(attackEvent(second.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(second.events.filter((event) =>\n      event.type === 'effect_ended' && event.reason === 'trigger_consumed')).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it('Divine Favor remains an active rider across subsequent weapon hits', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('favor-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      attacksPerAction: 2,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 1, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('favor-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'divine-favor', 1), () => 0.5).state;\n    const first = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n    const second = reduceEncounter(first.state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5);\n\n    expect(attackEvent(first.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(attackEvent(second.events).damage?.terms).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(second.state.effects).toMatchObject([{ payload: { kind: 'damage_rider', consumeOnHit: false } }]);\n  });\n\n  it('Ensnaring Strike consumes on hit and applies its failed-save restrained damage lifecycle', () => {\n    const caster = playerProfile('ensnaring-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('ensnaring-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'ensnaring-strike', 2), () => 0.5).state;\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, weaponAttack(caster, target), () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(state.effects).toMatchObject([{\n      targets: [target.id],\n      concentrationOwner: caster.id,\n      payload: {\n        kind: 'ensnaring_strike',\n        damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Piercing'), dice: { count: 2, sides: 6 } }] },\n      },\n    }]);\n    expect(combatantConditions(state, target.id)).toContainEqual({ name: 'Restrained' });\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('r9 single-spell manifest wins', () => {\n  it('heal_value_drifted: Heal pins and restores the flat 70 HP literal', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('heal')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 6,\n      targeting: { kind: 'single', rangeFeet: 60 },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'fixed_healing',\n        baseAmount: 70,\n        additionalPerSlot: 10,\n        removesConditions: ['Blinded', 'Deafened', 'Poisoned'],\n      },\n    });\n    const caster = playerProfile('heal-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 6, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('heal-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target);\n    state = {\n      ...state,\n      combatants: state.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === target.id ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 1 } : combatant),\n    };\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, cast(caster, 'heal', 6, { targets: [target.id] }), () => 0.5).state;\n\n    expect(state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(71);\n  });\n\n  it('moonbeam_save_dropped: Moonbeam pins 2d10 Radiant plus Constitution save-half and repeats the save at turn end', () => {\n    expect(spellDefinition('moonbeam')).toMatchObject({\n      level: 2,\n      targeting: { kind: 'area', rangeFeet: 120, shape: 'cylinder', baseSizeFeet: 5, secondarySizeFeet: 40 },\n      operation: {\n        kind: 'persistent_area',\n        origin: 'selected_when_cast',\n        movableFeet: 60,\n        hooks: expect.arrayContaining([\n          expect.objectContaining({\n            hook: 'on_enter', frequency: 'once_per_turn',\n            effect: expect.objectContaining({\n              kind: 'save_gated', ability: 'constitution', onSuccess: 'half',\n              payload: { kind: 'damage', damageType: damageType('Radiant'), dice: expect.objectContaining({ baseCount: 2, sides: 10, perSlotCount: 1 }) },\n            }),\n          }),\n        ]),\n      },\n    });\n    const caster = playerProfile('moonbeam-caster', {\n      initiativeBonus: 10,\n      spellSlots: [{ level: 2, maximum: 1 }],\n    });\n    const target = monsterProfile('moonbeam-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let state = startedEncounter(caster, target, 4);\n    const placed = {\n      shape: 'cylinder' as const,\n      template: { origin: feetPoint(20, 5), radius: feet(5), height: feet(40) },\n    };\n    const initial = reduceEncounter(\n      state,\n      cast(caster, 'moonbeam', 2, { area: placed }),\n      () => 0.5,\n    );\n    expect(initial.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(initial.state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(88);\n\n    state = reduceEncounter(initial.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const recurring = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: target.id }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(recurring.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'save_resolved')).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(recurring.state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === target.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(76);\n\n    const distantTarget = monsterProfile('moonbeam-move-target', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 0 });\n    let movable = startedEncounter(caster, distantTarget, 6);\n    movable = reduceEncounter(movable, cast(caster, 'moonbeam', 2, {\n      area: { shape: 'cylinder', template: { origin: feetPoint(15, 5), radius: feet(5), height: feet(40) } },\n    }), () => 0.5).state;\n    expect(movable.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === distantTarget.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(100);\n    movable = reduceEncounter(movable, { type: 'end_turn', actor: caster.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    movable = reduceEncounter(movable, { type: 'end_turn', actor: distantTarget.id }, () => 0.5).state;\n    const movedBeam = reduceEncounter(movable, {\n      type: 'move_persistent_area', actor: caster.id, areaId: persistentAreaId('area:1'),\n      origin: { kind: 'fixed', point: feetPoint(30, 5) },\n    }, () => 0.5);\n    expect(movedBeam.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'persistent_area_triggered', areaId: persistentAreaId('area:1'), hook: 'on_enter', target: distantTarget.id,\n    }));\n    expect(movedBeam.state.combatants.find((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === distantTarget.id)?.hitPoints).toBe(88);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/tools/agent-conformance.SIMULATED.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2030","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification emits VERIFIED rows and exit 0 for only"},{"id":"2039","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification preserves accumulated lifecycle evidence when a mid-lifecycle case fails"},{"id":"2040","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification reads the optional conformance timeout override"},{"id":"2041","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification prefers per-CLI timeout overrides over the global timeout"},{"id":"2042","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification emits UNVERIFIED absent and exit 2"},{"id":"2043","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification emits UNVERIFIED authentication and exit 2"},{"id":"2044","name":"SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification parses filtering and report arguments"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';\nimport { AgentAdapterError } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-adapters/process';\nimport { PI_MCP_SKIPPED_NO_EXTENSION } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-adapters/pi';\nimport { encounterSessionId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { agentSessionIdFromCli } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session';\nimport type { AgentCliKind, AgentFailureClassification, AgentInvocation, AgentSessionAdapter, AgentSessionBinding, AgentTurnResult, CliProbe } from '../../../src/vtt/agent-session';\nimport { parseAgentConformanceArguments, runAgentConformance } from '../../../tools/agent-conformance';\nimport type { AgentConformanceDependencies } from '../../../tools/agent-conformance';\n\ntype Mode = 'verified' | 'absent' | 'authentication' | 'failed' | 'timeout' | 'skipped_mcp' |\n  'resume_failure' | 'bad_mcp_proof' | 'retry_mcp_proof';\n\nconst SIMULATED_DIGEST = '0123456789abcdef'.repeat(4);\nconst SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN = '51b0af273f28f31751890e5dfd277624e7b1b2594f4c9f50a6ab938886e9b0bb';\nconst SIMULATED_PROOF = {\n  proofToken: SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN,\n  stateRef: {\n    runId: encounterSessionId('encounter:engine-mcp'),\n    stateHandle: `engine-state:${SIMULATED_DIGEST}`,\n    expectedRevision: 1,\n  },\n} as const;\n\nclass SIMULATEDCli implements AgentSessionAdapter {\n  #resumes = 0;\n  #proofAttempts = 0;\n  constructor(\n    readonly kind: AgentCliKind,\n    private readonly mode: Mode,\n    private readonly invocations: AgentInvocation[],\n    private readonly bindings: AgentSessionBinding[],\n  ) {}\n  probe(): Promise<CliProbe> { return Promise.resolve(this.mode === 'absent' ? { present: false, version: null } : { present: true, version: 'SIMULATED-1' }); }\n  start(_invocation: AgentInvocation, _signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentTurnResult> {\n    this.invocations.push(_invocation);\n    if (this.mode === 'authentication') return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('credentials_absent', 'SIMULATED authentication'));\n    if (this.mode === 'failed') {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError(\n        'malformed_output',\n        `SIMULATED malformed output ${'M'.repeat(600)}`,\n        { stderr: `discarded-prefix-${'S'.repeat(600)}` },\n      ));\n    }\n    if (this.mode === 'timeout') {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('timeout', 'Agent CLI timed out after 300000 ms.'));\n    }\n    return Promise.resolve({\n      resumeSessionId: agentSessionIdFromCli(`${this.kind}-SIMULATED-session`),\n      sessionId: null,\n      finalText: 'BOOT',\n      usage: null,\n      exit: 'completed',\n      ...(this.mode === 'skipped_mcp' ? { contractEvidence: [PI_MCP_SKIPPED_NO_EXTENSION] } : {}),\n    });\n  }\n  resume(binding: AgentSessionBinding, _invocation: AgentInvocation, _signal: AbortSignal): Promise<AgentTurnResult> {\n    this.invocations.push(_invocation);\n    this.bindings.push(binding);\n    this.#resumes += 1;\n    if (this.mode === 'resume_failure' && this.#resumes === 1) {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('malformed_output', 'SIMULATED resume failure'));\n    }\n    if (_invocation.prompt.includes('deliberately missing session')) {\n      return Promise.reject(new AgentAdapterError('resume_not_found', 'SIMULATED missing'));\n    }\n    const proof = _invocation.prompt.includes('proof_token');\n    if (proof) this.#proofAttempts += 1;\n    const proofSucceeded = this.mode !== 'bad_mcp_proof' &&\n      (this.mode !== 'retry_mcp_proof' || this.#proofAttempts >= 3);\n    return Promise.resolve({\n      resumeSessionId: binding.sessionId,\n      sessionId: null,\n      finalText: proof && proofSucceeded ? SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN : proof ? SIMULATED_DIGEST : 'RESUME',\n      usage: null,\n      exit: 'completed',\n    });\n  }\n  classifyFailure(error: unknown): AgentFailureClassification {\n    if (!(error instanceof AgentAdapterError)) return 'unknown';\n    if (error.code === 'credentials_absent') return 'authentication';\n    if (error.code === 'timeout') return 'transport';\n    return error.code === 'resume_not_found' ? 'resume_not_found' : 'unknown';\n  }\n}\n\nconst MODES: Readonly<Record<AgentCliKind, Mode>> = { codex: 'verified', opencode: 'verified', pi: 'verified', 'claude-code': 'verified' };\n\nfunction dependenciesFor(modes: Readonly<Record<AgentCliKind, Mode>>) {\n  const output: string[] = [];\n  const errors: string[] = [];\n  const invocations: AgentInvocation[] = [];\n  const bindings: AgentSessionBinding[] = [];\n  const dependencies: AgentConformanceDependencies = {\n    adapter: (kind) => new SIMULATEDCli(kind, modes[kind], invocations, bindings),\n    now: () => '2026-08-27T20:00:00.000Z',\n    stdout: (line) => { output.push(line); },\n    stderr: (line) => { errors.push(line); },\n    expectedMcpProof: () => Promise.resolve(SIMULATED_PROOF),\n    writeReport: () => Promise.resolve(),\n  };\n  return { dependencies, output, errors, invocations, bindings };\n}\n\ndescribe('SIMULATED four-CLI conformance harness — not live CLI verification', () => {\n  it('emits VERIFIED rows and exit 0 for all lifecycle cases', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: null, reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'VERIFIED', exitCode: 0 });\n    expect(report.records.map((row) => row.status)).toEqual(['VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED']);\n    expect(report.records[0]?.lifecycle).toEqual({\n      coldStart: true,\n      sessionIdCaptured: true,\n      resume: true,\n      mcpProof: true,\n      attempts_used: 1,\n      classifiedResumeFailure: true,\n    });\n    expect(report.records[0]?.contractEvidence.marker).toContain('UNVERIFIED_CONTRACT');\n    expect(fake.output.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([\n      expect.stringContaining('SUBSTITUTED_LOCAL'),\n      'CLI | PRESENT | VERSION | STATUS | REASON | ERROR',\n    ]);\n    expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.reasoningEffort === 'low')).toBe(true);\n    expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.timeoutMs === 300_000)).toBe(true);\n    expect(fake.errors).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('emits FAILED and exit 1 for an installed contract failure', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'failed' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: null, reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'FAILED', exitCode: 1 });\n    expect(report.records[2]).toMatchObject({ cli: 'pi', status: 'FAILED', reason: 'unknown' });\n    expect(report.records[2]?.errorExcerpt).toHaveLength(500);\n    expect(report.records[2]?.errorExcerpt).toContain('SIMULATED malformed output');\n    expect(report.records[2]?.stderrTail).toBe('S'.repeat(500));\n    expect(fake.errors[0]).toContain('pi | yes | SIMULATED-1 | FAILED | unknown');\n    expect(fake.errors[0]).toContain('SIMULATED malformed output');\n  });\n\n  it('classifies timeout distinctly as transport and preserves a timeout excerpt', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, codex: 'timeout' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      reason: 'transport',\n      errorExcerpt: 'Agent CLI timed out after 300000 ms.',\n      stderrTail: '',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('keeps a Pi run UNVERIFIED when the adapter reports skipped MCP wiring', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'skipped_mcp' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'UNVERIFIED', exitCode: 2 });\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'UNVERIFIED',\n      reason: 'mcp_wiring_skipped_no_extension',\n      errorExcerpt: 'Pi MCP wiring was skipped because no extension path was configured.',\n      contractEvidence: { turnMarkers: [PI_MCP_SKIPPED_NO_EXTENSION] },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('does not report VERIFIED when MCP proof only echoes the prompt-supplied capsule digest', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, opencode: 'bad_mcp_proof' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'opencode', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      reason: 'upstream_mcp_tools_not_exposed_issue_33027',\n      lifecycle: { coldStart: true, sessionIdCaptured: true, resume: true, mcpProof: false, attempts_used: 3, classifiedResumeFailure: true },\n      errorExcerpt: expect.stringContaining('anomalyco/opencode#33027'),\n    });\n    expect(fake.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain('engine.get_state_summary');\n  });\n\n  it('judges MCP proof by the independently derived response token and never puts that token in the prompt', async () => {\n    const openCode = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    const openCodeReport = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'opencode', reportPath: null }, openCode.dependencies);\n    expect(openCodeReport.records[0]?.lifecycle.mcpProof).toBe(true);\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('engine state summary tool');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain('engine.get_state_summary');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('\"run_id\":\"encounter:engine-mcp\"');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain(`\"state_handle\":\"engine-state:${SIMULATED_DIGEST}\"`);\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('\"expected_revision\":1');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('proof_token');\n    expect(openCode.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain(SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN);\n\n    const pi = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    const piReport = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, pi.dependencies);\n    expect(piReport.records[0]?.lifecycle.mcpProof).toBe(true);\n    expect(pi.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('engine_engine_get_state_summary');\n    expect(pi.invocations[2]?.prompt).toContain('mcp({search:\"engine\"})');\n    expect(pi.invocations[2]?.prompt).not.toContain(SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN);\n  });\n\n  it('uses up to three same-session MCP proof attempts and records attempts_used', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'retry_mcp_proof' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'VERIFIED',\n      lifecycle: { mcpProof: true, attempts_used: 3 },\n    });\n    const proofInvocations = fake.invocations.filter((value) => value.prompt.includes('proof_token'));\n    expect(proofInvocations).toHaveLength(3);\n    expect(proofInvocations.every((value) => !value.prompt.includes(SIMULATED_PROOF_TOKEN))).toBe(true);\n    expect(fake.bindings.slice(1, 4).every((value) => value.sessionId === 'pi-SIMULATED-session')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('keeps generic lifecycle_incomplete reporting for a non-OpenCode MCP proof failure', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, pi: 'bad_mcp_proof' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'pi', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      reason: 'lifecycle_incomplete',\n      lifecycle: { mcpProof: false, attempts_used: 3 },\n      errorExcerpt: 'One or more required lifecycle proofs did not complete.',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('uses a valid-format fixed UUID for the Claude missing-session proof only', async () => {\n    const claude = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'claude-code', reportPath: null }, claude.dependencies);\n    expect(claude.bindings[2]?.sessionId).toBe('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001');\n\n    const codex = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n    await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, codex.dependencies);\n    expect(codex.bindings[2]?.sessionId).toBe('missing-session-codex');\n  });\n\n  it('preserves accumulated lifecycle evidence when a mid-lifecycle case fails', async () => {\n    const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, codex: 'resume_failure' });\n    const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n    expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'FAILED',\n      lifecycle: { coldStart: true, sessionIdCaptured: true, resume: false, mcpProof: false, attempts_used: 0, classifiedResumeFailure: false },\n      errorExcerpt: 'SIMULATED resume failure',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('reads the optional conformance timeout override', async () => {\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS', '456789');\n    try {\n      const fake = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n      await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n      expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.timeoutMs === 456_789)).toBe(true);\n    } finally {\n      vi.unstubAllEnvs();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('prefers per-CLI timeout overrides over the global timeout', async () => {\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS', '456789');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_CODEX', '310001');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_OPENCODE', '310002');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_PI', '310003');\n    vi.stubEnv('DND_AGENT_CONFORMANCE_TIMEOUT_MS_CLAUDE_CODE', '310004');\n    try {\n      const expected = new Map<AgentCliKind, number>([\n        ['codex', 310_001],\n        ['opencode', 310_002],\n        ['pi', 310_003],\n        ['claude-code', 310_004],\n      ]);\n      for (const kind of ['codex', 'opencode', 'pi', 'claude-code'] as const) {\n        const fake = dependenciesFor(MODES);\n        await runAgentConformance({ cli: kind, reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n        expect(fake.invocations.every((value) => value.timeoutMs === expected.get(kind))).toBe(true);\n      }\n    } finally {\n      vi.unstubAllEnvs();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it.each([['absent', 'cli_absent'], ['authentication', 'authentication']] as const)(\n    'emits UNVERIFIED %s and exit 2', async (mode, reason) => {\n      const fake = dependenciesFor({ ...MODES, opencode: mode });\n      const report = await runAgentConformance({ cli: 'opencode', reportPath: null }, fake.dependencies);\n      expect(report).toMatchObject({ aggregate: 'UNVERIFIED', exitCode: 2 });\n      expect(report.records[0]).toMatchObject({ cli: 'opencode', status: 'UNVERIFIED', reason });\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('parses filtering and report arguments', () => {\n    expect(parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--cli', 'codex', '--report', '/tmp/live.json'])).toEqual({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: '/tmp/live.json' });\n    expect(parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--', '--cli', 'codex'])).toEqual({ cli: 'codex', reportPath: null });\n    expect(() => parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--cli', 'other'])).toThrow('--cli requires');\n    expect(() => parseAgentConformanceArguments(['--unknown'])).toThrow('Unknown agent conformance argument');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/ui/authoring-form-components.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2045","name":"HA-6 dialog refuses malformed lookalike conflict data"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { AuthoringValidationIssue } from '../../../src/authoring/contracts';\nimport type {\n  AuthorableEffectKind,\n  AuthoringDraftCharacterEffect,\n  AuthoringDraftFeatureEffect,\n} from '../../../src/authoring/effect-forms';\nimport type { HomebrewDraftItemUuid, HomebrewDraftUuid } from '../../../src/authoring/ids';\nimport type { DraftRevision } from '../../../src/authoring/contracts';\nimport { RpcError } from '../../../src/rpc/protocol';\nimport { damageType } from '../../../src/domain/enums';\nimport {\n  authoringPathKey,\n  createEffectCard,\n  createOrderedCardControls,\n  effectPreview,\n  installDraftBeforeUnloadGuard,\n  installDraftNavigationGuard,\n  renderValidationSummary,\n  type AuthoringEffectDraft,\n} from '../../../src/ui/authoring/form-components';\nimport {\n  createDraftConflictDialog,\n  draftRevisionConflict,\n} from '../../../src/ui/authoring/draft-conflict-dialog';\nimport {\n  elementText,\n  installInteractiveDocument,\n  interactiveElement,\n} from '../../fixtures/interactive-dom';\nimport { Router } from '../../../src/ui/router';\nimport { Application } from '../../../src/ui/app';\n\nfunction uuid(value: string): HomebrewDraftItemUuid {\n  return value as HomebrewDraftItemUuid;\n}\n\nconst EFFECTS = {\n  damage_resistance: {\n    kind: 'damage_resistance', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-resistance'),\n    label: 'Void ward', notes: null, damage_type: damageType('Void'),\n  },\n  hp_modifier: {\n    kind: 'hp_modifier', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-hp'),\n    label: 'Sturdy', notes: null, hit_points_flat: 2, hit_points_per_level: null,\n  },\n  speed: {\n    kind: 'speed', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-speed'),\n    label: 'Quick', notes: null, speed_bonus_feet: 5,\n  },\n  ability_increase: {\n    kind: 'ability_increase', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-increase'),\n    label: 'Mighty', notes: null, ability: 'strength', amount: 2, maximum: 20,\n  },\n  ability_override: {\n    kind: 'ability_override', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-override'),\n    label: 'Giant strength', notes: null, ability: 'strength', maximum: 23,\n  },\n  armor_class_bonus: {\n    kind: 'armor_class_bonus', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-ac-bonus'),\n    label: 'Guarded', notes: null, amount: 1,\n  },\n  armor_class_formula: {\n    kind: 'armor_class_formula', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-ac-formula'),\n    label: 'Natural armor', notes: null, base: 13, ability_1: 'dexterity',\n    ability_2: null, allows_shield: true,\n  },\n  attack_ability_override: {\n    kind: 'attack_ability_override', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-attack-ability'),\n    label: 'Bonded strikes', notes: null, ability: 'charisma',\n    weapon_scope: 'one_bonded_weapon',\n  },\n  weapon_attack_bonus: {\n    kind: 'weapon_attack_bonus', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-attack'),\n    label: 'Accurate', notes: null, amount: 1, weapon_scope: 'any_weapon',\n  },\n  weapon_damage_bonus: {\n    kind: 'weapon_damage_bonus', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-damage'),\n    label: 'Forceful', notes: null, amount: 1, weapon_scope: 'any_weapon',\n  },\n  extra_attack: {\n    kind: 'extra_attack', draft_item_uuid: uuid('effect-extra'),\n    label: 'Extra Attack', notes: null, attack_count: 2,\n    weapon_scope: 'any_weapon',\n  },\n} as const satisfies Readonly<Record<AuthorableEffectKind, AuthoringEffectDraft>>;\n\nfunction noEffectActions() {\n  return {\n    onKindChange: () => undefined,\n    onCommonChange: () => undefined,\n    onFieldChange: () => undefined,\n    onMoveUp: () => undefined,\n    onMoveDown: () => undefined,\n    onRemove: () => undefined,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction keydown(key: string, shiftKey = false): KeyboardEvent {\n  const event = new Event('keydown', { cancelable: true }) as KeyboardEvent;\n  Object.defineProperties(event, {\n    key: { value: key },\n    shiftKey: { value: shiftKey },\n  });\n  return event;\n}\n\nfunction routerWindow(initialUrl: string): Window {\n  const events = new EventTarget();\n  const location = {\n    href: initialUrl,\n    origin: new URL(initialUrl).origin,\n  };\n  let state: unknown = null;\n  const moveTo = (target: string | URL): void => {\n    location.href = new URL(String(target), location.href).href;\n  };\n  const history = {\n    get state(): unknown {\n      return state;\n    },\n    pushState(nextState: unknown, _unused: string, target?: string | URL | null): void {\n      state = nextState;\n      if (target !== undefined && target !== null) moveTo(target);\n    },\n    replaceState(nextState: unknown, _unused: string, target?: string | URL | null): void {\n      state = nextState;\n      if (target !== undefined && target !== null) moveTo(target);\n    },\n  };\n  return {\n    location,\n    history,\n    addEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject) =>\n      events.addEventListener(type, listener),\n    removeEventListener: (type: string, listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject) =>\n      events.removeEventListener(type, listener),\n  } as unknown as Window;\n}\n\nasync function settle(): Promise<void> {\n  for (let turn = 0; turn < 4; turn += 1) await Promise.resolve();\n}\n\ndescribe('HA-6 shared authoring form controls', () => {\n  it('HA-EFFECT-EXHAUSTIVE renders a specific field set and preview for every domain effect kind', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const kinds = Object.keys(EFFECTS) as AuthorableEffectKind[];\n      const cards = kinds.map((kind, index) => interactiveElement(createEffectCard({\n        effect: EFFECTS[kind],\n        position: index + 1,\n        count: kinds.length,\n        allowFeatureOnly: kind === 'extra_attack',\n        ...noEffectActions(),\n      })));\n\n      expect(cards).toHaveLength(11);\n      expect(cards.map((card) => card.getAttribute('data-draft-item-uuid')))\n        .toEqual(kinds.map((kind) => EFFECTS[kind].draft_item_uuid));\n      for (const [index, card] of cards.entries()) {\n        expect(card.getAttribute('aria-label')).toContain(\n          `Effect ${String(index + 1)} of 11`,\n        );\n        const preview = card.querySelector('[aria-label=\"Effect preview\"]');\n        expect(preview).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(\n          preview?.querySelector('[data-free-text=\"unverified-origin\"]')?.textContent,\n        ).toBe(effectPreview(EFFECTS[kinds[index]!]!));\n        expect(effectPreview(EFFECTS[kinds[index]!]!)).not.toContain('undefined');\n        expect(elementText(card as unknown as Node)).not.toContain('Other');\n        expect(elementText(card as unknown as Node)).not.toContain('Numeric bonus');\n      }\n      expect(elementText(cards[0] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Damage type');\n      expect(elementText(cards[1] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Flat hit points');\n      expect(elementText(cards[6] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Allows a shield');\n      expect(elementText(cards[10] as unknown as Node)).toContain('Total attacks');\n      expect(elementText(cards[7] as unknown as Node)).toContain(\n        'Not applied to sheet numbers until the character has a bonded weapon.',\n      );\n      const knownCustom = cards[0]?.querySelectorAll('input').find(\n        (input) => input.getAttribute('list') !== null,\n      );\n      expect(knownCustom?.getAttribute('type')).toBe('text');\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('keeps hostile names and descriptions visible, marked, and inert across every requested string class', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const hostile = '</legend><img data-hostile-authoring src=x> \"quoted\" 🐉 \\u202eRTL\\u202c nul\\u0000\\u0001tail';\n      const effect: AuthoringDraftCharacterEffect = {\n        ...EFFECTS.damage_resistance,\n        label: hostile,\n        notes: hostile,\n      };\n      const card = interactiveElement(createEffectCard({\n        effect,\n        position: 1,\n        count: 1,\n        allowFeatureOnly: false,\n        ...noEffectActions(),\n      }));\n\n      expect(elementText(card as unknown as Node)).toContain(hostile);\n      expect(card.querySelectorAll('img')).toHaveLength(0);\n      expect(card.querySelectorAll('script')).toHaveLength(0);\n      expect(card.querySelectorAll('[data-hostile-authoring]')).toHaveLength(0);\n      const marked = card.querySelectorAll('[data-free-text=\"unverified-origin\"]');\n      expect(marked.map((node) => node.textContent)).toEqual([\n        effectPreview(effect),\n        hostile,\n      ]);\n      expect(card.innerHTML).toBe('');\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('moves ordered cards only through labelled keyboard-reachable buttons and disables boundaries', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const calls: string[] = [];\n      const controls = interactiveElement(createOrderedCardControls({\n        collectionKey: 'aegis-collection',\n        itemKey: 'aegis-item',\n        accessibleName: 'Aegis', position: 1, count: 2,\n        onMoveUp: () => calls.push('up'),\n        onMoveDown: () => calls.push('down'),\n        onRemove: () => calls.push('remove'),\n      }));\n      const buttons = controls.querySelectorAll('button');\n      expect(buttons.map((button) => button.getAttribute('aria-label'))).toEqual([\n        'Move up Aegis, item 1 of 2',\n        'Move down Aegis, item 1 of 2',\n        'Remove Aegis, item 1 of 2',\n      ]);\n      expect(buttons[0]?.disabled).toBe(true);\n      expect(buttons[1]?.disabled).toBe(false);\n      buttons[0]?.click();\n      buttons[1]?.click();\n      buttons[2]?.click();\n      expect(calls).toEqual(['down', 'remove']);\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('matches a reordered item by collection and item key together', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const host = document.createElement('div');\n      host.setAttribute('data-authoring-form-kind', 'test');\n      document.body.append(host);\n      const render = (moved = false): void => {\n        const duplicate = createOrderedCardControls({\n          collectionKey: 'other-collection', itemKey: 'shared-item',\n          accessibleName: 'Other item', position: 2, count: 2,\n          onMoveUp: () => undefined, onMoveDown: () => undefined, onRemove: () => undefined,\n        });\n        const intended = createOrderedCardControls({\n          collectionKey: 'intended-collection', itemKey: 'shared-item',\n          accessibleName: moved ? 'Moved intended item' : 'Intended item',\n          position: moved ? 1 : 2, count: 2,\n          onMoveUp: () => render(true), onMoveDown: () => undefined, onRemove: () => undefined,\n        });\n        host.replaceChildren(duplicate, intended);\n      };\n      render();\n\n      const moveUp = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(\n        '[data-authoring-order-action]',\n      ))\n        .find((candidate) =>\n          candidate.getAttribute('data-authoring-order-collection') === 'intended-collection' &&\n          candidate.getAttribute('data-authoring-order-action') === 'move-up');\n      moveUp?.click();\n\n      expect(document.activeElement?.getAttribute('data-authoring-order-collection'))\n        .toBe('intended-collection');\n      expect(document.activeElement?.getAttribute('aria-label'))\n        .toBe('Move down Moved intended item, item 1 of 2');\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('focuses the first invalid labelled field and reports every validation path together', () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const form = document.createElement('form');\n      const name = document.createElement('input');\n      name.dataset.authoringPath = authoringPathKey(['name']);\n      const second = document.createElement('input');\n      second.dataset.authoringPath = authoringPathKey(['traits', 0, 'name']);\n      form.append(name, second);\n      const issues: readonly AuthoringValidationIssue[] = [\n        { path: ['name'], code: 'required', message: 'Name is required.' },\n        { path: ['traits', 0, 'name'], code: 'required', message: 'Trait name is required.' },\n        { path: ['effects', 0], code: 'invalid_value', message: 'Effect is incomplete.' },\n      ];\n      const summary = interactiveElement(renderValidationSummary(form, issues));\n\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(name);\n      expect(name.getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');\n      expect(second.getAttribute('aria-invalid')).toBe('true');\n      expect(elementText(summary as unknown as Node)).toContain('Name is required.');\n      expect(elementText(summary as unknown as Node)).toContain('Trait name is required.');\n      expect(elementText(summary as unknown as Node)).toContain('Effect is incomplete.');\n      summary.querySelectorAll('a')[1]?.click();\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(second);\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('screen-scoped dirty guard refuses navigation and is disposed on real screen unmount', async () => {\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    let allow = false;\n    try {\n      const root = document.createElement('div');\n      document.body.append(root);\n      const router = new Router(routerWindow('https://example.test/guarded'));\n      const application = new Application(\n        root,\n        null as never,\n        router,\n        () => true,\n        [\n          {\n            id: 'guarded-test-screen',\n            matches: (route) => route.path === '/guarded',\n            render: (context) => {\n              installDraftNavigationGuard(context, {\n                isDirty: () => true,\n                confirmLeave: () => allow,\n              });\n            },\n          },\n          {\n            id: 'plain-test-screen',\n            matches: () => true,\n            render: () => undefined,\n          },\n        ],\n      );\n      application.start();\n      await settle();\n\n      expect(router.navigate('/refused')).toBe(false);\n      expect(router.current.path).toBe('/guarded');\n\n      allow = true;\n      expect(router.navigate('/unmounted')).toBe(true);\n      allow = false;\n      expect(router.navigate('/after-unmount')).toBe(true);\n      expect(router.current.path).toBe('/after-unmount');\n\n      application.stop();\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('warns on browser unload only while the draft has unsaved local changes', () => {\n    const target = new EventTarget();\n    let dirty = true;\n    const cleanup = installDraftBeforeUnloadGuard(\n      target as unknown as Window,\n      () => dirty,\n    );\n    const blocked = new Event('beforeunload', { cancelable: true });\n    target.dispatchEvent(blocked);\n    expect(blocked.defaultPrevented).toBe(true);\n    dirty = false;\n    const clean = new Event('beforeunload', { cancelable: true });\n    target.dispatchEvent(clean);\n    expect(clean.defaultPrevented).toBe(false);\n    cleanup();\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('HA-6 stale draft conflict dialog', () => {\n  it('attaches before showModal, recognizes revision-CAS errors, and traps/restores focus', async () => {\n    const conflict = draftRevisionConflict(new RpcError(\n      'handler_error',\n      'Draft revision is stale.',\n      {\n        reason: 'stale_draft_revision',\n        draft_uuid: 'draft-conflict',\n        expected_revision: 3,\n        actual_revision: 4,\n      },\n    ));\n    expect(conflict).toEqual({\n      draft_uuid: 'draft-conflict', expected_revision: 3, actual_revision: 4,\n    });\n    if (conflict === null) throw new Error('Conflict was not recognized.');\n\n    const restoreDocument = installInteractiveDocument();\n    try {\n      const invoker = document.createElement('button');\n      document.body.append(invoker);\n      invoker.focus();\n      const choices: string[] = [];\n      const rendered = createDraftConflictDialog({\n        conflict,\n        mount: document.body,\n        restoreFocus: () => invoker.focus(),\n        onLoadSaved: () => { choices.push('load'); },\n        onKeepLocal: () => { choices.push('keep'); },\n      });\n      const dialog = interactiveElement(rendered.element);\n      const buttons = dialog.querySelectorAll('button');\n\n      expect(dialog.getAttribute('aria-modal')).toBe('true');\n      expect(dialog.isConnected).toBe(true);\n      expect(dialog.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).toBe('authoring-conflict-heading');\n      expect(elementText(dialog as unknown as Node)).toContain(\n        'revision 3, but revision 4 is now saved. Nothing was overwritten.',\n      );\n      expect(elementText(dialog as unknown as Node)).not.toContain('Overwrite');\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(buttons[0]);\n      dialog.dispatchEvent(keydown('Tab', true));\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(buttons[1]);\n      dialog.dispatchEvent(keydown('Tab'));\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(buttons[0]);\n      dialog.dispatchEvent(keydown('Escape'));\n      await rendered.whenSettled();\n      expect(choices).toEqual(['keep']);\n      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(invoker);\n      rendered.cleanup();\n    } finally {\n      restoreDocument();\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('refuses malformed lookalike conflict data', () => {\n    expect(draftRevisionConflict(new RpcError(\n      'handler_error',\n      'bad',\n      { reason: 'stale_draft_revision', draft_uuid: 'draft', expected_revision: '3', actual_revision: 4 },\n    ))).toBeNull();\n    expect(draftRevisionConflict(new Error('Draft revision is stale.'))).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n\n// Compile-only witnesses keep both effect unions exercised by this test file.\nconst characterWitness: AuthoringDraftCharacterEffect = EFFECTS.ability_override;\nconst featureWitness: AuthoringDraftFeatureEffect = EFFECTS.extra_attack;\nconst draftUuidWitness = 'draft' as HomebrewDraftUuid;\nconst revisionWitness = 1 as DraftRevision;\nvoid characterWitness;\nvoid featureWitness;\nvoid draftUuidWitness;\nvoid revisionWitness;\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/wild-shape-persistence.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2054","name":"Wild Shape session persistence round-trips a wildshaped combatant through export, strict decode, import, replay, and resume"},{"id":"2055","name":"Wild Shape session persistence closed_union_decode: refuses an unrecognized persisted overlay kind instead of widening it"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport {\n  encounterBranchId,\n  encounterSessionId,\n  statblockId,\n} from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { createWildShapeCharacterSheet, decodeWildShapeOverlay } from '../../../src/combat/wild-shape';\nimport type { PersistedCoordinatorState } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport {\n  EncounterSessionJournal,\n  MemoryBrowserSessionStore,\n  MemoryMirrorSink,\n  exportSavedSession,\n  importSavedSession,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/session-persistence';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst COORDINATOR: PersistedCoordinatorState = {\n  requestSequence: 1,\n  pendingRequest: null,\n  pendingCommand: null,\n  continuation: { kind: 'idle' },\n  pause: null,\n};\n\nfunction shapedEncounter() {\n  const base = playerProfile('persist-wild-druid', { hitPoints: 24, initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  if (base.kind !== 'player_character') throw new Error('Wild Shape persistence fixture is not a PC.');\n  const druid: Extract<CombatantProfile, { readonly kind: 'player_character' }> = {\n    ...base,\n    wildShape: createWildShapeCharacterSheet(2, [\n
