'statblock:wolf',\n      'statblock:boar',\n      'statblock:homebrew-beast/brush-bear',\n      'statblock:homebrew-beast/threadling-weaver',\n    ]),\n  };\n  const enemy = monsterProfile('persist-wild-enemy', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const started = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 2 },\n    combatants: [druid, enemy],\n    tokens: [placedToken(druid, 0), placedToken(enemy, 1)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0).state;\n  const shaped = reduceEncounter(started, {\n    type: 'assume_wild_shape',\n    actor: druid.id,\n    formId: statblockId('statblock:wolf'),\n    equipmentDisposition: 'merged_into_form',\n  }, () => 0).state;\n  return { druid, shaped };\n}\n\ndescribe('Wild Shape session persistence', () => {\n  it('round-trips a wildshaped combatant through export, strict decode, import, replay, and resume', () => {\n    const fixture = shapedEncounter();\n    const source = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n    const sessionId = encounterSessionId('session:wild-shape-round-trip');\n    EncounterSessionJournal.create({\n      sessionId,\n      branchId: encounterBranchId('branch:wild-shape-main'),\n      encounterState: fixture.shaped,\n      coordinatorState: COORDINATOR,\n      controllers: [],\n      rng: mulberry32(4242),\n      store: source,\n      mirror: new MemoryMirrorSink(),\n    });\n    const destination = new MemoryBrowserSessionStore();\n    expect(importSavedSession(destination, exportSavedSession(source, sessionId))).toBe(sessionId);\n    const resumed = EncounterSessionJournal.resume(sessionId, destination, new MemoryMirrorSink());\n    const restored = resumed.encounterState.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === fixture.druid.id);\n    expect(restored?.wildShape).toEqual(\n      fixture.shaped.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === fixture.druid.id)?.wildShape,\n    );\n    expect(restored?.wildShapeUses).toEqual({ kind: 'wild_shape_uses', maximum: 2, remaining: 1 });\n  });\n\n  it('closed_union_decode: refuses an unrecognized persisted overlay kind instead of widening it', () => {\n    const fixture = shapedEncounter();\n    const overlay = fixture.shaped.combatants.find((entry) => entry.profile.id === fixture.druid.id)?.wildShape;\n    if (overlay === undefined) throw new Error('Wild Shape overlay fixture is absent.');\n    expect(() => decodeWildShapeOverlay({ ...overlay, kind: 'wild_shape_from_the_future' }))\n      .toThrow('unknown kind');\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/legendary-windows.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2056","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 reports Unicorn pools, the hand-built post-player window, and tactical verdicts for pending actions"},{"id":"2057","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 mutation_guard: reports two remaining legendary uses after one declared-use action"},{"id":"2058","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 exposes pending legendary-resistance save and severity facts without choosing a policy"},{"id":"2059","name":"M4 legendary-windows-v1 returns typed unresolved results when no legendary actor or no timeline is available"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport {\n  createEncounter,\n  reduceEncounter,\n  type EncounterState,\n} from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { monsterCombatantProfile, type CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { damageType, dieSides } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { UNICORN } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/monsters';\nimport {\n  LEGENDARY_WINDOWS_POLICY,\n  provideLegendaryWindows,\n  type LegendaryWindowsIntel,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/intel/legendary-windows';\nimport {\n  projectEncounterTimeline,\n  type EncounterTimelineProjection,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/session-timeline';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction face(value: number): () => number {\n  return () => (value - 0.5) / 20;\n}\n\nfunction unicornProfile(key = 'legendary-window-unicorn'): CombatantProfile {\n  return monsterCombatantProfile(UNICORN, {\n    combatantId: `combatant:${key}`,\n    tokenId: `token:${key}`,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction startedEncounter(\n  player: CombatantProfile,\n  unicorn = unicornProfile(),\n): { readonly state: EncounterState; readonly player: CombatantProfile; readonly unicorn: CombatantProfile } {\n  const combatants = [player, unicorn];\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 12, rows: 4 },\n    combatants,\n    tokens: combatants.map((profile, index) => placedToken(profile, index, 1)),\n  });\n  return {\n    state: reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.975).state,\n    player,\n    unicorn,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction full(\n  state: EncounterState,\n  severityInputs: Parameters<typeof provideLegendaryWindows>[0]['resistanceSeverityInputs'] = [],\n  timeline: EncounterTimelineProjection | null = projectEncounterTimeline(state, []),\n): LegendaryWindowsIntel {\n  return provideLegendaryWindows({\n    state,\n    timeline,\n    detail: 'full',\n    resistanceSeverityInputs: severityInputs,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction requireDetails(intel: LegendaryWindowsIntel) {\n  if (intel.status !== 'resolved' || intel.details === null) throw new Error('Expected resolved full legendary intel.');\n  return intel.details;\n}\n\ndescribe('M4 legendary-windows-v1', () => {\n  it('reports Unicorn pools, the hand-built post-player window, and tactical verdicts for pending actions', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('legendary-window-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const setup = startedEncounter(player);\n    const handBuiltTimeline = {\n      phase: setup.state.phase,\n      round: 1,\n      currentCombatant: player.id,\n      initiative: [],\n      upcoming: [{\n        kind: 'legendary_action_window', legendaryCombatant: setup.unicorn.id,\n        boundary: { round: 1, combatant: player.id, boundary: 'end' },\n      }],\n      roundBoundaries: [],\n      branchPoints: [],\n    } satisfies EncounterTimelineProjection;\n    const beforeWindow = requireDetails(full(setup.state, [], handBuiltTimeline)).actors[0];\n    if (beforeWindow === undefined || beforeWindow.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected resolved Unicorn facts.');\n    expect(beforeWindow.nextWindow).toEqual({\n      status: 'resolved', afterCombatant: player.id, round: 1, source: 'timeline',\n    });\n\n    const state = reduceEncounter(setup.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: player.id }, face(10)).state;\n\n    const intel = full(state);\n    const details = requireDetails(intel);\n    const unicorn = details.actors[0];\n    if (unicorn === undefined || unicorn.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected resolved Unicorn facts.');\n\n    expect(intel.policy).toBe(LEGENDARY_WINDOWS_POLICY);\n    expect(intel.compact).toEqual([\n      'legendary', 'Unicorn', 'actions', '3/3', 'resistance', '3/3',\n      'next', String(player.id), 'pending', 'action',\n    ]);\n    expect(intel.compact).toHaveLength(10);\n    expect(unicorn.nextWindow).toEqual({\n      status: 'resolved', afterCombatant: player.id, round: 1, source: 'pending_decision',\n    });\n    expect(unicorn.pendingWindow?.options.map((option) => option.option.id)).toEqual([\n      'legendary_action:charging-horn', 'legendary_action:shimmering-shield', 'pass',\n    ]);\n    const horn = unicorn.pendingWindow?.options[0];\n    if (horn === undefined || horn.status !== 'resolved' || horn.assessment.kind !== 'attack') {\n      throw new Error('Expected a scored Charging Horn.');\n    }\n    expect(horn.assessment.tactical).toEqual({\n      policy: 'tactical-evaluator-v2',\n      range: { status: 'resolved', distanceFeet: 5, band: 'melee', legal: true },\n      rollMode: { mode: 'normal', reasons: [], sources: [] },\n      probabilities: { status: 'resolved', hit: 0.7, critical: 0.05, miss: 0.3 },\n      damage: {\n        // (13/20 × 9.5) + (1/20 × 15), represented by the evaluator's IEEE-754 arithmetic.\n        status: 'resolved', normalHitAverage: 9.5, criticalHitAverage: 15, expectedDamage: 6.924999999999999,\n      },\n      consequences: {\n        deathFailureOnHit: false, failuresOnHit: 0, failuresOnCritical: 0,\n        automaticCriticalOnHit: false, automaticCriticalMaximumDistanceFeet: null,\n      },\n      unresolved: [],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('mutation_guard: reports two remaining legendary uses after one declared-use action', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('legendary-window-spend-player', { initiativeBonus: 20, hitPoints: 100 });\n    const setup = startedEncounter(player);\n    const queued = reduceEncounter(setup.state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: player.id }, face(10)).state;\n    const decision = queued.pendingDecisions.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'legendary_action_window');\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected Unicorn legendary window.');\n    const spent = reduceEncounter(queued, {\n      type: 'resolve_pending_decision', decisionId: decision.id, optionId: 'legendary_action:charging-horn',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n\n    const unicorn = requireDetails(full(spent)).actors[0];\n    if (unicorn === undefined || unicorn.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected resolved Unicorn facts.');\n    // A plausible off-by-one mutant reports 3 here; the reducer has spent Charging Horn's cost of 1.\n    expect(unicorn.actionUses).toEqual({ remaining: 2, maximum: 3 });\n  });\n\n  it('exposes pending legendary-resistance save and severity facts without choosing a policy', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('legendary-resistance-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const setup = startedEncounter(player);\n    const failed = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'force_save', actor: player.id, target: setup.unicorn.id,\n      ability: 'constitution', dc: 20, rollMode: 'normal', cost: 'none', onSuccess: 'none',\n      damage: {\n        terms: [{ type: damageType('Force'), dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 4 } }],\n        critical: false, responses: [],\n      },\n    }, face(1)).state;\n    const decision = failed.pendingDecisions.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'legendary_resistance');\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected failed-save Legendary Resistance decision.');\n\n    const details = requireDetails(full(failed, [{\n      decisionId: decision.id,\n      effectSeverity: {\n        damageExpected: 4, imposedConditions: ['Poisoned'], forcedMovementFeet: null, removesTurn: false,\n      },\n    }]));\n    expect(details.resistanceSpendInputs).toEqual([{\n      status: 'resolved', decisionId: decision.id, combatant: setup.unicorn.id,\n      source: player.id, failedAbility: 'constitution', saveDc: 20,\n      effectSeverity: {\n        damageExpected: 4, imposedConditions: ['Poisoned'], forcedMovementFeet: null, removesTurn: false,\n      },\n    }]);\n  });\n\n  it('returns typed unresolved results when no legendary actor or no timeline is available', () => {\n    const player = playerProfile('ordinary-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const ordinary = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 4 }, combatants: [player], tokens: [placedToken(player, 0, 0)],\n    });\n    expect(provideLegendaryWindows({ state: ordinary, timeline: null, detail: 'compact' })).toMatchObject({\n      policy: LEGENDARY_WINDOWS_POLICY, status: 'unresolved', reason: 'no_legendary_actor',\n    });\n\n    const setup = startedEncounter(playerProfile('timeline-missing-player', { initiativeBonus: 20 }));\n    const intel = provideLegendaryWindows({ state: setup.state, timeline: null, detail: 'full' });\n    const unicorn = requireDetails(intel).actors[0];\n    if (unicorn === undefined || unicorn.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Expected Unicorn facts.');\n    expect(unicorn.nextWindow).toEqual({ status: 'unresolved', reason: 'timeline_unavailable' });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/symmetric-pc-evaluator.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2060","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator chooses the hand-computed movement-evaluator optimum through actor knowledge"},{"id":"2061","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator does not use full monster AC or HP when full knowledge would pick another target"},{"id":"2062","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator keeps unknown AC and HP in typed tactical unresolved results"},{"id":"2063","name":"symmetric scripted-PC evaluator is deterministic for equal state and legal-command transcripts"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { armorClass, damageType, dieSides, feet } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { evaluateTacticalAttack } from '../../../src/combat/tactical-evaluator';\nimport {\n  DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_PC_DECISION_POLICY,\n  evaluateSymmetricPcDecision,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/symmetric-pc-evaluator';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ndeclareTestInputs({});\n\nfunction attack(\n  actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'],\n  target: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>['id'],\n  range: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }>['tacticalRange'],\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  if (range === undefined) throw new Error('The test attack requires a typed tactical range.');\n  return {\n    type: 'attack', actor, target, attackBonus: 5, criticalFloor: 20, rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true, tacticalRange: range,\n    damage: { terms: [{ type: damageType('Piercing'), dice: { count: 1, sides: dieSides(8), modifier: 3 } }], critical: false, responses: [] },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction ready(state: EncounterState, actorId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id']): EncounterState {\n  return {\n    ...state,\n    combatants: state.combatants.map((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === actorId\n      ? {\n          ...combatant,\n          turn: {\n            ...combatant.turn,\n            action: { kind: 'available' },\n            movement: { speed: feet(30), spent: feet(0), remaining: feet(30) },\n          },\n        }\n      : combatant),\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('symmetric scripted-PC evaluator', () => {\n  it('chooses the hand-computed movement-evaluator optimum through actor knowledge', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const target = monsterProfile('symmetric-target');\n    const state = ready(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 3)],\n    }), actor.id);\n    const ranged = attack(actor.id, target.id, {\n      kind: 'ranged', normalRangeFeet: feet(10), longRangeFeet: feet(20),\n    });\n    const move: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'move' }> = {\n      type: 'move', actor: actor.id, path: [{ column: 1, row: 0 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    };\n\n    // At 15 feet the attack is legal only at long range. Moving 5 feet makes\n    // the distance 10 feet, exactly normal range, so movement-eval ranks it first.\n    const decision = evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({\n      state, actorId: actor.id, legalActions: [ranged, move, { type: 'end_turn', actor: actor.id }],\n    });\n\n    expect(DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_PC_DECISION_POLICY).toBe('symmetric_evaluator_v1');\n    expect(decision.policyVersions).toEqual({\n      tactical: 'tactical-evaluator-v2',\n      movement: 'movement-eval-v1',\n      concentration: 'concentration-intel-v1',\n      actorKnowledge: 'actor-knowledge-v2',\n    });\n    expect(decision.selected.command).toEqual(move);\n    const movement = decision.selected.movement;\n    if (movement?.status !== 'evaluated') throw new Error('Expected projected movement evaluation.');\n    expect(movement.evaluation.candidates.find((candidate) =>\n      candidate.destination.column === 1 && candidate.destination.row === 0)?.semantic).toEqual({\n      status: 'resolved', kind: 'move_5_to_normal_range',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('does not use full monster AC or HP when full knowledge would pick another target', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const alphaBase = monsterProfile('alpha', { hitPoints: 10 });\n    const betaBase = monsterProfile('beta', { hitPoints: 40 });\n    const alpha = { ...alphaBase, rules: { ...alphaBase.rules, armorClass: armorClass(18) } };\n    const beta = { ...betaBase, rules: { ...betaBase.rules, armorClass: armorClass(10) } };\n    const created = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 2 },\n      combatants: [actor, alpha, beta],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(alpha, 1, 0), placedToken(beta, 1, 1)],\n    });\n    const state = ready({\n      ...created,\n      combatants: created.combatants.map((combatant) => combatant.profile.id === alpha.id\n        ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 1 }\n        : combatant),\n    }, actor.id);\n    const range = { kind: 'melee' as const, reachFeet: feet(5) };\n    const alphaAttack = attack(actor.id, alpha.id, range);\n    const betaAttack = attack(actor.id, beta.id, range);\n    const decision = evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({\n      state,\n      actorId: actor.id,\n      legalActions: [betaAttack, alphaAttack, { type: 'end_turn', actor: actor.id }],\n    });\n    const fullAlpha = evaluateTacticalAttack({\n      attackerId: actor.id, targetId: alpha.id, attackerPosition: { column: 0, row: 0 }, targetPosition: { column: 1, row: 0 },\n      range, attackBonus: 5, targetArmorClass: 18, criticalFloor: 20,\n      damageTerms: [{ dice: { count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 3 } }], attackerConditions: [], targetConditions: [],\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true, rollModeSources: [],\n      target: { hitPoints: 1, usesDeathSaves: false },\n    });\n    const fullBeta = evaluateTacticalAttack({\n      attackerId: actor.id, targetId: beta.id, attackerPosition: { column: 0, row: 0 }, targetPosition: { column: 1, row: 1 },\n      range, attackBonus: 5, targetArmorClass: 10, criticalFloor: 20,\n      damageTerms: [{ dice: { count: 1, sides: 8, modifier: 3 } }], attackerConditions: [], targetConditions: [],\n      attackerCanSeeTarget: true, targetCanSeeAttacker: true, rollModeSources: [],\n      target: { hitPoints: 40, usesDeathSaves: false },\n    });\n    if (fullAlpha.damage.status !== 'resolved' || fullBeta.damage.status !== 'resolved') {\n      throw new Error('Full-knowledge comparison must resolve both attacks.');\n    }\n\n    // Full knowledge favours beta's AC 10. The PC receives only AC bands and\n    // never turns either band or alpha's 1 HP into a numeric evaluator input.\n    expect(fullBeta.damage.expectedDamage).toBeGreaterThan(fullAlpha.damage.expectedDamage);\n    expect(decision.selected.command).toEqual(alphaAttack);\n    expect(decision.actorKnowledge.targets.map((targetKnowledge) => targetKnowledge.kind === 'perceived'\n      ? [targetKnowledge.targetId, targetKnowledge.armorClass, targetKnowledge.hitPoints]\n      : [targetKnowledge.targetId, targetKnowledge.kind])).toEqual([\n      [alpha.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'heavily_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'near_death' }],\n      [beta.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'uninjured' }],\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('keeps unknown AC and HP in typed tactical unresolved results', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const target = monsterProfile('unknown-target');\n    const state = ready(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 1 }, combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 1)],\n    }), actor.id);\n    const command = attack(actor.id, target.id, { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: feet(5) });\n    const decision = evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({\n      state, actorId: actor.id, legalActions: [command, { type: 'end_turn', actor: actor.id }],\n    });\n    const tactical = decision.selected.tactical;\n    if (tactical?.status !== 'evaluated') throw new Error('Expected an evaluated tactical input.');\n\n    expect(tactical.evaluation.probabilities).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_armor_class_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(tactical.evaluation.damage).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_armor_class_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(tactical.evaluation.consequences).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_hit_points_unresolved',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('is deterministic for equal state and legal-command transcripts', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('symmetric-pc');\n    const target = monsterProfile('deterministic-target');\n    const state = ready(createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 3, rows: 1 }, combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 1)],\n    }), actor.id);\n    const legalActions = [\n      attack(actor.id, target.id, { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: feet(5) }),\n      { type: 'dodge' as const, actor: actor.id },\n      { type: 'end_turn' as const, actor: actor.id },\n    ];\n\n    expect(evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({ state, actorId: actor.id, legalActions }))\n      .toEqual(evaluateSymmetricPcDecision({ state: structuredClone(state), actorId: actor.id, legalActions: structuredClone(legalActions) }));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/detection-ui.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2064","name":"D373 detection UI projections tray_hides_autofire: always-policy auto-fire remains a non-interactive tray audit entry"},{"id":"2065","name":"D373 detection UI projections projects queued decision context and the typed turn-boundary refusal highlight"},{"id":"2066","name":"D373 detection UI projections keeps the tray non-blocking until end turn, then allows a retry after resolution"},{"id":"2067","name":"D373 detection UI projections hidden_token_rendered: hidden occupants become fog-only cells in DM and shared board data"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { ControllerRegistry, HumanController, type ControllerIdentity } from '../../../src/combat/controllers';\nimport { TurnCoordinator } from '../../../src/combat/coordinator';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { projectDmView, projectPlayerView } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { encounterBoardRenderModel, projectEncounterBoard } from '../../../src/vtt/encounter-board';\nimport { projectDmBoard, projectPlayerBoard } from '../../../src/vtt/encounter-projections';\nimport { REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter-art';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nconst IDLE = {\n  requestSequence: 1,\n  pendingRequest: null,\n  pendingCommand: null,\n  continuation: { kind: 'idle' as const },\n  pause: null,\n};\n\nfunction face(value: number): () => number {\n  return () => (value - 0.5) / 20;\n}\n\nfunction encounter(policy: 'ask' | 'always' = 'ask'): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly mover: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>;\n  readonly reactor: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>;\n} {\n  const mover = playerProfile('detection-ui-mover', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const reactor = monsterProfile('detection-ui-reactor', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const initial = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 3 },\n    combatants: [mover, reactor],\n    tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1, 1), placedToken(reactor, 0, 1)],\n    reactionPolicies: [{ combatant: reactor.id, reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack', policy }],\n  });\n  return {\n    state: reduceEncounter(initial, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, face(10)).state,\n    mover,\n    reactor,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction identities(state: EncounterState): readonly ControllerIdentity[] {\n  return state.combatants.map((subject) => ({\n    combatantId: subject.profile.id,\n    controllerId: `${subject.profile.id}:human:test`,\n    kind: 'human',\n    generation: 0,\n  }));\n}\n\ndescribe('D373 detection UI projections', () => {\n  it('tray_hides_autofire: always-policy auto-fire remains a non-interactive tray audit entry', () => {\n    const setup = encounter('always');\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const projection = projectDmBoard({\n      view: projectDmView(moved),\n      coordinator: IDLE,\n      controllers: identities(moved),\n      history: [],\n    });\n\n    expect(projection.decisionTray.entries).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      kind: 'auto_fire_log',\n      combatantId: setup.reactor.id,\n      reactionKind: 'opportunity_attack',\n      policy: 'always',\n      resolution: 'accept',\n      autoFired: true,\n      interactive: false,\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('projects queued decision context and the typed turn-boundary refusal highlight', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const projection = projectDmBoard({\n      view: projectDmView(moved),\n      coordinator: IDLE,\n      controllers: identities(moved),\n      history: [],\n      boundaryRefusal: {\n        code: 'turn_boundary_blocked',\n        message: 'The turn cannot advance while a pending decision for this boundary is unresolved.',\n      },\n    });\n\n    expect(projection.decisionTray.entries[0]).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'pending',\n      combatantName: 'detection-ui-reactor',\n      triggerContext: expect.stringContaining('moved from 1,1 to 2,1'),\n      interactive: true,\n    });\n    expect(projection.decisionTray.boundaryRefusal).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      code: 'turn_boundary_blocked',\n    }));\n  });\n\n  it('keeps the tray non-blocking until end turn, then allows a retry after resolution', async () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const moved = reduceEncounter(setup.state, {\n      type: 'move', actor: setup.mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 1 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n    }, face(20)).state;\n    const moverController = new HumanController();\n    const coordinator = new TurnCoordinator(\n      moved,\n      new ControllerRegistry([\n        { combatantId: setup.mover.id, controller: moverController, controllerId: 'controller:mover' },\n        { combatantId: setup.reactor.id, controller: new HumanController(), controllerId: 'controller:reactor' },\n      ]),\n      face(10),\n      {\n        pendingDecisionTray: true,\n        turnLegalActions: (_state, actor) => ({ actions: [{ type: 'end_turn', actor }] }),\n      },\n    );\n    const pendingStep = coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const request = moverController.pendingRequest();\n    if (request === null) throw new Error('Expected the mover turn request.');\n    moverController.submit({\n      requestId: request.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: request.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: setup.mover.id },\n    });\n    const refusal = await pendingStep;\n    expect(refusal).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'refused',\n      pendingDecisionCode: 'turn_boundary_blocked',\n    });\n\n    const decision = coordinator.state().pendingDecisions[0];\n    if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Expected a queued tray decision.');\n    expect(coordinator.resolvePendingDecision({\n      type: 'resolve_pending_decision', decisionId: decision.id, optionId: 'decline',\n    }).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect(coordinator.state().activeCombatant).toBe(setup.mover.id);\n    const resumedStep = coordinator.step();\n    await Promise.resolve();\n    const resumedRequest = moverController.pendingRequest();\n    if (resumedRequest === null) throw new Error('Expected the resumed mover turn request.');\n    moverController.submit({\n      requestId: resumedRequest.requestId,\n      encounterRevision: resumedRequest.encounterRevision,\n      action: { type: 'end_turn', actor: setup.mover.id },\n    });\n    expect((await resumedStep).kind).toBe('applied');\n    expect(coordinator.state().activeCombatant).toBe(setup.reactor.id);\n  });\n\n  it('hidden_token_rendered: hidden occupants become fog-only cells in DM and shared board data', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const hidden: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: setup.reactor.id, stealthTotal: 18, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n    const dmBoard = projectEncounterBoard(projectDmView(hidden));\n    const dmCell = encounterBoardRenderModel(dmBoard, {\n      ...REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART,\n      room: { ...REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.room, columns: 6, rows: 3 },\n      combatantTokens: {\n        ...REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.combatantTokens,\n        [setup.mover.id]: REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.combatantTokens['combatant:fighter']!,\n        [setup.reactor.id]: REFERENCE_ENCOUNTER_ART.combatantTokens['combatant:training-brute']!,\n      },\n    }).find((cell) => cell.key === '0,1');\n    expect(dmCell?.layers).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ role: 'fog' }));\n    expect(dmCell?.token).toBeNull();\n    expect(dmBoard.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).not.toContain(setup.reactor.id);\n\n    const playerView = projectPlayerView(hidden, {\n      seatId: 'seat:detection-ui',\n      combatantId: setup.mover.id,\n      ownedCombatantIds: [setup.mover.id],\n    });\n    const playerBoard = projectPlayerBoard(playerView, IDLE);\n    expect(playerBoard.concealedCells).toContainEqual({ column: 0, row: 1 });\n    expect(playerBoard.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).not.toContain(setup.reactor.id);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/watabou-adapter.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2068","name":"Watabou One Page Dungeon adapter maps documented rectangles, doors, notes, and provenance into reducer state"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { reduceEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { mulberry32 } from '../../../src/combat/random';\nimport {\n  adaptWatabouDungeon,\n  decodeWatabouDungeon,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/watabou-adapter';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\n\nconst FIXTURE = 'tests/fixtures/watabou/one-page-dungeon-sample.json' as const;\nconst inputs = declareTestInputs({ fixtures: [FIXTURE] });\n\ndescribe('Watabou One Page Dungeon adapter', () => {\n  it('maps documented rectangles, doors, notes, and provenance into reducer state', () => {\n    const source: unknown = JSON.parse(inputs.fixtures.readText(FIXTURE));\n    const decoded = decodeWatabouDungeon(source);\n    const encounter = adaptWatabouDungeon(source, { seed: 1_143_801_683 });\n\n    expect(decoded.rects).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(encounter.provenance).toEqual({\n      source: 'watabou',\n      licenseTag: 'LicenseRef-Watabou-Output-Free-Use',\n      seed: 1_143_801_683,\n    });\n    expect(encounter.state.bounds).toEqual({ columns: 14, rows: 12 });\n    expect(encounter.state.worldObjects).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([\n      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'door', position: { column: 7, row: 4 } }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'door', position: { column: 0, row: 2 } }),\n    ]));\n    expect(encounter.state.dmNotes).toContain('1: A brazier marks the old crossing.');\n\n    const started = reduceEncounter(encounter.state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, mulberry32(7));\n    expect(started.state.revision).toBe(1);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/actor-knowledge.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2069","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 projects a visible target as perceived with its current position"},{"id":"2070","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 projects PC actor knowledge as hand-computed bands without numeric AC or HP"},{"id":"2071","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 projects only visibly manifest conditions as positive markers"},{"id":"2072","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 observes a public reaction spend but never infers availability from no spend"},{"id":"2073","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 redacts a hidden target rather than exposing its position"},{"id":"2074","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 redacts a target in fog even when ordinary detection could see its cell"},{"id":"2075","name":"actor-knowledge-v2 records missing last-seen memory as a typed unresolved basis"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport type { CombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { effectStackingIdentity, encounterEffectId } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  ACTOR_KNOWLEDGE_POLICY,\n  projectActorKnowledge,\n  type ActorTargetKnowledge,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/intel/actor-knowledge';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ndeclareTestInputs({});\n\nfunction encounter(overrides: Partial<Pick<\n  Parameters<typeof createEncounter>[0],\n  'blockedCells' | 'foggedCells'\n>> = {}): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly actor: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>;\n  readonly target: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>;\n} {\n  const actor = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-monster');\n  const target = playerProfile('actor-knowledge-player');\n  return {\n    actor,\n    target,\n    state: createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [actor, target],\n      tokens: [placedToken(actor, 0), placedToken(target, 2)],\n      ...overrides,\n    }),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction onlyTarget(state: EncounterState, actor: CombatantProfile): ActorTargetKnowledge {\n  const projection = projectActorKnowledge(state, actor.id);\n  expect(projection.policy).toBe(ACTOR_KNOWLEDGE_POLICY);\n  expect(projection.targets).toHaveLength(1);\n  const target = projection.targets[0];\n  if (target === undefined) throw new Error('Expected exactly one projected target.');\n  return target;\n}\n\ndescribe('actor-knowledge-v2', () => {\n  it('projects a visible target as perceived with its current position', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(setup.state, setup.actor)).toEqual({\n      kind: 'perceived',\n      targetId: setup.target.id,\n      position: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n      conditions: [],\n      armorClass: { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'guarded' },\n      hitPoints: { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'uninjured' },\n      reciprocalVisibility: { kind: 'perceived', targetCanSeeActor: true },\n      reaction: { kind: 'unknown' },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('projects PC actor knowledge as hand-computed bands without numeric AC or HP', () => {\n    const actor = playerProfile('actor-knowledge-pc');\n    const uninjured = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-uninjured', { hitPoints: 12 });\n    const bloodied = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-bloodied', { hitPoints: 12 });\n    const nearDeath = monsterProfile('actor-knowledge-near-death', { hitPoints: 12 });\n    const created = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [actor, uninjured, bloodied, nearDeath],\n      tokens: [\n        placedToken(actor, 0),\n        placedToken(uninjured, 1),\n        placedToken(bloodied, 2),\n        placedToken(nearDeath, 3),\n      ],\n    });\n    const state: EncounterState = {\n      ...created,\n      combatants: created.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === bloodied.id\n          ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 7 }\n          : combatant.profile.id === nearDeath.id\n            ? { ...combatant, hitPoints: 3 }\n            : combatant),\n    };\n\n    const projection = projectActorKnowledge(state, actor.id);\n    expect(projection.policy).toBe('actor-knowledge-v2');\n    expect(projection.targets.map((target) => target.kind === 'perceived'\n      ? [target.targetId, target.armorClass, target.hitPoints]\n      : [target.targetId, target.kind])).toEqual([\n      [bloodied.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'bloodied' }],\n      [nearDeath.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'near_death' }],\n      [uninjured.id, { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'lightly_defended' },\n        { kind: 'perceived_band', band: 'uninjured' }],\n    ]);\n    for (const target of projection.targets) {\n      if (target.kind !== 'perceived') throw new Error('Expected a perceived target.');\n      expect('value' in target.armorClass).toBe(false);\n      expect('value' in target.hitPoints).toBe(false);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('projects only visibly manifest conditions as positive markers', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const state: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      effects: [{\n        id: encounterEffectId('effect:actor-knowledge-prone'),\n        source: setup.actor.id,\n        targets: [setup.target.id],\n        createdRevision: 0,\n        duration: { kind: 'permanent' },\n        concentrationOwner: null,\n        stackingIdentity: effectStackingIdentity('actor-knowledge-prone'),\n        stacking: 'replace_same_source',\n        repeatedSave: null,\n        payload: { kind: 'condition', condition: 'Prone' },\n      }],\n    };\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(state, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'perceived',\n      conditions: [{ kind: 'perceived', condition: 'Prone' }],\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('observes a public reaction spend but never infers availability from no spend', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const unobserved: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      combatants: setup.state.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n        combatant.profile.id === setup.target.id\n          ? { ...combatant, turn: { ...combatant.turn, reactionAvailable: false } }\n          : combatant),\n    };\n    expect(onlyTarget(unobserved, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'perceived', reaction: { kind: 'unknown' },\n    });\n\n    const observed: EncounterState = {\n      ...unobserved,\n      eventLog: [\n        { sequence: 1, type: 'turn_started', combatant: setup.target.id, round: 1 },\n        {\n          sequence: 2,\n          type: 'resource_spent',\n          combatant: setup.target.id,\n          resource: 'reaction',\n          purpose: 'Opportunity Attack',\n        },\n      ],\n    };\n    expect(onlyTarget(observed, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'perceived', reaction: { kind: 'observed_spent' },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('redacts a hidden target rather than exposing its position', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const hidden: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: setup.target.id, stealthTotal: 18, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n\n    const target = onlyTarget(hidden, setup.actor);\n    expect(target).toMatchObject({ kind: 'unknown', targetId: setup.target.id });\n    expect('position' in target).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('redacts a target in fog even when ordinary detection could see its cell', () => {\n    const setup = encounter({ foggedCells: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }] });\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(setup.state, setup.actor)).toMatchObject({\n      kind: 'unknown',\n      targetId: setup.target.id,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('records missing last-seen memory as a typed unresolved basis', () => {\n    const setup = encounter();\n    const hidden: EncounterState = {\n      ...setup.state,\n      hiddenCombatants: [{ combatant: setup.target.id, stealthTotal: 18, edition: '2024' }],\n    };\n\n    expect(onlyTarget(hidden, setup.actor)).toEqual({\n      kind: 'unknown',\n      targetId: setup.target.id,\n      lastSeen: {\n        status: 'unresolved',\n        reason: 'last_seen_position_not_modeled',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/projected-movement-options.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2076","name":"projected movement options matches the full movement decision when every movement-sensitive fact is observed"},{"id":"2077","name":"projected movement options makes opportunity risk unresolved when no reaction spend was observed"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { monsterCombatantProfile } from '../../../src/combat/combatant';\nimport { createEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { MovementEvaluation } from '../../../src/combat/movement-evaluator';\nimport { GOBLIN_WARRIOR } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/monsters';\nimport { feet } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport {\n  canonicalEngineQueryPort,\n  projectedMovementOptions,\n  type EngineProjectedMovementRequest,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/engine-query-port';\nimport { projectActorKnowledge } from '../../../src/vtt/intel/actor-knowledge';\nimport { declareTestInputs } from '../../helpers/test-inputs';\nimport { placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\ndeclareTestInputs({});\n\nfunction encounter(reaction: 'observed_spent' | 'unknown'): {\n  readonly state: EncounterState;\n  readonly actorId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'];\n  readonly targetId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'];\n} {\n  const actor = monsterCombatantProfile(GOBLIN_WARRIOR, {\n    combatantId: 'combatant:projected-goblin',\n    tokenId: 'token:projected-goblin',\n  });\n  const target = playerProfile('projected-fighter');\n  const created = createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n    combatants: [actor, target],\n    tokens: [placedToken(target, 0), placedToken(actor, 1)],\n  });\n  const state: EncounterState = {\n    ...created,\n    combatants: created.combatants.map((combatant) =>\n      combatant.profile.id === actor.id\n        ? {\n            ...combatant,\n            turn: {\n              ...combatant.turn,\n              action: { kind: 'available' },\n              bonusActionAvailable: true,\n              reactionAvailable: true,\n              movement: { speed: feet(30), spent: feet(0), remaining: feet(30) },\n            },\n          }\n        : combatant.profile.id === target.id\n          ? {\n              ...combatant,\n              turn: {\n                ...combatant.turn,\n                reactionAvailable: reaction === 'unknown',\n              },\n            }\n          : combatant),\n    eventLog: reaction === 'observed_spent'\n      ? [\n          { sequence: 1, type: 'turn_started', combatant: target.id, round: 1 },\n          {\n            sequence: 2,\n            type: 'resource_spent',\n            combatant: target.id,\n            resource: 'reaction',\n            purpose: 'Opportunity Attack',\n          },\n        ]\n      : [],\n  };\n  return { state, actorId: actor.id, targetId: target.id };\n}\n\nfunction request(\n  actorId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'],\n  targetId: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>['id'],\n): EngineProjectedMovementRequest {\n  return {\n    actorId,\n    targetId,\n    attack: {\n      range: { kind: 'melee', reachFeet: feet(5) },\n      attackBonus: 4,\n      criticalFloor: 20,\n      damageTerms: [{ dice: { count: 1, sides: 6, modifier: 2 } }],\n      attackerConditions: [],\n      rollModeSources: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction movementDecision(evaluation: MovementEvaluation) {\n  return {\n    start: evaluation.start,\n    earliestAttackTurn: evaluation.earliestAttackTurn,\n    candidates: evaluation.candidates.map((candidate) => ({\n      destination: candidate.destination,\n      path: candidate.path,\n      semantic: candidate.semantic,\n      beforeRange: candidate.before.status === 'resolved'\n        ? candidate.before.evaluation.range\n        : candidate.before,\n      afterRange: candidate.after.status === 'resolved'\n        ? candidate.after.evaluation.range\n        : candidate.after,\n    })),\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('projected movement options', () => {\n  it('matches the full movement decision when every movement-sensitive fact is observed', () => {\n    const setup = encounter('observed_spent');\n    const projection = projectActorKnowledge(setup.state, setup.actorId);\n    const projected = projectedMovementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      projection,\n      request(setup.actorId, setup.targetId),\n    );\n    const full = canonicalEngineQueryPort.movementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      setup.actorId,\n      setup.targetId,\n      'scimitar',\n    );\n    if (projected === null || full === null) throw new Error('Expected both movement evaluations.');\n\n    expect(movementDecision(projected)).toEqual(movementDecision(full));\n    expect(projected.candidates.every((candidate) => candidate.path.status !== 'found' ||\n      candidate.path.opportunityAttackRisk.status === 'resolved')).toBe(true);\n    const first = projected.candidates[0];\n    if (first?.before.status !== 'resolved') throw new Error('Projected tactical input is absent.');\n    expect(first.before.evaluation.probabilities).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_armor_class_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(first.before.evaluation.consequences).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'target_hit_points_unresolved',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('makes opportunity risk unresolved when no reaction spend was observed', () => {\n    const setup = encounter('unknown');\n    const projection = projectActorKnowledge(setup.state, setup.actorId);\n    const projected = projectedMovementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      projection,\n      request(setup.actorId, setup.targetId),\n    );\n    const full = canonicalEngineQueryPort.movementOptions(\n      setup.state,\n      setup.actorId,\n      setup.targetId,\n      'scimitar',\n    );\n    if (projected === null || full === null) throw new Error('Expected both movement evaluations.');\n    const retreat = projected.candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.destination.column === 2);\n    const fullRetreat = full.candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.destination.column === 2);\n    if (retreat?.path.status !== 'found' || fullRetreat?.path.status !== 'found') {\n      throw new Error('Expected the one-square retreat candidate.');\n    }\n\n    expect(retreat.path.opportunityAttackRisk).toEqual({\n      status: 'unresolved', reason: 'opportunity_attack_eligibility_unresolved',\n    });\n    expect(fullRetreat.path.opportunityAttackRisk).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'resolved', atRisk: true,\n    });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/alerting.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2078","name":"D420 NPC help-calling normalizes a pre-D420 state with every roster combatant participating"},{"id":"2079","name":"D420 NPC help-calling treats an unlisted existing combatant as participating and emits no unconfigured help call"},{"id":"2080","name":"D420 NPC help-calling joins exactly nearby NPCs within yelling distance and excludes one cell farther"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { defaultEncounterAlertingState, yellingDistance } from '../../../src/combat/alerting';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport { damageType, dieSides, feet } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst fixedD20 = (face: number) => () => (face - 0.5) / 20;\n\nfunction requiredAlerting(state: EncounterState) {\n  if (state.alerting === undefined) throw new Error('Expected persisted D420 alerting state.');\n  return state.alerting;\n}\n\nfunction attack(\n  actor: ReturnType<typeof playerProfile>,\n  target: ReturnType<typeof monsterProfile>,\n): Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> {\n  return {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: actor.id,\n    target: target.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{\n        type: damageType('Force'),\n        dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 0 },\n      }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('D420 NPC help-calling', () => {\n  it('normalizes a pre-D420 state with every roster combatant participating', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('legacy-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('legacy-monster', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const created = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 0), placedToken(monster, 2)],\n    });\n    const preD420Record = structuredClone(created) as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;\n    delete preD420Record['alerting'];\n    delete preD420Record['searchMemories'];\n    const serialized = JSON.stringify(created);\n    expect(serialized).toBe(JSON.stringify(preD420Record));\n    const legacyRecord = JSON.parse(serialized) as unknown;\n\n    const result = reduceEncounter(\n      legacyRecord as EncounterState,\n      { type: 'roll_initiative' },\n      fixedD20(10),\n    );\n\n    expect(result.state.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([pc.id, monster.id]);\n    expect(result.state.searchMemories).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(result.state.alerting).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('treats an unlisted existing combatant as participating and emits no unconfigured help call', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('unlisted-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const monster = monsterProfile('unlisted-monster', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const created = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 4, rows: 1 },\n      combatants: [pc, monster],\n      tokens: [placedToken(pc, 0), placedToken(monster, 2)],\n    });\n    const defaultAlerting = defaultEncounterAlertingState([pc.id, monster.id]);\n    const incompleteMembership: EncounterState = {\n      ...created,\n      alerting: {\n        ...defaultAlerting,\n        membership: defaultAlerting.membership.filter((entry) => entry.combatant === pc.id),\n      },\n    };\n    const started = reduceEncounter(\n      incompleteMembership,\n      { type: 'roll_initiative' },\n      fixedD20(10),\n    ).state;\n    const attacked = reduceEncounter(started, attack(pc, monster), fixedD20(10));\n\n    expect(started.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([pc.id, monster.id]);\n    expect(attacked.events.some((event) => event.type === 'npc_called_for_help')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('joins exactly nearby NPCs within yelling distance and excludes one cell farther', () => {\n    const pc = playerProfile('help-attacker', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n    const caller = monsterProfile('help-caller', { initiativeBonus: -20 });\n    const inside = monsterProfile('help-inside');\n    const outside = monsterProfile('help-outside');\n    let state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 7, rows: 1 },\n      alerting: {\n        nearbyNpcIds: [inside.id, outside.id],\n        yellingDistance: yellingDistance(feet(10)),\n      },\n      combatants: [pc, caller, inside, outside],\n      tokens: [\n        placedToken(pc, 0),\n        placedToken(caller, 2),\n        placedToken(inside, 4),\n        placedToken(outside, 5),\n      ],\n    });\n    state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(10)).state;\n    const result = reduceEncounter(state, attack(pc, caller), fixedD20(10));\n\n    expect(result.events).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({\n      type: 'npc_called_for_help',\n      caller: caller.id,\n      attacker: pc.id,\n      origin: { column: 2, row: 0 },\n      yellingDistance: { kind: 'yelling_distance', radius: 10 },\n      soundPropagation: { kind: 'radial', occlusion: 'not_modeled' },\n    }));\n    expect(result.events.filter((event) => event.type === 'combatant_joined_encounter')).toEqual([\n      expect.objectContaining({\n        combatant: inside.id,\n        calledBy: caller.id,\n        distance: 10,\n        initiative: { kind: 'callers_slot', slot: 1 },\n      }),\n    ]);\n    expect(requiredAlerting(result.state).membership).toEqual([\n      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'participant', combatant: pc.id }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'participant', combatant: caller.id }),\n      expect.objectContaining({ kind: 'participant', combatant: inside.id }),\n      { kind: 'nearby_npc', combatant: outside.id },\n    ]);\n    expect(result.state.initiative.map((entry) => entry.combatant)).toEqual([\n      pc.id,\n      caller.id,\n      inside.id,\n    ]);\n    const serialized = JSON.stringify(result.state);\n    const roundTripped = JSON.parse(serialized) as unknown as EncounterState;\n    expect(JSON.stringify(roundTripped)).toBe(serialized);\n    expect(requiredAlerting(roundTripped)).toEqual(requiredAlerting(result.state));\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/bridge/narration.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2081","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts NARRATION-SCHEMA-'cinematic_visible_rolls' decodes its distinct bounded schema"},{"id":"2082","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts NARRATION-SCHEMA-'terse_tactical' decodes its distinct bounded schema"},{"id":"2083","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts NARRATION-SCHEMA-'rules_explicit' decodes its distinct bounded schema"},{"id":"2084","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts NARRATION-SCHEMA-'terse_rule_citing_validation' decodes its distinct bounded schema"},{"id":"2085","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts M48-VALIDATION-LOCATOR-REQUIRED rejects a rule id without its SRD locator"},{"id":"2086","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts VALIDATION-KB-PAIR-REAL rejects a real rule id paired to the wrong real locator"},{"id":"2087","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts M47-NARRATION-CANNOT-CHANGE-DAMAGE rejects state mutation fields in narration"},{"id":"2088","name":"DM narration and adjudication contracts ADJUDICATION-ISOLATION returns only a proposal until converted to a reducer command"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { dmVisibleEncounter, projectDmView } from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport {\n  adjudicationCommand,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/contracts';\nimport {\n  decodeAdjudicationProposal,\n  decodeNarration,\n} from '../../../src/vtt/dm-bridge/narration';\nimport { SPELL_KB_ENTRIES } from '../../../src/combat/spells/kb/entries';\nimport { STARTER_MONSTER_KB } from '../../../src/combat/statblocks/kb/entries';\nimport { referenceEncounterSetup, REFERENCE_MONSTER_ID } from '../../../src/vtt/reference-encounter';\n\nconst SPELL_KB_ENTRY = SPELL_KB_ENTRIES[0];\nconst SPELL_CITATION = {\n  ruleId: SPELL_KB_ENTRY.ruleId,\n  srdLocator: SPELL_KB_ENTRY.srdLocator,\n  sentence: SPELL_KB_ENTRY.rulingGuidance,\n} as const;\n\nconst MONSTER_KB_ENTRY = STARTER_MONSTER_KB[0];\nconst MONSTER_CITATION = {\n  ruleId: MONSTER_KB_ENTRY.ruleId,\n  srdLocator: MONSTER_KB_ENTRY.srdLocator,\n  sentence: MONSTER_KB_ENTRY.rulingGuidance,\n} as const;\n\ndescribe('DM narration and adjudication contracts', () => {\n  it.each([\n    {\n      voice: 'cinematic_visible_rolls',\n      value: {\n        kind: 'narration',\n        voice: 'cinematic_visible_rolls',\n        sentence: 'The blade flashes as the visible die settles.',\n        visibleRolls: [{ label: 'Longsword attack', faces: [17], total: 22 }],\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      voice: 'terse_tactical',\n      value: { kind: 'narration', voice: 'terse_tactical', sentence: 'The ogre closes and attacks.' },\n    },\n    {\n      voice: 'rules_explicit',\n      value: {\n        kind: 'narration',\n        voice: 'rules_explicit',\n        sentence: 'The checked spell template includes the touched square.',\n        rules: [SPELL_CITATION],\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      voice: 'terse_rule_citing_validation',\n      value: { kind: 'narration', voice: 'terse_rule_citing_validation', lines: [MONSTER_CITATION] },\n    },\n  ])('NARRATION-SCHEMA-$voice decodes its distinct bounded schema', ({ value, voice }) => {\n    expect(decodeNarration(value).voice).toBe(voice);\n  });\n\n  it('M48-VALIDATION-LOCATOR-REQUIRED rejects a rule id without its SRD locator', () => {\n    expect(() => decodeNarration({\n      kind: 'narration',\n      voice: 'terse_rule_citing_validation',\n      lines: [{ ruleId: 'R-MONSTER-004', sentence: 'The Ogre uses its checked attack.' }],\n    })).toThrow('srdLocator');\n  });\n\n  it('VALIDATION-KB-PAIR-REAL rejects a real rule id paired to the wrong real locator', () => {\n    expect(() => decodeNarration({\n      kind: 'narration',\n      voice: 'terse_rule_citing_validation',\n      lines: [{ ...MONSTER_CITATION, srdLocator: SPELL_CITATION.srdLocator }],\n    })).toThrow('real spell/statblock KB rule and locator');\n  });\n\n  it('M47-NARRATION-CANNOT-CHANGE-DAMAGE rejects state mutation fields in narration', () => {\n    expect(() => decodeNarration({\n      kind: 'narration',\n      voice: 'terse_tactical',\n      sentence: 'The ogre hits.',\n      damage: { target: REFERENCE_MONSTER_ID, amount: 9 },\n    })).toThrow('unexpected field damage');\n  });\n\n  it('ADJUDICATION-ISOLATION returns only a proposal until converted to a reducer command', () => {\n    const state = createEncounter(referenceEncounterSetup());\n    const projection = dmVisibleEncounter(projectDmView(state));\n    const proposal = decodeAdjudicationProposal({\n      kind: 'adjudication_proposal',\n      target: REFERENCE_MONSTER_ID,\n      subject: 'engine:hit-points',\n      reasoning: 'A genuinely unmodeled mechanism requires an explicit override.',\n      consequence: { kind: 'hit_point_delta', amount: -3 },\n    });\n\n    expect(proposal).toEqual({\n      kind: 'adjudication_proposal',\n      target: REFERENCE_MONSTER_ID,\n      subject: 'engine:hit-points',\n      reasoning: 'A genuinely unmodeled mechanism requires an explicit override.',\n      consequence: { kind: 'hit_point_delta', amount: -3 },\n    });\n    expect(adjudicationCommand(proposal, projection)).toEqual({\n      type: 'adjudicate',\n      target: REFERENCE_MONSTER_ID,\n      subject: 'engine:hit-points',\n      reasoning: proposal.reasoning,\n      consequence: proposal.consequence,\n    });\n    expect(state.revision).toBe(0);\n    expect(state.eventLog).toEqual([]);\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/combat/visibility.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2089","name":"D359 encounter views omits a fogged edge cell and its contents while retaining the adjacent visible boundary cell"},{"id":"2090","name":"D359 encounter views omits hidden death-save results, fog facts, and DM-only fields from player objects while exposing a redacted result"},{"id":"2091","name":"D359 encounter views gates owned details per seat and produces distinguishing views over the same state"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport type { EncounterCommand } from '../../../src/combat/events';\nimport {\n  dmVisibleEncounter,\n  projectDmView,\n  projectPlayerView,\n} from '../../../src/combat/visibility';\nimport { damageType, dieSides } from '../../../src/combat/values';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from './fixtures';\n\nconst fixedD20 = (face: number) => () => (face - 0.5) / 20;\n\nfunction hiddenDeathSaveState(): EncounterState {\n  const pc = playerProfile('viewer', { initiativeBonus: -20, hitPoints: 10 });\n  const monster = monsterProfile('fogged', { initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  let state = createEncounter({\n    hideDeathSaveRolls: true,\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 2 },\n    blockedCells: [{ column: 4, row: 0 }],\n    foggedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 0 }, { column: 4, row: 0 }],\n    dmNotes: ['The east square contains a hidden mechanism.'],\n    combatants: [pc, monster],\n    tokens: [placedToken(pc, 0), placedToken(monster, 3)],\n  });\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'roll_initiative' }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n  const attack: Extract<EncounterCommand, { readonly type: 'attack' }> = {\n    type: 'attack',\n    actor: monster.id,\n    target: pc.id,\n    attackBonus: 100,\n    criticalFloor: 20,\n    rollMode: 'normal',\n    attackerCanSeeTarget: true,\n    targetCanSeeAttacker: true,\n    damage: {\n      terms: [{\n        type: damageType('Force'),\n        dice: { count: 0, sides: dieSides(6), modifier: 10 },\n      }],\n      critical: false,\n      responses: [],\n    },\n  };\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, attack, fixedD20(11)).state;\n  state = reduceEncounter(state, { type: 'end_turn', actor: monster.id }, fixedD20(11)).state;\n  const decision = state.pendingDecisions.find((candidate) => candidate.kind === 'death_save');\n  if (decision === undefined) throw new Error('Visibility fixture has no death-save decision.');\n  return reduceEncounter(state, {\n    type: 'resolve_pending_decision', decisionId: decision.id, optionId: 'roll',\n  }, fixedD20(9)).state;\n}\n\ndescribe('D359 encounter views', () => {\n  it('omits a fogged edge cell and its contents while retaining the adjacent visible boundary cell', () => {\n    const state = hiddenDeathSaveState();\n    const pc = state.combatants.find((subject) => subject.profile.kind === 'player_character');\n    if (pc === undefined) throw new Error('Visibility fixture has no player seat.');\n\n    const fogged = projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: pc.profile.id,\n    });\n    const revealed = projectPlayerView({\n      ...state,\n      foggedCells: [{ column: 4, row: 0 }],\n    }, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: pc.profile.id,\n    });\n\n    expect(fogged.cells).toContainEqual({ column: 2, row: 0 });\n    expect(fogged.cells).not.toContainEqual({ column: 3, row: 0 });\n    expect(fogged.combatants.map((entry) => entry.name)).not.toContain('fogged');\n    expect(revealed.cells).toContainEqual({ column: 3, row: 0 });\n    expect(revealed.combatants.map((entry) => entry.name)).toContain('fogged');\n  });\n\n  it('omits hidden death-save results, fog facts, and DM-only fields from player objects while exposing a redacted result', () => {\n    const state = hiddenDeathSaveState();\n    const pc = state.combatants.find((subject) => subject.profile.kind === 'player_character');\n    if (pc === undefined) throw new Error('Visibility fixture has no player seat.');\n    const player = projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: pc.profile.id,\n    });\n    const dm = dmVisibleEncounter(projectDmView(state));\n    const serializedPlayer = JSON.stringify(player);\n\n    expect(serializedPlayer).not.toContain('hidden mechanism');\n    expect(serializedPlayer).not.toContain('foggedCells');\n    expect(player.recentEvents.find((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved')).toMatchObject({\n      rollVisibility: 'dm_only',\n      failures: 1,\n      lifeState: 'dying',\n    });\n    expect(serializedPlayer).not.toContain('\"roll\":9');\n    expect(dm.dmOnly.notes).toContain('The east square contains a hidden mechanism.');\n    expect(dm.recentEvents.find((event) => event.type === 'death_save_resolved')).toMatchObject({\n      roll: 9,\n      failures: 1,\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('gates owned details per seat and produces distinguishing views over the same state', () => {\n    const west = playerProfile('west-seat');\n    const east = playerProfile('east-seat');\n    const state = createEncounter({\n      bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 1 },\n      foggedCells: [{ column: 4, row: 0 }],\n      combatants: [west, east],\n      tokens: [placedToken(west, 0), placedToken(east, 4)],\n    });\n\n    const westView = projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:west',\n      combatantId: west.id,\n    });\n    const eastView = projectPlayerView(state, {\n      seatId: 'seat:east',\n      combatantId: east.id,\n    });\n\n    expect(westView.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([west.id]);\n    expect(eastView.combatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([west.id, east.id]);\n    expect(westView.ownedCombatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([west.id]);\n    expect(eastView.ownedCombatants.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([east.id]);\n    expect(westView.seat).toMatchObject({ seatId: 'seat:west', combatantId: west.id });\n    expect(eastView.seat).toMatchObject({ seatId: 'seat:east', combatantId: east.id });\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/reaction-guidance.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2092","name":"D401 reaction guidance leaves the DM-attended tray path unchanged even when sticky guidance says take"}],"source":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { createEncounter, reduceEncounter, type EncounterState } from '../../../src/combat/encounter';\nimport { guidedPendingReactionResolution } from '../../../src/vtt/reaction-guidance';\nimport { monsterProfile, placedToken, playerProfile } from '../combat/fixtures';\n\nfunction pendingReaction(): EncounterState {\n  const mover = playerProfile('guidance-mover', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: 20 });\n  const reactor = monsterProfile('guidance-reactor', { hitPoints: 100, initiativeBonus: -20 });\n  const started = reduceEncounter(createEncounter({\n    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 2 }, combatants: [mover, reactor],\n    tokens: [placedToken(mover, 1), placedToken(reactor, 0)],\n  }), { type: 'roll_initiative' }, () => 0.5).state;\n  return reduceEncounter(started, {\n    type: 'move', actor: mover.id, path: [{ column: 2, row: 0 }], cause: 'voluntary',\n  }, () => 0.5).state;\n}\n\ndescribe('D401 reaction guidance', () => {\n  it('leaves the DM-attended tray path unchanged even when sticky guidance says take', () => {\n    const state = pendingReaction();\n    const decision = state.pendingDecisions.find((entry) => entry.kind === 'reaction_offer');\n    if (decision?.kind !== 'reaction_offer') throw new Error('Expected a pending Reaction offer.');\n\n    expect(guidedPendingReactionResolution(\n      state, decision, 'agent', { kind: 'dm_attended' },\n      { sideWide: { opportunity_attack: 'take' }, actors: [] },\n    )).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n"},"tests/unit/vtt/closed-predicates.test.ts":{"tests":[{"id":"2093","name":"closed VTT predicates classifies agent command type \"attack\""},{"id":"2094","name":"closed VTT predicates This violates the offers boundary (an offered option must execute) and is VIS-FIELD's to fix before landing. (c) DEFECT 2 — src/vtt/room-generator.ts:1223 hasOpenOpposingRay() calls a ray open when tier === 'none' without requiring blocksSight === false, so the generator's M576-E2 wall placement no longer certifies a sight lane. (a) LEGITIMATE CONSEQUENCE — 25 monsters across the ten frozen brutal-b rooms and 18 across seven of the ten frozen brutal-2 rooms (the D569 second family: 6207002, 004-009) lose every productive first-turn option because their only lanes were two-blocker seams (per-seed flanking cells listed; mechanism count 25 seam / 0 derived-fog / 0 other; the B2 consolidation shown non-causal); the D569 second-family validator re-checks productivity against the current engine, so the frozen 480-cell second family is now an invalid manifest. (b) derived-fog/detection consequences: none. All three suites pass under main's tracer (in-memory replay). VERIFIED BY ME by reading: engine-query-port.ts:1163 tests only `tier === 'total'`; encounter.ts:7183 tests `attackLine.blocksSight || attackLine.tier === 'total'` — the disagreement is real. RULING: (1) a VIS-FIELD LANDING RECONCILIATION batch (LAND-01) fixes the two production defects and the helper now: the query port refuses to offer an attack/save whose trace blocksSight (agreement witness: for a seam-blocked pair the query offers nothing the reducer would refuse — a hand-authored fixture plus a property over the frozen families that every offered attack executes); the generator requires tier 'none' AND blocksSight false for an open opposing ray (witness + mutant); dryRunMonsterPlan materializes a legal activation choice or skips choice-requiring options; nothing else. (2) The frozen brutal-b and brutal-2 families and the D569 second-family manifest are the OWNER's decision, asked now (regenerate under the seam-aware generator, invalidating the second-family experiment identity: 240 cell state hashes and a new manifest version; or amend the productivity contract — sol and I advise against; or revisit D635). Landing waits for both.

/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-multiclass-spells-static/.claude/consensus/vis-field/impl-wall-01-fix-r2-sol.md-502-
/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-multiclass-spells-static/.claude/consensus/vis-field/impl-wall-01-fix-r2-sol.md:503:The quiet-window scripts used two different mechanisms at once: an exit-file dependency AND a `pgrep -f "[v]erify-.*\.sh"` busy check. verify-offers-s3b.sh was queued behind gate-heldout.exit and, while merely sleeping in that wait loop, matched the busy pattern used by gate-quietstone-quiet.sh — which the heldout gate waits on. Circular: quietstone ← offers-waiter ← heldout ← quietstone. Load sat at ~0.9 with nothing running from 12:05 to 16:58 and no gate fired; the three gate monitors reported "waiting" correctly and the supervisor read that as a busy machine rather than checking the condition. Fix: killed the five waiters by PID and relaunched them as a strict linear chain with no pgrep condition — quietstone → heldout → d569b → offers 3B verify → handoff battery, each waiting only on its predecessor's exit file, with the real exit code recorded instead of a hardcoded 0. Quietstone gate started 16:58:39 at load 1.05. Rule: a queue may use exit-file ordering or a process-presence check, never both; a sleeping queued waiter is not a busy machine.

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,

+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({

+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

function sharedVertexBlockingCell(
  column: number,
  row: number,
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
): GridCell | null {
  const topLeft = { column: column - 1, row: row - 1 };
  const topRight = { column, row: row - 1 };
  // Check TL/BR first so lower row then lower column wins when both pairs seal.
  if (sightBlockingAt(topLeft) && sightBlockingAt({ column, row })) return topLeft;
  if (sightBlockingAt(topRight) && sightBlockingAt({ column: column - 1, row })) return topRight;
  return null;
}

function firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
): SightBlockingHit | null {
  if (![from.column, from.row, to.column, to.row].every(Number.isInteger)) return null;
  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
  const latticeSteps = greatestCommonDivisor(columnDelta, rowDelta);
  if (latticeSteps <= 1) return null;
  const columnStep = columnDelta / latticeSteps;
  const rowStep = rowDelta / latticeSteps;
  // Indices exclude t=0 and t=1: endpoint vertices are governed only by cell-interior crossing.
  for (let index = 1; index < latticeSteps; index += 1) {
    const column = from.column + columnStep * index;
    const row = from.row + rowStep * index;
    const cell = sharedVertexBlockingCell(column, row, sightBlockingAt);
    if (cell !== null) return { cell, progress: index / latticeSteps };
  }
  return null;
}

function entersOppositeQuadrant(
  columnDelta: number,
  rowDelta: number,
  ownCellQuadrant: CornerQuadrant,
): boolean {
  if (columnDelta === 0 || rowDelta === 0) return false;
  return Math.sign(columnDelta) === -ownCellQuadrant.column &&
    Math.sign(rowDelta) === -ownCellQuadrant.row;
}
