+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

}

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

export function coverTierBetweenObjects(
  objects: readonly WorldObject[],
  from: GridCell,
  to: GridCell,
): CoverTier {
  const exclusions = new Set([cellKey(from), cellKey(to)]);
  const candidates = [...new Map(objects
    .flatMap((object) => object.footprint)
    .filter((cell) => !exclusions.has(cellKey(cell)))
    .map((cell) => [cellKey(cell), cell] as const)).values()];
  const sourceCell = { ...from };
  const targetCell = { ...to };
  const sourceEndpoints = outerCornerEndpoints([from]);
  const targetEndpoints = outerCornerEndpoints([to]);
  const sourcesAt = (cell: GridCell): readonly TerrainLineSource[] =>
    objects.flatMap((object): readonly TerrainLineSource[] =>
      objectOccupiesCell(object, cell) && object.blocking.cover !== 'none'
        ? [{ kind: 'world_object', id: String(object.id), tier: object.blocking.cover }]
        : []);
  const sightBlockingAt = (cell: GridCell): boolean =>
    !exclusions.has(cellKey(cell)) && sourcesAt(cell).some((source) => source.tier === 'total');
  const traces = sourceEndpoints.map((sourceEndpoint) => aggregateCornerLines(
    sourceEndpoint.point,
    targetEndpoints.map((targetEndpoint) => traceCornerLine(
      sourceEndpoint.point,
      targetEndpoint.point,
      sourceEndpoint.cellQuadrant,
      targetEndpoint.cellQuadrant,
      candidates,
      sourcesAt,
      sightBlockingAt,
    )),
    sourceCell,
    targetCell,
  ));
  const first = traces[0];
  if (first === undefined) throw new RangeError('A line query requires non-empty source and target spaces.');
  return traces.reduce((best, candidate) =>
    comparePhysicalCornerTraces(candidate, best) < 0 ? candidate : best, first).tier;
}

}

  sourceId: CombatantId,
  targetId: CombatantId,
  options: CreatureCoverOptions = {},

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e8b0cdcc04614b7c7972002479e2e106a20acb17
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}
diff --git a//tmp/wall01-r4-generation.ts b//tmp/wall01-r4-generation.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cf9918a28b3a2e76450b0b0ff2d8e9f0d19aa03a
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-generation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

codex
One performance detail surfaced in the LOS matrix: endpoint checks were probing four neighboring cells even for same-side and edge-aligned rays that can never qualify. I’m tightening that without changing semantics—direction is now rejected before any blocker lookup—then I’ll re-time the two fixed 5-second budget tests.

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e8b0cdcc04614b7c7972002479e2e106a20acb17
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}
diff --git a//tmp/wall01-r4-generation.ts b//tmp/wall01-r4-generation.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cf9918a28b3a2e76450b0b0ff2d8e9f0d19aa03a
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-generation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));
