+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+  })),

+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cf9918a28b3a2e76450b0b0ff2d8e9f0d19aa03a
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-generation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+
+const cases = [

+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,

+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({

+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,

+  })),

+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-r4-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

codex
Implemented endpoint-junction sealing in [cover.ts](/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/combat/cover.ts:409), with witnesses in [visibility-field.test.ts](/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/tests/unit/combat/visibility-field.test.ts:1102).

### Implemented rule

At a sealed diagonal lattice vertex:

- Source rays block only when leaving diagonally into the quadrant opposite the source cell.
- Target rays use the mirrored arrival rule.
- Axis-aligned rays remain governed by the shared-edge rule.
- Zero-length corner rays between opposite free quadrants are blocked.
- Endpoint hits retain progress `0`/`1`; existing progress and lower-row/lower-column ordering remains.
- Physical cover is unchanged.
- The same endpoint metadata/path is used by `coverTierBetweenObjects`.

Corner ownership is explicitly mapped: TL→BR, TR→BL, BL→TR, BR→TL.

### Witness derivations

| Witness | Hand-derived geometry | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED` | Observer `(2,1)` bottom-left corner is vertex `(2,2)`, with its cell in TR. Ray `(2,2)→(0,4)` leaves into opposite BL through TL `(1,1)` + BR `(2,2)`. | `tier none`, blocked, first `(1,1)` |
| `TARGET_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED` | Reverse ray `(0,4)→(2,2)` arrives from BL, opposite the target cell’s TR quadrant, through the same pair. | `tier half`, blocked, first `(1,1)` |
| `SAME_SIDE_ENDPOINT_GRAZE_CLEAR` | `(2,1)→(5,1)` stays on the source side or follows an edge. Mirrored ray `(5,1)→(2,2)` arrives through the target’s own TR quadrant, not opposite BL. | Clear, `firstBlockingCell null` |
| `ADJACENT_CORNER_ZERO_LENGTH` | Source `(2,1)` is TR and target `(1,2)` is BL at vertex `(2,2)`. TL `(1,1)` + BR `(2,2)` separate those opposite free quadrants. | Zero-length and diagonal rays blocked at `(1,1)`; removing BR makes the scene clear |
| Physical-cover pin | `(0,4)→(2,2)` stops optically at the endpoint pinch without crossing an interior. | Line remains `tier none` |
| D569 normalization | Existing `DIAGONAL_CORNER_TOUCH_SEALED_D642` was previously aggregate clear/null because endpoint `(1,1)` was skipped. The source cell lies TL; all four rays from `(1,1)` toward `(2,2)..(3,3)` leave into opposite BR through TR `(1,0)` + BL `(0,1)`. | Normalized only aggregate to blocked, first `(1,0)`; physical tier remains `none` |

### Mutants

- Endpoint rule disabled: exactly `SOURCE_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED` and `TARGET_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED` red; both changed to clear/null.
- Every sealed endpoint blocked regardless of direction: `SAME_SIDE_ENDPOINT_GRAZE_CLEAR` red; mirrored ray became blocked at `(1,1)`.

+] as const;

+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) offers += 1;
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

Implemented endpoint-junction sealing in [cover.ts](/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/combat/cover.ts:409), with witnesses in [visibility-field.test.ts](/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/tests/unit/combat/visibility-field.test.ts:1102).

### Implemented rule

At a sealed diagonal lattice vertex:

- Source rays block only when leaving diagonally into the quadrant opposite the source cell.
- Target rays use the mirrored arrival rule.
- Axis-aligned rays remain governed by the shared-edge rule.
- Zero-length corner rays between opposite free quadrants are blocked.
- Endpoint hits retain progress `0`/`1`; existing progress and lower-row/lower-column ordering remains.
- Physical cover is unchanged.
- The same endpoint metadata/path is used by `coverTierBetweenObjects`.

Corner ownership is explicitly mapped: TL→BR, TR→BL, BL→TR, BR→TL.

### Witness derivations

| Witness | Hand-derived geometry | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED` | Observer `(2,1)` bottom-left corner is vertex `(2,2)`, with its cell in TR. Ray `(2,2)→(0,4)` leaves into opposite BL through TL `(1,1)` + BR `(2,2)`. | `tier none`, blocked, first `(1,1)` |
| `TARGET_ENDPOINT_JUNCTION_SEALED` | Reverse ray `(0,4)→(2,2)` arrives from BL, opposite the target cell’s TR quadrant, through the same pair. | `tier half`, blocked, first `(1,1)` |
| `SAME_SIDE_ENDPOINT_GRAZE_CLEAR` | `(2,1)→(5,1)` stays on the source side or follows an edge. Mirrored ray `(5,1)→(2,2)` arrives through the target’s own TR quadrant, not opposite BL. | Clear, `firstBlockingCell null` |
| `ADJACENT_CORNER_ZERO_LENGTH` | Source `(2,1)` is TR and target `(1,2)` is BL at vertex `(2,2)`. TL `(1,1)` + BR `(2,2)` separate those opposite free quadrants. | Zero-length and diagonal rays blocked at `(1,1)`; removing BR makes the scene clear |
| Physical-cover pin | `(0,4)→(2,2)` stops optically at the endpoint pinch without crossing an interior. | Line remains `tier none` |
| D569 normalization | Existing `DIAGONAL_CORNER_TOUCH_SEALED_D642` was previously aggregate clear/null because endpoint `(1,1)` was skipped. The source cell lies TL; all four rays from `(1,1)` toward `(2,2)..(3,3)` leave into opposite BR through TR `(1,0)` + BL `(0,1)`. | Normalized only aggregate to blocked, first `(1,0)`; physical tier remains `none` |
